 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_user u WHERE u.id=actor AND
 u.is_active)
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
   WHERE c.id=clinic AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF enrollment IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
   WHERE e.id=enrollment AND e.clinic_id=clinic AND e.organization_id=tenant
 ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole WHERE revoked_at IS NULL) r
  WHERE r.user_id=actor AND r.clinic_id=clinic AND r.organization_id=tenant
  AND (CASE r.role
 WHEN 'allied_professional' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read',
 'break_glass.request_scoped', 'demographics.read', 'observation.write',
 'order.observe', 'order.task']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'automation.admin', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.read', 'payout.request', 'refund.request', 'staff.clinic', 'tiss.read',
 'writeoff.request']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_manager' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'automation.admin', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.read', 'payout.request', 'refund.request', 'staff.clinic', 'tiss.read',
 'writeoff.request']::text[])
 WHEN 'finance' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.finance',
 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.billing_read', 'payout.approve', 'refund.approve', 'settlement.post',
 'tiss.manage', 'tiss.read', 'writeoff.approve']::text[])
 WHEN 'nurse' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'break_glass.request_scoped',
 'demographics.read', 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.task']::text[])
 WHEN 'org_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.organization',
 'charge.read', 'configuration.organization', 'finance.policy', 'staff.organization',
 'tiss.read']::text[])
 WHEN 'owner' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.organization',
 'charge.read', 'configuration.organization', 'finance.policy', 'staff.organization',
 'tiss.read']::text[])
 WHEN 'physician' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book_own', 'appointment.move_own',
 'appointment.read_own', 'automation.propose_clinical', 'break_glass.request',
 'charge.read', 'clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read',
 'clinical.write', 'configuration.propose', 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write',
 'order.place', 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge',
 'result.read', 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[])
 WHEN 'receptionist' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read',
 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write', 'order.route']::text[])
 WHEN 'scheduler' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read',
 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write', 'order.route']::text[])
 ELSE false END)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_rolegrant g
    WHERE g.organization_id=tenant AND g.clinic_id=clinic AND g.role=r.role
      AND g.bundle_version=1 AND g.permission=perm AND g.effect='remove'
      AND g.valid_from<=checked_at AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<g.valid_to))
  AND (NOT perm=ANY(ARRAY['break_glass.request', 'break_glass.request_scoped',
 'clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read', 'clinical.write',
 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.place', 'order.task',
 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge', 'result.read',
 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[]) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_professionalregistration p
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=p.clinic_id
    WHERE p.organization_id=tenant AND p.clinic_id=clinic AND p.user_id=actor
      AND p.role=r.role AND p.jurisdiction=c.crm_uf AND p.status='regular'
      AND p.synthetic AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND p.valid_from<=checked_at AND checked_at<p.valid_to
      AND (p.physician_profile_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_physicianprofile legacy
        WHERE legacy.id=p.physician_profile_id AND legacy.organization_id=tenant
          AND legacy.user_id=actor AND legacy.jurisdiction=p.jurisdiction
          AND legacy.synthetic AND legacy.status='regular'
          AND legacy.last_checked_at<=checked_at AND checked_at<legacy.recheck_at
          AND (legacy.expires_at IS NULL OR checked_at<legacy.expires_at)))
  ))
  AND (NOT perm=ANY(ARRAY['clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read',
 'clinical.write', 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.place', 'order.task',
 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge', 'result.read',
 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[]) OR (enrollment IS NOT NULL AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_careteammembership team
      WHERE team.organization_id=tenant AND team.clinic_id=clinic
        AND team.patient_enrollment_id=enrollment AND team.user_id=actor
        AND team.role=r.role AND team.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND team.valid_from<=checked_at
        AND (team.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<team.valid_to))
    OR (r.role='physician' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter encounter
      JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
        ON e.patient_id=encounter.patient_id AND e.clinic_id=encounter.clinic_id
      WHERE e.id=enrollment AND e.organization_id=tenant
        AND encounter.organization_id=tenant AND encounter.clinic_id=clinic
        AND encounter.physician_id=actor AND encounter.state='open'
    ))
  )))
 );
END "

function identity_invitation_begin(bytea.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_invitation_begin(requested_hash bytea, requested_username bytea, requested_password text, requested_device_key text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    invitation clinic_app.identity_staffinvitation%ROWTYPE;
    created_device integer;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO invitation
    FROM clinic_app.identity_staffinvitation
    WHERE token_hash = requested_hash
      AND state = 'pending' AND revoked_at IS NULL
      AND expires_at > statement_timestamp()
      AND organization_id = NULLIF(
          current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), ''
      )::uuid
      AND pending_user_id = NULLIF(
          current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), ''
      )::uuid
    FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND OR invitation.password_set_at IS NOT NULL
       OR requested_username IS NULL OR requested_password IS NULL
       OR requested_password = '!' OR requested_device_key IS NULL
       OR requested_device_key !~ '^[a-f0-9]{40}$'
    THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_user
    SET password = requested_password
    WHERE id = invitation.pending_user_id AND NOT is_active;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice(
        user_id, name, confirmed, key, step, t0, digits, tolerance,
        drift, last_t, throttling_failure_timestamp, throttling_failure_count,
        created_at, last_used_at
    ) VALUES (
        invitation.pending_user_id, 'Clinic OS authenticator', false,
        requested_device_key, 30, 0, 6, 1, 0, -1, NULL, 0,
        statement_timestamp(), NULL
    ) RETURNING id INTO created_device;
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_staffinvitation
    SET desired_username = requested_username,
        password_set_at = statement_timestamp(),
        device_id = created_device
    WHERE id = invitation.id;
    RETURN created_device;
END
$function$
"

function identity_invitation_claim(bytea.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_invitation_claim(requested_hash bytea)
 RETURNS TABLE(invitation_id uuid, organization_id uuid, clinic_id uuid, user_id uuid, desired_username bytea, encoded_password text, device_id integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), '') IS NOT NULL
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '') IS NOT NULL
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal', true), '') IS NOT NULL
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session', true), '') IS NOT NULL
    THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;
    RETURN QUERY
        SELECT invitation.id, invitation.organization_id, invitation.clinic_id,
            invitation.pending_user_id, invitation.desired_username,
            account.password, invitation.device_id
        FROM clinic_app.identity_staffinvitation AS invitation
        JOIN clinic_app.identity_user AS account
          ON account.id = invitation.pending_user_id
        JOIN clinic_app.identity_organization AS organization
          ON organization.id = invitation.organization_id
        WHERE invitation.token_hash = requested_hash
          AND invitation.state = 'pending' AND invitation.revoked_at IS NULL
          AND invitation.expires_at > statement_timestamp()
          AND organization.status = 'active' AND NOT account.is_active
        FOR UPDATE OF invitation, account;
END
$function$
"

function identity_invitation_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_invitation_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
        IF OLD.state <> 'pending' AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'invitation terminal history is immutable';
        END IF;
        IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
           OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
           OR NEW.clinic_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.clinic_id
           OR NEW.pending_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_user_id
           OR NEW.invited_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.invited_by_id
           OR NEW.email_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.email_hash
           OR NEW.email IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.email
           OR NEW.bundle IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.bundle
           OR NEW.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.token_hash
           OR NEW.token_nonce IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.token_nonce
           OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
           OR NEW.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expires_at
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'invitation identity is immutable';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.state = 'accepted' THEN
        IF current_user <> 'clinic_resolver'
           OR NEW.accepted_at IS NULL OR NEW.password_set_at IS NULL
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice AS device
               JOIN clinic_app.identity_user AS account ON account.id = device.user_id
               WHERE device.id = NEW.device_id
                 AND device.user_id = NEW.pending_user_id
                 AND device.confirmed AND device.last_t >= 0 AND account.is_active
                 AND account.password <> '!'
           )
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'invitation requires password and confirmed TOTP';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function identity_recovery_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_recovery_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'identity_recoverycode' THEN
        IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
            IF octet_length(NEW.code_hash) <> 32 OR NEW.used_at IS NOT NULL THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                    MESSAGE = 'recovery code requires an unused digest';
            END IF;
        ELSE
            IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
               OR NEW.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.batch_id
               OR NEW.code_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.code_hash
               OR OLD.used_at IS NOT NULL
               OR NEW.used_at IS NULL OR current_user <> 'clinic_resolver'
            THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                    MESSAGE = 'recovery code consumption requires its boundary';
            END IF;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'identity_recoverybatch' THEN
        IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
            IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
               OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_id
               OR NEW.device_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.device_id
               OR NEW.static_device_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.static_device_id
               OR NEW.issued_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.issued_at
               OR OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.revoked_at IS NULL
            THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                    MESSAGE = 'recovery enrollment history is immutable';
            END IF;
        ELSIF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice AS device
            JOIN clinic_app.otp_static_staticdevice AS recovery
              ON recovery.id = NEW.static_device_id
            WHERE device.id = NEW.device_id AND device.user_id = NEW.user_id
              AND device.confirmed AND recovery.user_id = NEW.user_id
              AND recovery.confirmed
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_authenticatorretirement
                  WHERE device_id = device.id
              )
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'recovery enrollment requires a confirmed authenticator';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice
            WHERE id = NEW.device_id AND user_id = NEW.user_id
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'authenticator retirement history is immutable';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function identity_reset_execute(uuid, by.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_reset_execute(requested_reset uuid, requested_session bytea)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    reset clinic_app.identity_authenticatorreset%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO reset FROM clinic_app.identity_authenticatorreset
    WHERE id = requested_reset
      AND organization_id = NULLIF(
          current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), ''
      )::uuid
    FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND OR reset.executed_at IS NOT NULL
       OR reset.notified_at IS NULL OR reset.available_at IS NULL
       OR reset.available_at <> reset.notified_at + interval '24 hours'
       OR reset.available_at > statement_timestamp()
       OR NOT clinic_app.identity_session_step_up(
           requested_session, reset.clinic_id
       )
       OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole AS membership
           JOIN clinic_app.identity_user AS account
             ON account.id = membership.user_id
           WHERE membership.user_id = reset.user_id
             AND membership.clinic_id = reset.clinic_id
             AND membership.organization_id = reset.organization_id
             AND membership.revoked_at IS NULL AND account.is_active
       )
       OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation AS operation
           WHERE operation.id = reset.notification_operation_id
             AND operation.status = 'delivered'
       )
    THEN
        RETURN false;
    END IF;
    PERFORM clinic_app.identity_retire_authenticators(reset.user_id);
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_authenticatorreset
    SET executed_at = statement_timestamp() WHERE id = reset.id;
    RETURN true;
END
$function$
"

           JOIN clinic_app.identity_user AS account
             ON account.id = membership.user_id
           WHERE membership.user_id = reset.user_id
             AND membership.clinic_id = reset.clinic_id
             AND membership.organization_id = reset.organization_id
             AND membership.revoked_at IS NULL AND account.is_active
       )
       OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation AS operation
           WHERE operation.id = reset.notification_operation_id
             AND operation.status = 'delivered'
       )
    THEN
        RETURN false;
    END IF;
    PERFORM clinic_app.identity_retire_authenticators(reset.user_id);
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_authenticatorreset
    SET executed_at = statement_timestamp() WHERE id = reset.id;

function identity_reset_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_reset_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        IF NEW.notified_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.available_at IS NOT NULL
           OR NEW.executed_at IS NOT NULL
           OR NOT clinic_app.identity_reset_target(NEW.clinic_id, NEW.user_id)
           OR NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(
               current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), ''
           )::uuid
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'reset starts without notification or execution';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
           OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
           OR NEW.clinic_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.clinic_id
           OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_id
           OR NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requested_by_id
           OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
           OR (OLD.notification_operation_id IS NOT NULL
               AND NEW.notification_operation_id
                   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.notification_operation_id)
           OR OLD.executed_at IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'reset identity and execution history are immutable';
        END IF;
        IF (
            NEW.notified_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.notified_at
            OR NEW.available_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.available_at
            OR NEW.executed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.executed_at
        ) AND current_user <> 'clinic_resolver' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'reset timing and execution require their boundaries';
        END IF;
        IF NEW.notified_at IS NOT NULL AND (
            NEW.available_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.notified_at + interval '24 hours'
            OR NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation AS operation
                WHERE operation.id = NEW.notification_operation_id
                  AND operation.status = 'delivered'
            )
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'reset requires delivered notification and full delay';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.notification_operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation AS operation
        WHERE operation.id = NEW.notification_operation_id
          AND operation.organization_id = NEW.organization_id
          AND operation.clinic_id = NEW.clinic_id
          AND operation.actor_id = NEW.requested_by_id
          AND operation.subject_id = NEW.id
          AND operation.subject_type = 'identity.authenticator_reset'
          AND operation.provider = 'identity-email-v1'
          AND operation.kind = 'communication' AND operation.channel = 'email'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'reset requires its own scoped notification operation';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    result uuid;
BEGIN
    IF requested_hash IS NULL OR octet_length(requested_hash) <> 32
       OR requested_user IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(
           current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), ''
       )::uuid
       OR requested_expiry IS NULL OR requested_expiry <= statement_timestamp()
       OR requested_network IS NULL OR requested_family IS NULL
       OR requested_family NOT IN ('chromium', 'firefox', 'safari', 'other')
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal', true), '') IS NOT NULL
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session', true), '') IS NOT NULL
       OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_user
           WHERE id = requested_user AND is_active
       )
    THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO clinic_app.identity_sessionrecord (
        id, user_id, session_key_hash, created_at, last_seen, ip_network,
        user_agent_family, expires_at, revoked_at, verification_device_id, verified_at
    ) VALUES (
        gen_random_uuid(), requested_user, requested_hash, statement_timestamp(),
        statement_timestamp(), requested_network, requested_family, requested_expiry,
        NULL, NULL, NULL
    )
    ON CONFLICT (session_key_hash) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id INTO result;
    IF result IS NULL THEN
        SELECT id INTO result FROM clinic_app.identity_sessionrecord
        WHERE session_key_hash = requested_hash AND user_id = requested_user
          AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > statement_timestamp();
    END IF;
    RETURN result;
END
$function$
"

          AND account.is_active

function patient_registry_count(text, uu.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.patient_registry_count(kek text, requested_clinic uuid, normalized_query text, requested_birth date)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    total pg_catalog.int8;
BEGIN

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole AS role_row
          JOIN clinic_app.identity_user AS user_row
            ON user_row.id = role_row.user_id AND user_row.is_active
         WHERE role_row.user_id = NULLIF(
             pg_catalog.current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), ''
         )::pg_catalog.uuid
           AND role_row.organization_id = NULLIF(
               pg_catalog.current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), ''
           )::pg_catalog.uuid
           AND role_row.revoked_at IS NULL
           AND role_row.clinic_id = requested_clinic
           AND role_row.role IN ('owner', 'clinic_admin', 'receptionist')
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501',
            MESSAGE = 'clinic manager authority is required';
    END IF;

    SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) INTO total
      FROM (

        SELECT enrollment_row.id AS enrollment_id,
               patient_row.id AS patient_id,
               pg_catalog.convert_from(
                   clinic_app.protected_decrypt(
                       kek, 'intake.patient.full_name', patient_row.full_name
                   ),
                   'UTF8'
               ) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" AS decrypted_name,
               CASE WHEN patient_row.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
                    ELSE pg_catalog.convert_from(
                        clinic_app.protected_decrypt(
                            kek,
                            'intake.patient.birth_date',
                            patient_row.birth_date
                        ),
                        'UTF8'
                    )::pg_catalog.date
               END AS decrypted_birth,
               CASE WHEN demographics_row.social_name IS NULL THEN NULL
                    ELSE pg_catalog.convert_from(
                        clinic_app.protected_decrypt(
                            kek,
                            'intake.patientdemographics.social_name',
                            demographics_row.social_name
                        ),
                        'UTF8'
                    )
               END COLLATE pg_catalog."default" AS decrypted_social_name
          FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment AS enrollment_row
          JOIN clinic_app.intake_patient AS patient_row
            ON patient_row.id = enrollment_row.patient_id
           AND patient_row.organization_id = enrollment_row.organization_id
          LEFT JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientdemographics AS demographics_row
            ON demographics_row.organization_id = enrollment_row.organization_id
           AND demographics_row.patient_id = enrollment_row.patient_id
           AND demographics_row.version = (
               SELECT pg_catalog.max(latest_row.version)
                 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientdemographics AS latest_row
                WHERE latest_row.organization_id = enrollment_row.organization_id
                  AND latest_row.patient_id = enrollment_row.patient_id
           )
         WHERE enrollment_row.clinic_id = requested_clinic
           AND enrollment_row.organization_id = NULLIF(
               pg_catalog.current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), ''
           )::pg_catalog.uuid

      ) AS decrypted
     WHERE 
        (pg_catalog.strpos(
            clinic_app.unaccent(
                pg_catalog.lower(decrypted.decrypted_name)
            ),
            clinic_app.unaccent(pg_catalog.lower(normalized_query))
        ) > 0
        OR pg_catalog.strpos(
            clinic_app.unaccent(
                pg_catalog.lower(
                    COALESCE(decrypted.decrypted_social_name, '')
                )
            ),
            clinic_app.unaccent(pg_catalog.lower(normalized_query))
        ) > 0)

       AND (requested_birth IS NULL
            OR decrypted.decrypted_birth = requested_birth);
    RETURN total;
END
$function$
"

function identity_invitation_claim(bytea.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_invitation_claim(requested_hash bytea)
 RETURNS TABLE(invitation_id uuid, organization_id uuid, clinic_id uuid, user_id uuid, desired_username bytea, encoded_password text, device_id integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), '') IS NOT NULL
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '') IS NOT NULL
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal', true), '') IS NOT NULL
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session', true), '') IS NOT NULL
    THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;
    RETURN QUERY
        SELECT invitation.id, invitation.organization_id, invitation.clinic_id,
            invitation.pending_user_id, invitation.desired_username,
            account.password::text, invitation.device_id
        FROM clinic_app.identity_staffinvitation AS invitation
        JOIN clinic_app.identity_user AS account
          ON account.id = invitation.pending_user_id
        JOIN clinic_app.identity_organization AS organization
          ON organization.id = invitation.organization_id
        WHERE invitation.token_hash = requested_hash
          AND invitation.state = 'pending' AND invitation.revoked_at IS NULL
          AND invitation.expires_at > statement_timestamp()
          AND organization.status = 'active' AND NOT account.is_active
        FOR UPDATE OF invitation;
END
$function$
"

function identity_invitation_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_invitation_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
        IF OLD.state <> 'pending' AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'invitation terminal history is immutable';
        END IF;
        IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
           OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
           OR NEW.clinic_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.clinic_id
           OR NEW.pending_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_user_id
           OR NEW.invited_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.invited_by_id
           OR NEW.email_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.email_hash
           OR NEW.email IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.email
           OR NEW.bundle IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.bundle
           OR NEW.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.token_hash
           OR NEW.token_nonce IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.token_nonce
           OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
           OR NEW.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expires_at
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'invitation identity is immutable';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.state = 'accepted' THEN
        IF current_user <> 'clinic_owner'
           OR NEW.accepted_at IS NULL OR NEW.password_set_at IS NULL
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice AS device
               JOIN clinic_app.identity_user AS account ON account.id = device.user_id
               WHERE device.id = NEW.device_id
                 AND device.user_id = NEW.pending_user_id
                 AND device.confirmed AND device.last_t >= 0 AND account.is_active
                 AND account.password <> '!'
           )
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'invitation requires password and confirmed TOTP';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

           OR NEW.accepted_at IS NULL OR NEW.password_set_at IS NULL
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice AS device
               JOIN clinic_app.identity_user AS account ON account.id = device.user_id
               WHERE device.id = NEW.device_id
                 AND device.user_id = NEW.pending_user_id
                 AND device.confirmed AND device.last_t >= 0 AND account.is_active
                 AND account.password <> '!'
           )
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                MESSAGE = 'invitation requires password and confirmed TOTP';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END

"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_session_change_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
       OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_id
       OR NEW.session_key_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.session_key_hash
       OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
       OR NEW.ip_network IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ip_network
       OR NEW.user_agent_family IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_agent_family
       OR NEW.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expires_at
       OR (OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD)
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'session identity is immutable';
    END IF;
    IF (
           NEW.verification_device_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.verification_device_id
           OR NEW.verified_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.verified_at
           OR NEW.superseded_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.superseded_at
       )
       AND current_user <> 'clinic_resolver'
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'session verification requires its authenticated boundary';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function has_permission(text, uuid, uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.has_permission(perm text, clinic uuid, enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid; tenant uuid; checked_at timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
BEGIN
 BEGIN
  actor := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
  tenant := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RETURN false;
 END;
 IF actor IS NULL OR tenant IS NULL OR clinic IS NULL OR perm IS NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_user u WHERE u.id=actor AND
 u.is_active)
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
   WHERE c.id=clinic AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF enrollment IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
   WHERE e.id=enrollment AND e.clinic_id=clinic AND e.organization_id=tenant
 ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r
  WHERE r.revoked_at IS NULL
  AND r.user_id=actor AND r.clinic_id=clinic AND r.organization_id=tenant
  AND (CASE r.role
 WHEN 'allied_professional' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read',
 'break_glass.request_scoped', 'demographics.read', 'observation.write',
 'order.observe', 'order.task']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'automation.admin', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.read', 'payout.request', 'refund.request', 'staff.clinic', 'tiss.read',
 'writeoff.request']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_manager' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'automation.admin', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.read', 'payout.request', 'refund.request', 'staff.clinic', 'tiss.read',
 'writeoff.request']::text[])
 WHEN 'finance' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.finance',
 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.billing_read', 'payout.approve', 'refund.approve', 'settlement.post',
 'tiss.manage', 'tiss.read', 'writeoff.approve']::text[])
 WHEN 'nurse' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'break_glass.request_scoped',
 'demographics.read', 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.task']::text[])
 WHEN 'org_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.organization',
 'charge.read', 'configuration.organization', 'finance.policy', 'staff.organization',
 'tiss.read']::text[])
 WHEN 'owner' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.organization',
 'charge.read', 'configuration.organization', 'finance.policy', 'staff.organization',
 'tiss.read']::text[])
 WHEN 'physician' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book_own', 'appointment.move_own',
 'appointment.read_own', 'automation.propose_clinical', 'break_glass.request',
 'charge.read', 'clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read',
 'clinical.write', 'configuration.propose', 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write',
 'order.place', 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge',
 'result.read', 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[])
 WHEN 'receptionist' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read',
 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write', 'order.route']::text[])
 WHEN 'scheduler' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read',
 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write', 'order.route']::text[])
 ELSE false END OR (r.workflow_bundle_version=2 AND CASE r.role
 WHEN 'owner' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete','tasks.reassign']::text[])
 WHEN 'org_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete','tasks.reassign']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete','tasks.reassign']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_manager' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete','tasks.reassign']::text[])
 WHEN 'physician' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'nurse' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'allied_professional' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'receptionist' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'scheduler' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'finance' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 ELSE false END))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_rolegrant g
    WHERE g.organization_id=tenant AND g.clinic_id=clinic AND g.role=r.role
      AND g.bundle_version IN (1,r.workflow_bundle_version)
      AND g.permission=perm AND g.effect='remove'
      AND g.valid_from<=checked_at AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<g.valid_to))
  AND (NOT perm=ANY(ARRAY['break_glass.request', 'break_glass.request_scoped',
 'clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read', 'clinical.write',
 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.place', 'order.task',
 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge', 'result.read',
 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[]) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_professionalregistration p
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=p.clinic_id
    WHERE p.organization_id=tenant AND p.clinic_id=clinic AND p.user_id=actor
      AND p.role=r.role AND p.jurisdiction=c.crm_uf AND p.status='regular'
      AND p.synthetic AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND p.valid_from<=checked_at AND checked_at<p.valid_to
      AND (p.physician_profile_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_physicianprofile legacy
        WHERE legacy.id=p.physician_profile_id AND legacy.organization_id=tenant
          AND legacy.user_id=actor AND legacy.jurisdiction=p.jurisdiction
          AND legacy.synthetic AND legacy.status='regular'
          AND legacy.last_checked_at<=checked_at AND checked_at<legacy.recheck_at
          AND (legacy.expires_at IS NULL OR checked_at<legacy.expires_at)))
  ))
  AND (NOT perm=ANY(ARRAY['clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read',
 'clinical.write', 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.place', 'order.task',
 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge', 'result.read',
 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[]) OR (enrollment IS NOT NULL AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_careteammembership team
      WHERE team.organization_id=tenant AND team.clinic_id=clinic
        AND team.patient_enrollment_id=enrollment AND team.user_id=actor
        AND team.role=r.role AND team.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND team.valid_from<=checked_at
        AND (team.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<team.valid_to))
    OR (r.role='physician' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter encounter
      JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
        ON e.patient_id=encounter.patient_id AND e.clinic_id=encounter.clinic_id
      WHERE e.id=enrollment AND e.organization_id=tenant
        AND encounter.organization_id=tenant AND encounter.clinic_id=clinic
        AND encounter.physician_id=actor AND encounter.state='open'
    ))
  )))
 );
END $function$
"

function patient_session_overview(text).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.patient_session_overview(kek text)
 RETURNS TABLE(session_id uuid, patient_name character varying, clinic_name character varying, enrolled_at timestamp with time zone, operations text[], expires_at timestamp with time zone, idle_expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER ROWS 1
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT s.session_id,convert_from(clinic_app.protected_decrypt(kek,
   CASE WHEN demographics.social_name IS NOT NULL
   THEN 'intake.patientdemographics.social_name' ELSE 'intake.patient.full_name' END,
   coalesce(demographics.social_name,p.full_name)),'UTF8')::varchar,
   c.name,e.created_at,s.operations,s.expires_at,s.idle_expires_at
 FROM clinic_app.current_patient_authority('enrollment_view') s
 JOIN clinic_app.intake_patient p ON p.id=s.patient_id
 JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=s.clinic_id
 JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e ON e.id=s.enrollment_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT d.social_name FROM clinic_app.intake_patientdemographics d
   WHERE d.patient_id=s.patient_id AND d.organization_id=s.organization_id
   ORDER BY d.version DESC LIMIT 1) demographics ON true
$function$
"

function has_permission(text, uuid, uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.has_permission(perm text, clinic uuid, enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid; tenant uuid; checked_at timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
BEGIN
 BEGIN
  actor := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
  tenant := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RETURN false;
 END;
 IF actor IS NULL OR tenant IS NULL OR clinic IS NULL OR perm IS NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_user u WHERE u.id=actor AND
 u.is_active)
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
   WHERE c.id=clinic AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF enrollment IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
   WHERE e.id=enrollment AND e.clinic_id=clinic AND e.organization_id=tenant
 ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF perm=ANY(ARRAY['encounter.open_unscheduled']::text[]) THEN
  RETURN EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r
   WHERE r.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND r.user_id=actor AND r.clinic_id=clinic AND r.organization_id=tenant
    AND r.role='physician'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_rolegrant g
     WHERE g.organization_id=tenant AND g.clinic_id=clinic AND g.role=r.role
      AND g.bundle_version=2 AND g.permission=perm AND g.effect='remove'
      AND g.valid_from<=checked_at AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<g.valid_to))
    AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_professionalregistration p
     JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=p.clinic_id
     WHERE p.organization_id=tenant AND p.clinic_id=clinic AND p.user_id=actor
      AND p.role=r.role AND p.jurisdiction=c.crm_uf AND p.status='regular'
      AND p.synthetic AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND p.valid_from<=checked_at AND checked_at<p.valid_to
      AND (p.physician_profile_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_physicianprofile legacy
       WHERE legacy.id=p.physician_profile_id AND legacy.organization_id=tenant
        AND legacy.user_id=actor AND legacy.jurisdiction=p.jurisdiction
        AND legacy.synthetic AND legacy.status='regular'
        AND legacy.last_checked_at<=checked_at AND checked_at<legacy.recheck_at
        AND (legacy.expires_at IS NULL OR checked_at<legacy.expires_at))))
  );
 END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r
  WHERE r.revoked_at IS NULL
  AND r.user_id=actor AND r.clinic_id=clinic AND r.organization_id=tenant
  AND (CASE r.role
 WHEN 'allied_professional' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read',
 'break_glass.request_scoped', 'demographics.read', 'observation.write',
 'order.observe', 'order.task']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'automation.admin', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.read', 'payout.request', 'refund.request', 'staff.clinic', 'tiss.read',
 'writeoff.request']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_manager' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'automation.admin', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.read', 'payout.request', 'refund.request', 'staff.clinic', 'tiss.read',
 'writeoff.request']::text[])
 WHEN 'finance' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.finance',
 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read', 'configuration.clinic',
 'demographics.billing_read', 'payout.approve', 'refund.approve', 'settlement.post',
 'tiss.manage', 'tiss.read', 'writeoff.approve']::text[])
 WHEN 'nurse' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'break_glass.request_scoped',
 'demographics.read', 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.task']::text[])
 WHEN 'org_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.organization',
 'charge.read', 'configuration.organization', 'finance.policy', 'staff.organization',
 'tiss.read']::text[])
 WHEN 'owner' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.read', 'automation.organization',
 'charge.read', 'configuration.organization', 'finance.policy', 'staff.organization',
 'tiss.read']::text[])
 WHEN 'physician' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book_own', 'appointment.move_own',
 'appointment.read_own', 'automation.propose_clinical', 'break_glass.request',
 'charge.read', 'clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read',
 'clinical.write', 'configuration.propose', 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write',
 'order.place', 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge',
 'result.read', 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[])
 WHEN 'receptionist' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read',
 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write', 'order.route']::text[])
 WHEN 'scheduler' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY['appointment.book', 'appointment.move',
 'appointment.read', 'charge.collect', 'charge.create', 'charge.read',
 'demographics.read', 'demographics.write', 'order.route']::text[])
 ELSE false END OR (r.workflow_bundle_version=2 AND CASE r.role
 WHEN 'owner' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete','tasks.reassign']::text[])
 WHEN 'org_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete','tasks.reassign']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_admin' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete','tasks.reassign']::text[])
 WHEN 'clinic_manager' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete','tasks.reassign']::text[])
 WHEN 'physician' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'nurse' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'allied_professional' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'receptionist' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'scheduler' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 WHEN 'finance' THEN perm=ANY(ARRAY[
  'tasks.view','tasks.assign','tasks.complete']::text[])
 ELSE false END))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_rolegrant g
    WHERE g.organization_id=tenant AND g.clinic_id=clinic AND g.role=r.role
      AND g.bundle_version IN (1,r.workflow_bundle_version)
      AND g.permission=perm AND g.effect='remove'
      AND g.valid_from<=checked_at AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<g.valid_to))
  AND (NOT perm=ANY(ARRAY['break_glass.request', 'break_glass.request_scoped',
 'clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read', 'clinical.write',
 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.place', 'order.task',
 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge', 'result.read',
 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[]) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_professionalregistration p
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=p.clinic_id
    WHERE p.organization_id=tenant AND p.clinic_id=clinic AND p.user_id=actor
      AND p.role=r.role AND p.jurisdiction=c.crm_uf AND p.status='regular'
      AND p.synthetic AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND p.valid_from<=checked_at AND checked_at<p.valid_to
      AND (p.physician_profile_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_physicianprofile legacy
        WHERE legacy.id=p.physician_profile_id AND legacy.organization_id=tenant
          AND legacy.user_id=actor AND legacy.jurisdiction=p.jurisdiction
          AND legacy.synthetic AND legacy.status='regular'
          AND legacy.last_checked_at<=checked_at AND checked_at<legacy.recheck_at
          AND (legacy.expires_at IS NULL OR checked_at<legacy.expires_at)))
  ))
  AND (NOT perm=ANY(ARRAY['clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read',
 'clinical.write', 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.place', 'order.task',
 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge', 'result.read',
 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[]) OR (enrollment IS NOT NULL AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_careteammembership team
      WHERE team.organization_id=tenant AND team.clinic_id=clinic
        AND team.patient_enrollment_id=enrollment AND team.user_id=actor
        AND team.role=r.role AND team.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND team.valid_from<=checked_at
        AND (team.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<team.valid_to))
    OR (r.role='physician' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter encounter
      JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
        ON e.patient_id=encounter.patient_id AND e.clinic_id=encounter.clinic_id
      WHERE e.id=enrollment AND e.organization_id=tenant
        AND encounter.organization_id=tenant AND encounter.clinic_id=clinic
        AND encounter.physician_id=actor AND encounter.state='open'
    ))
  )))
 );
END $function$
"

      AND p.role=r.role AND p.jurisdiction=c.crm_uf AND p.status='regular'
      AND p.synthetic AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND p.valid_from<=checked_at AND checked_at<p.valid_to
      AND (p.physician_profile_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_physicianprofile legacy
        WHERE legacy.id=p.physician_profile_id AND legacy.organization_id=tenant
          AND legacy.user_id=actor AND legacy.jurisdiction=p.jurisdiction
          AND legacy.synthetic AND legacy.status='regular'
          AND legacy.last_checked_at<=checked_at AND checked_at<legacy.recheck_at
          AND (legacy.expires_at IS NULL OR checked_at<legacy.expires_at)))
  ))
  AND (NOT perm=ANY(ARRAY['clinical.amend', 'clinical.finalize', 'clinical.read',
 'clinical.write', 'observation.write', 'order.observe', 'order.place', 'order.task',
 'prescription.prepare', 'prescription.sign', 'result.acknowledge', 'result.read',
 'result.release', 'tiss.clinical_read']::text[]) OR (enrollment IS NOT NULL AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_careteammembership team
      WHERE team.organization_id=tenant AND team.clinic_id=clinic
        AND team.patient_enrollment_id=enrollment AND team.user_id=actor
        AND team.role=r.role AND team.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND team.valid_from<=checked_at
        AND (team.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<team.valid_to))
    OR (r.role='physician' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter encounter
      JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
        ON e.patient_id=encounter.patient_id AND e.clinic_id=encounter.clinic_id
      WHERE e.id=enrollment AND e.organization_id=tenant
        AND encounter.organization_id=tenant AND encounter.clinic_id=clinic
        AND encounter.physician_id=actor AND encounter.state='open'
    ))
  )))
 );
END "

function identity_session_change_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_session_change_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
       OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_id
       OR NEW.session_key_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.session_key_hash
       OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
       OR NEW.ip_network IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ip_network
       OR NEW.user_agent_family IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_agent_family
       OR NEW.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expires_at
       OR NEW.superseded_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.superseded_at
          AND current_user <> 'clinic_resolver'
       OR (OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD)
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'session identity is immutable';
    END IF;
    IF (
        NEW.verification_device_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.verification_device_id
        OR NEW.verification_passkey_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.verification_passkey_id
        OR NEW.verified_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.verified_at
    ) AND current_user <> 'clinic_resolver' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'session verification requires its authenticated boundary';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function identity_retire_authenticators(.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_retire_authenticators(requested_user uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO clinic_app.identity_authenticatorretirement(
        id, user_id, device_id, retired_at
    )
    SELECT gen_random_uuid(), user_id, id, statement_timestamp()
    FROM clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice WHERE user_id = requested_user
    ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO NOTHING;
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_passkey SET removed_at = statement_timestamp()
    WHERE user_id = requested_user AND removed_at IS NULL;
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_recoverybatch
    SET revoked_at = statement_timestamp()
    WHERE user_id = requested_user AND revoked_at IS NULL;
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_sessionrecord
    SET revoked_at = statement_timestamp()
    WHERE user_id = requested_user AND revoked_at IS NULL;
END
$function$
"

function identity_session_verify(bytea,.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_session_verify(requested_hash bytea, requested_device integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    WITH verified AS (
        UPDATE clinic_app.identity_sessionrecord AS session
        SET verification_device_id = requested_device,
            verification_passkey_id = NULL,
            verified_at = statement_timestamp()
        FROM clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice AS device
        WHERE session.session_key_hash = requested_hash
          AND session.user_id = NULLIF(
              current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), ''
          )::uuid
          AND session.revoked_at IS NULL
          AND session.expires_at > statement_timestamp()
          AND device.id = requested_device AND device.user_id = session.user_id
          AND device.confirmed AND device.last_t >= 0
          AND device.last_used_at >= statement_timestamp() - interval '5 minutes'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_authenticatorretirement AS retirement
              WHERE retirement.device_id = device.id
          )
        RETURNING session.id
    )
    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verified)
$function$
"

function has_permission(text, uuid, uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.has_permission(perm text, clinic uuid, enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid; tenant uuid; checked_at timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
BEGIN
 BEGIN
  actor := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
  tenant := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RETURN false;
 END;
 IF actor IS NULL OR tenant IS NULL OR clinic IS NULL OR perm IS NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_user u WHERE u.id=actor AND
 u.is_active)
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
   WHERE c.id=clinic AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF enrollment IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
   WHERE e.id=enrollment AND e.clinic_id=clinic AND e.organization_id=tenant
 ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF perm='reception.queue' THEN
  RETURN EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r
   WHERE r.organization_id=tenant AND r.clinic_id=clinic AND r.user_id=actor
    AND r.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.role IN ('receptionist','nurse')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_rolegrant g
     WHERE g.organization_id=tenant AND g.clinic_id=clinic AND g.role=r.role
      AND g.bundle_version=2 AND g.permission=perm AND g.effect='remove'
      AND g.valid_from<=checked_at AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<g.valid_to))
  );
 END IF;
 IF perm=ANY(ARRAY['encounter.open_unscheduled']::text[]) THEN
  RETURN EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r
   WHERE r.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND r.user_id=actor AND r.clinic_id=clinic AND r.organization_id=tenant
    AND r.role='physician'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_rolegrant g
     WHERE g.organization_id=tenant AND g.clinic_id=clinic AND g.role=r.role
      AND g.bundle_version=2 AND g.permission=perm AND g.effect='remove'
      AND g.valid_from<=checked_at AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR checked_at<g.valid_to))
    AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_professionalregistration p
     JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=p.clinic_id
     WHERE p.organization_id=tenant AND p.clinic_id=clinic AND p.user_id=actor
      AND p.role=r.role AND p.jurisdiction=c.crm_uf AND p.status='regular'
      AND p.synthetic AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND p.valid_from<=checked_at AND checked_at<p.valid_to
      AND (p.physician_profile_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_physicianprofile legacy
       WHERE legacy.id=p.physician_profile_id AND legacy.organization_id=tenant

function scribe_assigned(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_assigned(requested_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession s
 WHERE s.id=requested_session
 AND s.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND s.physician_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
 AND clinic_app.ehr_assigned(s.encounter_id)
 AND clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',s.clinic_id,s.enrollment_id))
$function$
"

function scribe_consent(uuid, uuid, uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_consent(acceptance uuid, clinic uuid, enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance a
 JOIN clinic_app.consent_consenttext t ON t.id=a.text_id
 WHERE a.id=acceptance AND a.clinic_id=clinic AND a.enrollment_id=enrollment
 AND t.purpose='consultation_recording'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentrevocation r
  WHERE r.acceptance_id=a.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consenttext newer
  WHERE newer.clinic_id=t.clinic_id AND newer.purpose=t.purpose
   AND newer.version>t.version))
$function$
"
function scribe_consent(uuid, uuid, uuid.prosrc:
"
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance a
 JOIN clinic_app.consent_consenttext t ON t.id=a.text_id
 WHERE a.id=acceptance AND a.clinic_id=clinic AND a.enrollment_id=enrollment
 AND t.purpose='consultation_recording'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentrevocation r
  WHERE r.acceptance_id=a.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consenttext newer
  WHERE newer.clinic_id=t.clinic_id AND newer.purpose=t.purpose
   AND newer.version>t.version))
"

function scribe_consent_fence().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_consent_fence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE clinic uuid; purpose text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='consent_consenttext' THEN
  clinic:=NEW.clinic_id; purpose:=NEW.purpose;
 ELSE
  SELECT a.clinic_id,t.purpose INTO clinic,purpose
   FROM clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance a
   JOIN clinic_app.consent_consenttext t ON t.id=a.text_id
   WHERE a.id=NEW.acceptance_id;
 END IF;
 IF purpose='consultation_recording' THEN
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
   'clinic-lock-v1:comms-subject:scribe-consent:'||clinic,0));
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function scribe_gaps(uuid, text, integer.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_gaps(requested_epoch uuid, requested_track text, high integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(lo,hi) ORDER BY lo),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM (SELECT min(n) lo,max(n) hi FROM (
   SELECT n,n-row_number() OVER(ORDER BY n) AS bucket
   FROM generate_series(0,high) n WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_audiochunk c WHERE c.epoch_id=requested_epoch
    AND c.track=requested_track AND c.seq=n AND c.state IN ('buffered','accepted'))
 ) missing GROUP BY bucket) ranges
$function$
"
function scribe_gaps(uuid, text, integer.prosrc:
"
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(lo,hi) ORDER BY lo),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM (SELECT min(n) lo,max(n) hi FROM (
   SELECT n,n-row_number() OVER(ORDER BY n) AS bucket
   FROM generate_series(0,high) n WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_audiochunk c WHERE c.epoch_id=requested_epoch
    AND c.track=requested_track AND c.seq=n AND c.state IN ('buffered','accepted'))
 ) missing GROUP BY bucket) ranges
"

function scribe_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE s clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession; e clinic_app.ehr_encounter;
 p clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment; ep clinic_app.scribe_captureepoch;
 token text; item record; valid boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'recording history is retained' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 token:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.scribe_token',true),'');
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_recordingsession' THEN
  SELECT * INTO e FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter WHERE id=NEW.encounter_id;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment
   WHERE id=NEW.enrollment_id;
  IF e.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL
   OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.physician_id)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.physician_id)
   OR (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id,p.patient_id)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.patient_id)
   OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM
     NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
   OR NEW.physician_id IS DISTINCT FROM
     NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
   OR NOT clinic_app.ehr_assigned(NEW.encounter_id)
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
   OR NEW.token_digest !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'recording authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.state<>'created' OR NEW.epoch<>0 OR NEW.revision<>1
    OR NEW.discarded OR NEW.stopped_at IS NOT NULL OR e.state<>'open'
    OR NEW.token_digest IS DISTINCT FROM token THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid recording binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp();
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-
    ARRAY['state','epoch','revision','discarded','stopped_at','token_digest'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-
    ARRAY['state','epoch','revision','discarded','stopped_at','token_digest'])
    OR OLD.state NOT IN ('created','authorized','recording','paused')
    OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR (OLD.discarded AND NOT NEW.discarded)
    OR (OLD.state,NEW.state) NOT IN (
     ('created','authorized'),('authorized','recording'),
     ('recording','paused'),('paused','recording'),
     ('authorized','paused'),('paused','paused'),
     ('created','stopped'),('authorized','stopped'),('recording','stopped'),
     ('paused','stopped'),('created','stopped_revoked'),
     ('authorized','stopped_revoked'),('recording','stopped_revoked'),
     ('paused','stopped_revoked'))
    OR (NEW.state='recording' AND NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch+1)
    OR (NEW.state<>'recording' AND NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch)
    OR (NEW.state NOT IN ('stopped','stopped_revoked')
      AND (NEW.stopped_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.discarded
       OR NEW.token_digest IS DISTINCT FROM token))
    OR (NEW.state IN ('stopped','stopped_revoked') AND NEW.stopped_at IS NULL)
    OR (NEW.token_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.token_digest
      AND (NEW.state<>'paused'
       OR current_setting('app.scribe_recovery',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid recording transition' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
  valid:=clinic_app.scribe_consent(NEW.consent_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id);
  IF (NEW.state IN ('created','authorized','recording') AND NOT valid)
   OR (NEW.state='stopped_revoked' AND valid)
   OR (NEW.state='recording' AND e.state<>'open')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'recording consent denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state IN ('created','authorized','recording') AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.providers_capabilityversion v
   JOIN clinic_app.providers_providercapability c ON c.id=v.capability_id
   WHERE v.id=NEW.capability_version_id AND c.key='object_storage_media'
    AND v.state NOT IN ('revoked','degraded') AND c.current_version_id=v.id
    AND NEW.capability_snapshot=jsonb_build_object(
     'capability','object_storage_media','provider',v.provider,'account',v.account,
     'environment',v.environment,'api_version',v.api_version,'region',v.region,
     'retention_terms',v.retention_terms)
    AND c.id=(SELECT chosen.id FROM clinic_app.providers_providercapability chosen
      WHERE chosen.key='object_storage_media'
       AND (chosen.clinic_id IS NULL OR chosen.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
      ORDER BY chosen.clinic_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'recording capability denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO s FROM clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession WHERE id=NEW.session_id;
 IF s.id IS NULL OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.organization_id
  OR NOT clinic_app.scribe_assigned(s.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'recording authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_captureepoch' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF s.state<>'recording' OR NEW.number<>s.epoch OR NEW.number<1
    OR NEW.number<>coalesce((SELECT max(number)+1
      FROM clinic_app.scribe_captureepoch WHERE session_id=s.id),1)
    OR NEW.ended_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reason<>''
    OR NEW.high_water<>'{}'::jsonb OR NEW.gaps<>'{}'::jsonb
    OR token IS DISTINCT FROM s.token_digest THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid capture epoch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.started_at:=statement_timestamp();

   OR NEW.token_digest !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN

function scribe_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE s clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession; e clinic_app.ehr_encounter;
 p clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment; ep clinic_app.scribe_captureepoch;
 token text; item record; valid boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'recording history is retained' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 token:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.scribe_token',true),'');
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_recordingsession' THEN
  SELECT * INTO e FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter WHERE id=NEW.encounter_id;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment
   WHERE id=NEW.enrollment_id;
  IF e.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL
   OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.physician_id)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.physician_id)
   OR (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id,p.patient_id)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.patient_id)
   OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM
     NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
   OR NEW.physician_id IS DISTINCT FROM
     NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
   OR NOT clinic_app.ehr_assigned(NEW.encounter_id)
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
   OR NEW.token_digest !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'recording authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.state<>'created' OR NEW.epoch<>0 OR NEW.revision<>1
    OR NEW.discarded OR NEW.stopped_at IS NOT NULL OR e.state<>'open'
    OR NEW.token_digest IS DISTINCT FROM token THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid recording binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp();
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-
    ARRAY['state','epoch','revision','discarded','stopped_at','token_digest'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-
    ARRAY['state','epoch','revision','discarded','stopped_at','token_digest'])
    OR OLD.state NOT IN ('created','authorized','recording','paused')
    OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR (OLD.discarded AND NOT NEW.discarded)
    OR (OLD.state,NEW.state) NOT IN (
     ('created','authorized'),('authorized','recording'),
     ('recording','paused'),('paused','recording'),
     ('authorized','paused'),('paused','paused'),
     ('created','stopped'),('authorized','stopped'),('recording','stopped'),
     ('paused','stopped'),('created','stopped_revoked'),
     ('authorized','stopped_revoked'),('recording','stopped_revoked'),
     ('paused','stopped_revoked'))
    OR (NEW.state='recording' AND NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch+1)
    OR (NEW.state<>'recording' AND NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch)
    OR (NEW.state NOT IN ('stopped','stopped_revoked')
      AND (NEW.stopped_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.discarded
       OR NEW.token_digest IS DISTINCT FROM token))

function ai_budget_usage(text).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_budget_usage(requested_purpose text)
 RETURNS TABLE(total_micros numeric, purpose_micros numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN status='reserved'
   THEN reserved_micros ELSE cost_micros END),0),
 coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN purpose=requested_purpose THEN
   CASE WHEN status='reserved' THEN reserved_micros ELSE cost_micros END
   ELSE 0 END),0)
 FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation
 WHERE organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND (status='reserved' OR
  coalesce(settled_at,created_at)>=
  date_trunc('month',statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
$function$
"

function ai_policy_valid(jsonb).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_policy_valid(policy jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE item record; p text;
BEGIN
 IF policy='{}'::jsonb THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(policy)<>'object'
 OR policy-ARRAY['enabled','purposes','monthly_budget_micros','purpose_budgets']
   <>'{}'::jsonb
 OR NOT policy ?& ARRAY['enabled','purposes','monthly_budget_micros',
   'purpose_budgets']
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'enabled')<>'boolean'
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'purposes')<>'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'purpose_budgets')<>'object'
 OR policy->>'monthly_budget_micros' !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$'
 OR (policy->>'monthly_budget_micros')::numeric>1000000000000000
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(policy->'purposes') x
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'string')
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes'))
 <> (SELECT count(DISTINCT x) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes') x)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 FOR p IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes') LOOP
  IF p<>ALL(ARRAY['scribe_asr','scribe_draft','brief','extraction',
   'front_desk','analyst','decision_support'])
  OR NOT (policy->'purpose_budgets') ? p THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_each(policy->'purpose_budgets') LOOP
  IF item.key<>ALL(ARRAY['scribe_asr','scribe_draft','brief','extraction',
   'front_desk','analyst','decision_support'])
  OR jsonb_typeof(item.value)<>'number'
  OR item.value::text !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$'
  OR item.value::numeric>1000000000000000 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_typeof(policy->'monthly_budget_micros')='number';
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range
 OR invalid_parameter_value THEN RETURN false;
END $function$
"

function ai_staff(uuid, text, uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_staff(clinic uuid, purpose text, enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE purpose
 WHEN 'front_desk' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.read',clinic,NULL)
 WHEN 'analyst' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('charge.read',clinic,NULL)
 WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'brief' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'extraction' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'decision_support' THEN
  clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 ELSE false END
$function$
"
function ai_staff(uuid, text, uuid).prosrc:
"
 SELECT CASE purpose
 WHEN 'front_desk' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.read',clinic,NULL)
 WHEN 'analyst' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('charge.read',clinic,NULL)
 WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'brief' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)

 ELSE false END
"

function scribe_asr_allowed(uuid, uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_asr_allowed(requested_session uuid, acceptance uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession s
  JOIN clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance a ON a.id=acceptance
  JOIN clinic_app.consent_consenttext t ON t.id=a.text_id
  WHERE s.id=requested_session AND NOT s.discarded
   AND clinic_app.scribe_assigned(s.id)
   AND clinic_app.scribe_consent(
    s.consent_id,s.clinic_id,s.enrollment_id,s.encounter_id)
   AND (a.organization_id,a.clinic_id,a.enrollment_id)
     =(s.organization_id,s.clinic_id,s.enrollment_id)
   AND t.purpose='ai_assistance'
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentrevocation r
    WHERE r.acceptance_id=a.id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consenttext newer
    WHERE newer.clinic_id=t.clinic_id AND newer.purpose=t.purpose
     AND newer.version>t.version))
$function$
"

function scribe_asr_consent_fence().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_asr_consent_fence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE org uuid; purpose text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='consent_consenttext' THEN
  org:=NEW.organization_id; purpose:=NEW.purpose;
 ELSE
  SELECT a.organization_id,t.purpose INTO org,purpose
   FROM clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance a
   JOIN clinic_app.consent_consenttext t ON t.id=a.text_id
   WHERE a.id=NEW.acceptance_id;
 END IF;
 IF purpose IN ('ai_assistance','consultation_recording') THEN
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
   'clinic-lock-v1:comms-subject:ai-organization:'||org,0));
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function scribe_transcript_coverage(uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_transcript_coverage(requested_session uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'epoch_id',ep.id,'track',track.key,'sequence',positions.sequence_number,
  'chunk_id',CASE WHEN c.state='accepted' THEN c.id ELSE NULL END)
  ORDER BY ep.number,track.key,positions.sequence_number),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM clinic_app.scribe_captureepoch ep
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(ep.high_water) track
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0,(track.value::text)::integer)
  AS positions(sequence_number)
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.scribe_audiochunk c
  ON c.epoch_id=ep.id AND c.track=track.key AND c.seq=positions.sequence_number
 WHERE ep.session_id=requested_session
  AND clinic_app.scribe_assigned(requested_session)
$function$
"

"

  ORDER BY ep.number,track.key,positions.sequence_number),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM clinic_app.scribe_captureepoch ep

function prescription_item_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.prescription_item_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondraft d
   WHERE d.id=NEW.draft_id AND d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
     AND d.version=NEW.version AND d.state='draft')
   OR btrim(NEW.medication_description)='' OR btrim(NEW.strength_form)=''
   OR btrim(NEW.dose)='' OR btrim(NEW.route)='' OR btrim(NEW.frequency)=''
   OR btrim(NEW.duration)='' OR btrim(NEW.quantity)='' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid prescription item binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function intake_duplicate_transition_gua.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.intake_duplicate_transition_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF (NEW.id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_a_id,
        NEW.enrollment_b_id,NEW.signals,NEW.created_at)
       IS DISTINCT FROM
       (OLD.id,OLD.organization_id,OLD.clinic_id,OLD.enrollment_a_id,
        OLD.enrollment_b_id,OLD.signals,OLD.created_at)
       OR OLD.state<>'open' OR NEW.state NOT IN ('dismissed','merged')
       OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_mergedecision d
           WHERE d.candidate_id=OLD.id AND d.organization_id=OLD.organization_id
             AND d.created_at=transaction_timestamp()
             AND NEW.state=CASE d.decision WHEN 'merge' THEN 'merged' ELSE
                 'dismissed' END
             AND clinic_app.intake_merge_authorized(d.clinic_id,d.verified_session_id)
       )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',
            MESSAGE='duplicate candidate transition is invalid';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"
