function intake_merge_authorized(uuid, u.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.intake_merge_authorized(requested_clinic uuid, requested_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    actor_text text := current_setting('app.current_user_id',true);
    tenant_text text := current_setting('app.current_tenant',true);
    session_text text := current_setting('app.current_merge_session',true);
BEGIN
    IF actor_text IS NULL OR tenant_text IS NULL
       OR actor_text !~*
           '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
       OR tenant_text !~*
           '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
       OR session_text IS NULL OR session_text !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NOT NULL
       OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session',true),'') IS NOT NULL
    THEN RETURN false; END IF;
    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_sessionrecord s
        JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r ON r.user_id=s.user_id
        JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=r.clinic_id
        WHERE s.id=requested_session AND s.user_id=actor_text::uuid
          AND encode(s.session_key_hash,'hex')=session_text
          AND r.clinic_id=requested_clinic AND r.organization_id=tenant_text::uuid
          AND c.organization_id=r.organization_id
          AND r.role IN ('clinic_manager','physician','clinic_admin','owner')
          AND clinic_app.has_permission('demographics.read',requested_clinic,NULL)
          AND clinic_app.identity_session_verified(s.session_key_hash)
    );
END
$function$
"

function intake_merge_decision_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.intake_merge_decision_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    candidate clinic_app.intake_duplicatecandidate;
    first_patient uuid;
    second_patient uuid;
    locked_patient uuid;
    verified_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO candidate FROM clinic_app.intake_duplicatecandidate
    WHERE id=NEW.candidate_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id
      AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF candidate.id IS NULL OR candidate.state<>'open'
       OR NEW.adjudicator_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting
           ('app.current_user_id',true)
       OR NOT clinic_app.intake_merge_authorized(NEW.clinic_id,NEW.verified_session_id)
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',
            MESSAGE='duplicate adjudication authority required';
    END IF;
    SELECT e.patient_id INTO first_patient
    FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e WHERE
        e.id=candidate.enrollment_a_id;
    SELECT e.patient_id INTO second_patient
    FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e WHERE
        e.id=candidate.enrollment_b_id;
    SELECT s.verified_at INTO verified_at FROM clinic_app.identity_sessionrecord s
    WHERE s.id=NEW.verified_session_id;
    IF NEW.merged_patient_id NOT IN (first_patient,second_patient)
       OR NEW.survivor_patient_id NOT IN (first_patient,second_patient)
       OR NEW.merged_patient_id=NEW.survivor_patient_id
       OR NEW.step_up_verified_at IS DISTINCT FROM verified_at
       OR NEW.merged_version IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE((
           SELECT max(v.version) FROM clinic_app.intake_patientdemographics v
           WHERE v.patient_id=NEW.merged_patient_id AND
               v.organization_id=NEW.organization_id),0)
       OR NEW.survivor_version IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE((
           SELECT max(v.version) FROM clinic_app.intake_patientdemographics v
           WHERE v.patient_id=NEW.survivor_patient_id AND
               v.organization_id=NEW.organization_id),0)
       OR NEW.reason IS NULL OR NEW.field_choices IS NULL
       OR NEW.decision NOT IN ('merge','dismiss')
       OR (NEW.decision='merge' AND NEW.result_version IS DISTINCT FROM
           NEW.survivor_version+1)
       OR (NEW.decision='dismiss' AND NEW.result_version IS NOT NULL)
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',
            MESSAGE='duplicate adjudication binding is invalid';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.decision='merge' THEN
        FOR locked_patient IN
            SELECT patient_id
            FROM unnest(ARRAY[first_patient,second_patient]) patient_id
            ORDER BY patient_id
        LOOP
            PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
                'intake-alias-write-v1:'||NEW.organization_id::text||':'||
                    locked_patient::text,0
            ));
        END LOOP;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.decision='merge' AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias a
        WHERE a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.active
          AND a.merged_patient_id IN (NEW.merged_patient_id,NEW.survivor_patient_id)
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',MESSAGE='patient_aliased';
    END IF;
    NEW.created_at := transaction_timestamp();
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function intake_merge_receipt_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.intake_merge_receipt_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_duplicatecandidate c
        WHERE c.id=NEW.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
          AND c.state=CASE NEW.decision WHEN 'merge' THEN 'merged' ELSE 'dismissed' END
    ) OR (NEW.decision='merge' AND (
        NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias a WHERE
            a.merge_decision_id=NEW.id)

            SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientdemographics v
            JOIN clinic_app.intake_demographicscorrection r ON r.demographics_id=v.id

    ))
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',
            MESSAGE='duplicate adjudication requires its receipts';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END

function intake_patient_alias_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.intake_patient_alias_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    decision clinic_app.intake_mergedecision;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO decision FROM clinic_app.intake_mergedecision
    WHERE id=NEW.merge_decision_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
    IF decision.id IS NULL OR decision.decision<>'merge'
       OR (NEW.merged_patient_id,NEW.survivor_patient_id)
          IS DISTINCT FROM (decision.merged_patient_id,decision.survivor_patient_id)
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',
            MESSAGE='patient alias binding is invalid';
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
        IF NOT NEW.active OR NEW.deactivated_at IS NOT NULL
           OR NEW.deactivated_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.deactivation_session_id IS
               NOT NULL
           OR NEW.deactivation_reason IS NOT NULL
           OR decision.created_at<>transaction_timestamp()
           OR NOT clinic_app.intake_merge_authorized(decision.clinic_id,
               decision.verified_session_id)
           OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias a
                      WHERE a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.active
                        AND a.merged_patient_id IN (NEW.merged_patient_id,
                            NEW.survivor_patient_id))
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',
                MESSAGE='patient alias transition is invalid';
        END IF;
        NEW.created_at := transaction_timestamp();
    ELSE
        IF (NEW.id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.merged_patient_id,NEW.survivor_patient_id,
            NEW.merge_decision_id,NEW.created_at)
           IS DISTINCT FROM
           (OLD.id,OLD.organization_id,OLD.merged_patient_id,OLD.survivor_patient_id,
            OLD.merge_decision_id,OLD.created_at)
           OR NOT OLD.active OR NEW.active
           OR NEW.deactivation_reason IS NULL
           OR NEW.deactivated_by_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting
               ('app.current_user_id',true)
           OR NOT clinic_app.intake_merge_authorized(decision.clinic_id,
               NEW.deactivation_session_id)
        THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',
                MESSAGE='patient alias transition is invalid';
        END IF;
        NEW.deactivated_at := transaction_timestamp();
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function patient_alias_set(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.patient_alias_set(requested_patient uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(patient_id uuid, survivor_patient_id uuid, unified_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    requested_org uuid;
    tenant_text text := current_setting('app.current_tenant',true);
    actor_text text := current_setting('app.current_user_id',true);
    patient_session_text text := current_setting('app.current_patient_session',true);
BEGIN
    IF NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NOT NULL
    THEN RETURN; END IF;
    IF NULLIF(tenant_text,'') IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF NULLIF(patient_session_text,'') IS NOT NULL OR actor_text IS NULL
           OR actor_text !~*
               '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
           OR tenant_text !~*
               '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
        THEN RETURN; END IF;
        SELECT p.organization_id INTO requested_org
        FROM clinic_app.intake_patient p
        WHERE p.id=requested_patient AND p.organization_id=tenant_text::uuid
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
              JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r ON r.clinic_id=e.clinic_id
              JOIN clinic_app.identity_user u ON u.id=r.user_id AND u.is_active
              WHERE e.patient_id=p.id AND e.organization_id=p.organization_id
                AND r.organization_id=p.organization_id AND r.user_id=actor_text::uuid
          );
    ELSE
        IF patient_session_text IS NULL
           OR patient_session_text !~*
               '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
           OR NULLIF(actor_text,'') IS NOT NULL
        THEN RETURN; END IF;
        SELECT s.organization_id INTO requested_org
        FROM clinic_app.current_patient_authority(NULL) s
        WHERE s.session_id=patient_session_text::uuid
          AND s.patient_id=requested_patient;
    END IF;
    IF requested_org IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH RECURSIVE forward AS (
        SELECT requested_patient AS id
        UNION
        SELECT a.survivor_patient_id FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias a
        JOIN forward f ON f.id=a.merged_patient_id
        WHERE a.active AND a.organization_id=requested_org
    ), root AS (
        SELECT f.id FROM forward f WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias a
            WHERE a.active AND a.organization_id=requested_org
              AND a.merged_patient_id=f.id
        )
    ), members AS (
        SELECT r.id FROM root r
        UNION
        SELECT a.merged_patient_id FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias a
        JOIN members m ON m.id=a.survivor_patient_id
        WHERE a.active AND a.organization_id=requested_org
    )
    SELECT m.id, r.id,
        (SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias a
         WHERE a.active AND a.organization_id=requested_org
           AND a.merged_patient_id IN (SELECT lineage.id FROM members lineage))
    FROM members m CROSS JOIN root r ORDER BY m.id;
END
$function$
"

function ehr_copy_finalization_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ehr_copy_finalization_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.state='finalized' AND OLD.state='draft' AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_copiednoteblock b WHERE b.target_id=NEW.id
 AND (b.reviewed_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.revision
      OR b.reviewed_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.author_id)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'copied_blocks_unreviewed' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function ehr_timeline_enqueue().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ehr_timeline_enqueue()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE scope_row record;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ehr_clinicaldocumentversion' THEN
   SELECT e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.patient_id INTO scope_row
   FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d
   JOIN clinic_app.ehr_encounter e ON e.id=d.encounter_id WHERE d.id=NEW.document_id;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ehr_episodeencounter' THEN
   SELECT organization_id,clinic_id,patient_id INTO scope_row
   FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter WHERE id=NEW.encounter_id;
 ELSE
   SELECT NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.patient_id INTO scope_row;
 END IF;
 IF scope_row.organization_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment p
  WHERE p.organization_id=scope_row.organization_id
  AND p.clinic_id=scope_row.clinic_id AND p.patient_id=scope_row.patient_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid projection scope' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO clinic_app.ehr_timelinerefresh
 (id,organization_id,clinic_id,patient_id,revision,refreshed_revision,refreshed_at)
 VALUES (gen_random_uuid(),scope_row.organization_id,scope_row.clinic_id,
 scope_row.patient_id,1,0,NULL)
 ON CONFLICT (clinic_id,patient_id) DO UPDATE
 SET revision=ehr_timelinerefresh.revision+1;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function ehr_timeline_refresh(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ehr_timeline_refresh(requested_refresh uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE q clinic_app.ehr_timelinerefresh;
BEGIN
 IF NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL
 OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'') IS NOT NULL
 OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session',true),'') IS NOT NULL
 OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
   RETURN false;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO q FROM clinic_app.ehr_timelinerefresh WHERE id=requested_refresh
 AND revision>refreshed_revision FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
 IF q.id IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 INSERT INTO clinic_app.ehr_timelineprojection
 (id,organization_id,clinic_id,patient_id,source_id,kind,effective_at,provenance,
 source_revision,encounter_id,episode_id)
 SELECT gen_random_uuid(),s.organization_id,s.clinic_id,s.patient_id,s.source_id,
 s.kind,s.effective_at,s.provenance,s.source_revision,s.encounter_id,s.episode_id
 FROM (
 SELECT m.id source_id, 'medication'::varchar kind, m.organization_id,m.clinic_id,
 m.patient_id,m.effective_at,m.provenance,m.revision source_revision,
 NULL::uuid encounter_id,NULL::uuid episode_id FROM clinic_app.ehr_medicationstatement m
 UNION ALL
 SELECT o.id,'observation',o.organization_id,o.clinic_id,o.patient_id,o.effective_at,
 o.provenance,o.revision,NULL,NULL FROM clinic_app.ehr_observation o
 UNION ALL
 SELECT v.id,'note',e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.patient_id,
 coalesce(v.finalized_at,v.created_at),
 CASE WHEN v.state IN ('finalized','superseded') THEN 'clinician_confirmed'
 ELSE 'observed' END,v.revision,e.id,l.episode_id
 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.id=v.document_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_encounter e ON e.id=d.encounter_id
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.ehr_episodeencounter l ON l.encounter_id=e.id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.id,'encounter',e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.patient_id,e.created_at,
 'observed',e.revision,e.id,l.episode_id FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter e
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.ehr_episodeencounter l ON l.encounter_id=e.id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT a.id,'addendum',a.organization_id,a.clinic_id,a.patient_id,a.updated_at,
 'observed',a.revision,a.encounter_id,l.episode_id
 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounteraddendum a
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.ehr_episodeencounter l ON l.encounter_id=a.encounter_id
) s WHERE s.organization_id=q.organization_id
 AND s.clinic_id=q.clinic_id AND s.patient_id=q.patient_id
 ON CONFLICT (kind,source_id) DO UPDATE SET
 effective_at=excluded.effective_at,provenance=excluded.provenance,
 source_revision=excluded.source_revision,encounter_id=excluded.encounter_id,
 episode_id=excluded.episode_id
 WHERE (ehr_timelineprojection.organization_id,ehr_timelineprojection.clinic_id,
        ehr_timelineprojection.patient_id) =

 UPDATE clinic_app.ehr_timelinerefresh SET refreshed_revision=q.revision,
 refreshed_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=q.id;
 RETURN true;
END $function$
"
function ehr_timeline_refresh(uuid).prosrc:
"
DECLARE q clinic_app.ehr_timelinerefresh;
BEGIN
 IF NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL
 OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'') IS NOT NULL
 OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session',true),'') IS NOT NULL
 OR NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
   RETURN false;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO q FROM clinic_app.ehr_timelinerefresh WHERE id=requested_refresh
 AND revision>refreshed_revision FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
 IF q.id IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 INSERT INTO clinic_app.ehr_timelineprojection
 (id,organization_id,clinic_id,patient_id,source_id,kind,effective_at,provenance,
 source_revision,encounter_id,episode_id)
 SELECT gen_random_uuid(),s.organization_id,s.clinic_id,s.patient_id,s.source_id,
 s.kind,s.effective_at,s.provenance,s.source_revision,s.encounter_id,s.episode_id
 FROM (
 SELECT m.id source_id, 'medication'::varchar kind, m.organization_id,m.clinic_id,
 m.patient_id,m.effective_at,m.provenance,m.revision source_revision,
 NULL::uuid encounter_id,NULL::uuid episode_id FROM clinic_app.ehr_medicationstatement m
 UNION ALL
 SELECT o.id,'observation',o.organization_id,o.clinic_id,o.patient_id,o.effective_at,
 o.provenance,o.revision,NULL,NULL FROM clinic_app.ehr_observation o
 UNION ALL
 SELECT v.id,'note',e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.patient_id,
 coalesce(v.finalized_at,v.created_at),
 CASE WHEN v.state IN ('finalized','superseded') THEN 'clinician_confirmed'
 ELSE 'observed' END,v.revision,e.id,l.episode_id
 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.id=v.document_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_encounter e ON e.id=d.encounter_id
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.ehr_episodeencounter l ON l.encounter_id=e.id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.id,'encounter',e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,e.patient_id,e.created_at,
 'observed',e.revision,e.id,l.episode_id FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter e
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.ehr_episodeencounter l ON l.encounter_id=e.id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT a.id,'addendum',a.organization_id,a.clinic_id,a.patient_id,a.updated_at,
 'observed',a.revision,a.encounter_id,l.episode_id
 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounteraddendum a
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.ehr_episodeencounter l ON l.encounter_id=a.encounter_id
) s WHERE s.organization_id=q.organization_id
 AND s.clinic_id=q.clinic_id AND s.patient_id=q.patient_id
 ON CONFLICT (kind,source_id) DO UPDATE SET
 effective_at=excluded.effective_at,provenance=excluded.provenance,
 source_revision=excluded.source_revision,encounter_id=excluded.encounter_id,
 episode_id=excluded.episode_id
 WHERE (ehr_timelineprojection.organization_id,ehr_timelineprojection.clinic_id,
        ehr_timelineprojection.patient_id) =
       (excluded.organization_id,excluded.clinic_id,excluded.patient_id);
 UPDATE clinic_app.ehr_timelinerefresh SET refreshed_revision=q.revision,
 refreshed_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=q.id;
 RETURN true;
END "

function ehr_timeline_visible(text, uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ehr_timeline_visible(source_kind text, source uuid, requested_clinic uuid, requested_patient uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE source_kind
 WHEN 'observation' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_observation o
  WHERE o.id=source AND o.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND o.clinic_id=requested_clinic AND o.patient_id=requested_patient
  AND (clinic_app.ehr_patient_permission('clinical.read',o.clinic_id,o.patient_id)
   OR clinic_app.ehr_patient_permission('observation.write',o.clinic_id,o.patient_id)))
 WHEN 'medication' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_medicationstatement m
  WHERE m.id=source AND m.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND m.clinic_id=requested_clinic AND m.patient_id=requested_patient
  AND clinic_app.ehr_patient_permission('clinical.read',m.clinic_id,m.patient_id))
 WHEN 'note' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
  JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.id=v.document_id
  JOIN clinic_app.ehr_encounter e ON e.id=d.encounter_id
  WHERE v.id=source AND e.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND e.clinic_id=requested_clinic AND e.patient_id=requested_patient
  AND clinic_app.ehr_patient_permission('clinical.read',e.clinic_id,e.patient_id)
  AND clinic_app.ehr_note_visible(d.id)
  AND ((v.state='draft' AND v.author_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid AND clinic_app.ehr_assigned(e.id))
   OR (v.state IN ('finalized','superseded')
     AND (clinic_app.ehr_assigned(e.id) OR clinic_app.ehr_care(e.id)))))
 WHEN 'encounter' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter e
  WHERE e.id=source AND e.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND e.clinic_id=requested_clinic AND e.patient_id=requested_patient
  AND clinic_app.ehr_patient_permission('clinical.read',e.clinic_id,e.patient_id))
 WHEN 'addendum' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounteraddendum a
  WHERE a.id=source AND a.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND a.clinic_id=requested_clinic AND a.patient_id=requested_patient
  AND a.author_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  AND clinic_app.ehr_patient_permission('clinical.read',a.clinic_id,a.patient_id))
 ELSE false END
$function$
"

function orders_audit_scope(uuid, text).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_audit_scope(record_id uuid, event_name text)
 RETURNS TABLE(principal_id uuid, organization_id uuid, clinic_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT a.principal_id,a.organization_id,a.clinic_id
 FROM clinic_app.orders_labaccount a WHERE
 a.id=clinic_app.orders_lab_account(a.clinic_id) AND (
 event_name IN ('orders.result.ingested','orders.result.matched',
  'orders.result.quarantined') AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion v
 WHERE v.id=record_id AND v.lab_account_id=a.id)
 OR event_name='orders.task.created' AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultworkitem w
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultversion v ON v.id=w.version_id
 WHERE w.task_id=record_id AND v.lab_account_id=a.id))
$function$
"

function orders_can_read_version(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_can_read_version(version uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion v
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m ON m.version_id=v.id
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.id=coalesce(m.order_id,v.proposed_order_id)
 WHERE v.id=version AND v.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND (
 clinic_app.has_permission('order.route',v.clinic_id,NULL)
 OR ((m.id IS NOT NULL OR v.uploader_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid)
 AND o.clinic_id=v.clinic_id AND o.organization_id=v.organization_id
 AND (m.id IS NULL OR (
 m.clinic_id=v.clinic_id AND m.organization_id=v.organization_id))
 AND clinic_app.has_permission('result.read',v.clinic_id,o.enrollment_id))))
$function$
"

 AND g.state='active' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
 AND g.expires_at>statement_timestamp()

function orders_emit_task().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_emit_task()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v clinic_app.orders_resultversion; task uuid:=gen_random_uuid();
 task_kind text; clinician uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r WHERE r.id=NEW.version_id;
 task_kind:=CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultmatch'
  THEN 'review' ELSE 'quarantine' END;
 IF task_kind='review' THEN
  SELECT o.ordered_by_id INTO clinician FROM clinic_app.orders_order o
  WHERE o.id=NEW.order_id;
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO clinic_app.orders_resultworkitem
 (id,organization_id,clinic_id,created_at,version_id,task_id,kind)
 VALUES(gen_random_uuid(),v.organization_id,v.clinic_id,statement_timestamp(),
 v.id,task,task_kind);
 INSERT INTO clinic_app.workflows_task
 (id,organization_id,clinic_id,kind,subject_ref,created_by_id,owner_user_id,
 owner_role,due_at,priority,state,escalation_policy_version,escalated_at,
 depends_on_id,completion_evidence,revision,idempotency_key,fingerprint,
 last_command_key,last_command_digest,created_at,updated_at)
 VALUES(task,v.organization_id,v.clinic_id,'review',
 jsonb_build_object('kind','clinic','id',v.clinic_id::text),NULL,clinician,
 CASE WHEN task_kind='quarantine' THEN 'receptionist' ELSE '' END,
 v.created_at,CASE WHEN v.critical THEN 'urgent'
 WHEN task_kind='quarantine' THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END,
 'assigned',1,NULL,NULL,'{}',1,task,encode(clinic_app.digest(
 'orders-task:'||v.id::text||':'||task_kind,'sha256'),'hex'),
 NULL,'',statement_timestamp(),statement_timestamp());
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function orders_event_receipt(uuid, uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_event_receipt(clinic uuid, event uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(result_id uuid, version_id uuid, number integer, state text, fingerprint text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v clinic_app.orders_resultversion; requested_order uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r WHERE r.event_id=event
 AND r.clinic_id=clinic AND r.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 IF v.id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT m.order_id INTO requested_order FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m
 WHERE m.version_id=v.id;
 IF NOT clinic_app.orders_ingest_allowed(
 clinic,coalesce(requested_order,v.proposed_order_id))
 OR (clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic) IS NOT NULL
 AND v.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'result denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT v.result_id,v.id,v.number,
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultrelease r
 WHERE r.version_id=v.id) THEN 'released'
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultacknowledgment r
 WHERE r.version_id=v.id) THEN 'acknowledged'
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m
 WHERE m.version_id=v.id) THEN 'matched'
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultrejection r
 WHERE r.version_id=v.id) THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'quarantined' END,v.fingerprint::text;
END $function$
"

function orders_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE o clinic_app.orders_order; v clinic_app.orders_resultversion;
 previous clinic_app.orders_orderevent; matched clinic_app.orders_resultmatch;
 enrollment uuid; permission text; valid boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_labaccount' AND TG_OP='UPDATE'
  AND session_user='clinic_owner' AND current_setting('role')<>'clinic_app'
  AND OLD.active AND NOT NEW.active AND
  (to_jsonb(NEW)-'active')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'active') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'order/result history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid result scope' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
 WHEN 'orders_labaccount' THEN
  IF session_user<>'clinic_owner' OR current_setting('role')='clinic_app'
  OR NEW.provider<>'synthetic-lab-v1' OR NEW.signing_key_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_serviceprincipal p
   WHERE p.id=NEW.principal_id AND p.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.active AND p.purpose='lab_ingest')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid lab account' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_order' THEN
  IF NEW.ordered_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('order.place',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
  WHERE e.id=NEW.enrollment_id AND e.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
  AND e.organization_id=NEW.organization_id)
  OR NEW.fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR (NEW.lab_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_labaccount a
  WHERE a.id=NEW.lab_account_id AND a.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
  AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.active))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'order denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_orderitem', 'orders_orderevent' THEN
  SELECT * INTO o FROM clinic_app.orders_order r WHERE r.id=NEW.order_id
  AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF o.id IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission(
  'order.place',NEW.clinic_id,o.enrollment_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'order denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||o.id,0));
  SELECT * INTO previous FROM clinic_app.orders_orderevent e
   WHERE e.order_id=o.id ORDER BY e.sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_orderitem' THEN
   IF previous.state IS NOT NULL OR NEW.catalog_version<>1
   OR NEW.exam_code NOT IN ('cbc','urinalysis') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'order items immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE

    (previous.id IS NULL AND NEW.state='draft') OR

   WHERE r.result_id=NEW.result_id ORDER BY r.number DESC LIMIT 1;

   WHERE m.version_id=v.id;
  IF NEW.number<>coalesce(v.number,0)+1 OR NEW.predecessor_id IS DISTINCT FROM v.id

   coalesce(matched.order_id,v.proposed_order_id)
   OR NEW.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM v.lab_account_id))
  OR NEW.storage_key!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR NEW.sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

  OR NEW.content_type NOT IN ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png')

 WHEN 'orders_resultobservation' THEN
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r WHERE r.id=NEW.version_id;
  IF v.clinic_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.clinic_id
  OR v.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id
  OR NOT clinic_app.orders_ingest_allowed(NEW.clinic_id,v.proposed_order_id)
  OR v.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM clinic_app.orders_lab_account(NEW.clinic_id)
  OR v.uploader_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR octet_length(NEW.source)<68
  OR NEW.position<>(SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.orders_resultobservation r
    WHERE r.version_id=v.id)

  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultquarantine q WHERE q.version_id=v.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid source observation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r WHERE r.id=NEW.version_id;

  OR v.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid result scope' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('orders_resultacknowledgment','orders_resultrelease',
    'orders_resultrejection') THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||v.result_id,0));
   IF NOT clinic_app.orders_is_current(v.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'source superseded' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;

   SELECT r.enrollment_id INTO enrollment FROM clinic_app.orders_order r
    WHERE r.id=matched.order_id;
   IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultrejection' THEN
    valid:=clinic_app.has_permission('order.route',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     AND NEW.operator_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
     AND matched.id IS NULL AND NEW.evidence_code IN (
      'wrong_patient_confirmed','invalid_source_confirmed')
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultquarantine q
       WHERE q.version_id=v.id);
   ELSE
    permission:=CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultacknowledgment'
     THEN 'result.acknowledge' ELSE 'result.release' END;
    valid:=matched.id IS NOT NULL AND
     clinic_app.has_permission(permission,NEW.clinic_id,enrollment);
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultacknowledgment' THEN
     valid:=valid AND NEW.reviewer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
      AND NEW.disposition IN ('no_action','follow_up','urgent_review');
    ELSE
     valid:=valid AND NEW.released_by_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultacknowledgment a
       WHERE a.id=NEW.acknowledgment_id AND a.version_id=v.id)

       OR (NEW.audience='delegate' AND clinic_app.orders_delegate_allowed(
        v.id,NEW.delegate_grant_id)));
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF valid IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'result action denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  END IF;
 END CASE;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
 WHERE c.id=clinic AND c.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid) AND (
 clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic) IS NOT NULL AND
 (requested_order IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_order o
 WHERE o.id=requested_order AND o.clinic_id=clinic AND o.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND o.lab_account_id=clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic)))

 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_order o WHERE o.id=requested_order
 AND o.clinic_id=clinic AND o.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND clinic_app.has_permission('order.place',clinic,o.enrollment_id)))
$function$
"

function orders_ingest_scope(uuid, uuid,.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_ingest_scope(clinic uuid, requested_order uuid, result uuid, predecessor uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(organization_id uuid, lab_account_id uuid, number integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid,clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic),
 CASE WHEN predecessor IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE (
 SELECT v.number+1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion v WHERE v.id=predecessor
 AND v.result_id=result AND v.clinic_id=clinic AND v.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND coalesce((SELECT m.order_id FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m
 WHERE m.version_id=v.id),v.proposed_order_id) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM requested_order
 AND (clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic) IS NULL
 OR v.lab_account_id=clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic))
 AND clinic_app.orders_is_current(v.id)) END
 WHERE clinic_app.orders_ingest_allowed(clinic,requested_order)
 AND ((result IS NULL AND predecessor IS NULL) OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion v WHERE v.id=predecessor
 AND v.result_id=result AND v.clinic_id=clinic AND v.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND coalesce((SELECT m.order_id FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m
 WHERE m.version_id=v.id),v.proposed_order_id) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM requested_order
 AND (clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic) IS NULL
 OR v.lab_account_id=clinic_app.orders_lab_account(clinic))
 AND clinic_app.orders_is_current(v.id)))
$function$

function orders_patient_sources(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_patient_sources(requested_version uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(version_id uuid, number integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, storage_key text, sha256 text, size_bytes integer, content_type text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT v.id,v.number,v.created_at,v.storage_key::text,v.sha256::text,
 v.size_bytes,v.content_type::text
 FROM clinic_app.current_patient_authority('records') a
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.enrollment_id=a.enrollment_id
 AND o.organization_id=a.organization_id AND o.clinic_id=a.clinic_id
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m ON m.order_id=o.id
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultversion v ON v.id=m.version_id
 WHERE (requested_version IS NULL OR v.id=requested_version)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion newer
 WHERE newer.result_id=v.result_id AND newer.number>v.number)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultrelease r
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultacknowledgment ack
 ON ack.id=r.acknowledgment_id AND ack.version_id=v.id
 WHERE r.version_id=v.id AND (
 (a.delegate_grant_id IS NULL AND r.audience='patient') OR
 (a.delegate_grant_id IS NOT NULL AND r.audience='delegate'
  AND r.delegate_grant_id=a.delegate_grant_id

function orders_patient_sources(uuid).prosrc:
"
 SELECT v.id,v.number,v.created_at,v.storage_key::text,v.sha256::text,
 v.size_bytes,v.content_type::text
 FROM clinic_app.current_patient_authority('records') a
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.enrollment_id=a.enrollment_id
 AND o.organization_id=a.organization_id AND o.clinic_id=a.clinic_id
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m ON m.order_id=o.id
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultversion v ON v.id=m.version_id
 WHERE (requested_version IS NULL OR v.id=requested_version)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion newer
 WHERE newer.result_id=v.result_id AND newer.number>v.number)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultrelease r
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultacknowledgment ack
 ON ack.id=r.acknowledgment_id AND ack.version_id=v.id
 WHERE r.version_id=v.id AND (
 (a.delegate_grant_id IS NULL AND r.audience='patient') OR
 (a.delegate_grant_id IS NOT NULL AND r.audience='delegate'
  AND r.delegate_grant_id=a.delegate_grant_id
  AND clinic_app.orders_delegate_allowed(v.id,r.delegate_grant_id))))
 ORDER BY v.created_at DESC,v.id
"

function orders_system_task_valid(jsonb).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_system_task_valid(row_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT pg_trigger_depth()>1 AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultworkitem w
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultversion v ON v.id=w.version_id
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m ON m.version_id=v.id
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.id=m.order_id
 WHERE w.task_id=(row_data->>'id')::uuid AND w.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND (row_data-'id'-'created_at'-'updated_at')=jsonb_build_object(
  'organization_id',w.organization_id,'clinic_id',w.clinic_id,'kind','review',
  'subject_ref',jsonb_build_object('kind','clinic','id',w.clinic_id::text),
  'created_by_id',NULL,'owner_user_id',CASE WHEN w.kind='review'
   THEN o.ordered_by_id ELSE NULL END,
  'owner_role',CASE WHEN w.kind='quarantine' THEN 'receptionist' ELSE '' END,
  'due_at',v.created_at,'priority',CASE WHEN v.critical THEN 'urgent'
   WHEN w.kind='quarantine' THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END,
  'state','assigned','escalation_policy_version',1,'escalated_at',NULL,
  'depends_on_id',NULL,'completion_evidence','{}'::jsonb,'revision',1,
  'idempotency_key',w.task_id,'fingerprint',encode(clinic_app.digest(
   'orders-task:'||v.id::text||':'||w.kind,'sha256'),'hex'),
  'last_command_key',NULL,'last_command_digest',''))
$function$
"

function ehr_pack_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ehr_pack_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE p clinic_app.ehr_specialtypack; e clinic_app.ehr_encounter;
 expected_calculators jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained specialty history' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ehr_specialtypack' THEN
   IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
     PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
       'ehr-pack-use:'||OLD.id::text,0));
     IF NEW.position IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.position THEN
       IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'position') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'position')
         OR OLD.uninstalled_at IS NOT NULL THEN
         RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pack ordering' USING ERRCODE='23514';
       END IF;
       RETURN NEW;
     END IF;
     IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'uninstalled_at') IS DISTINCT FROM
        (to_jsonb(OLD)-'uninstalled_at') OR OLD.uninstalled_at IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.uninstalled_at IS NULL THEN
       RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pack transition' USING ERRCODE='23514';
     END IF;
     RETURN NEW;
   END IF;
   expected_calculators := CASE NEW.key
     WHEN 'general' THEN '[{"key":"bmi","version":1},{"key":"egfr","version":1}]'
     WHEN 'pediatrics' THEN
       '[{"key":"corrected_age","version":1},{"key":"growth_percentile","version":1}]'
     WHEN 'psychiatry' THEN '[{"key":"phq9","version":1},{"key":"gad7","version":1}]'
     WHEN 'procedures' THEN '[]' END;
   IF NEW.version<>1 OR NEW.uninstalled_at IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.calculators IS DISTINCT FROM expected_calculators
     OR NEW.license_ref<>'docs/clinical/specialty-packs.md'
     OR NEW.clinical_owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM
       NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
       WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id)
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_specialtytemplate t
       WHERE t.id=NEW.template_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
       AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
       AND t.key='pack_'||NEW.key||'_v'||NEW.version
       AND t.prompts->>'state'='published')
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_questionnairetemplate q
       WHERE q.id=NEW.questionnaire_id AND q.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
       AND q.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
       AND q.key='pack_'||NEW.key||'_v'||NEW.version) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pack binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
 ELSE
   IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable specialty entry' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended(
     'ehr-pack-use:'||NEW.pack_id::text,0));
   SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ehr_specialtypack WHERE id=NEW.pack_id;
   SELECT * INTO e FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter WHERE id=NEW.encounter_id;
   IF p.id IS NULL OR e.id IS NULL OR p.uninstalled_at IS NOT NULL
     OR e.state<>'open'
     OR (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
        (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id)
     OR (e.organization_id,e.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
        (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id)
     OR e.physician_id<>NEW.recorded_by_id
     OR (NEW.kind='immunization' AND (p.key<>'pediatrics'
       OR NEW.consent_document_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.images<>'[]'::jsonb))
     OR (NEW.kind='procedure' AND (p.key<>'procedures'
       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicalattachment a
         WHERE a.id=NEW.consent_document_id AND a.encounter_id=e.id
         AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.state='available')))
     OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.images) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
     OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.images)>20
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(NEW.images) image_id
       WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicalattachment a
         WHERE a.id::text=image_id AND a.encounter_id=e.id
         AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.state='available'
         AND a.detected_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/png'))) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid specialty entry binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function agent_approval_current(uuid, uu.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_approval_current(requested uuid, approval_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_approval a
 WHERE a.id=approval_id AND a.proposal_id=requested
 AND a.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND CASE WHEN pg_has_role(session_user,'clinic_agent','USAGE')
 THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.agent_proposal_scope(requested))
 ELSE clinic_app.agent_staff(a.clinic_id) END
 AND a.authority_snapshot=clinic_app.agent_bound_snapshot(a.clinic_id,a.approver_id,
 a.authority_snapshot->>'permission',a.organization_id))
$function$
"

function agent_audit(uuid, text, timesta.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_audit(record_id uuid, event_name text, occurred_at_utc timestamp with time zone, content_hash bytea)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE s RECORD; previous_hash bytea; inserted_seq bigint; verb text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO s FROM clinic_app.agent_audit_scope(record_id,event_name);
 IF s.principal_id IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent audit denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed'
 OR content_hash IS NULL OR octet_length(content_hash)<>32
 OR occurred_at_utc IS NULL
 OR occurred_at_utc NOT BETWEEN clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes'
  AND clock_timestamp()+interval '5 minutes' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid audit input' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 verb:=split_part(event_name,'.',3);
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
  ('clinic-audit:'||s.organization_id::text) COLLATE pg_catalog."C",0));
 SELECT a.curr_hash INTO previous_hash FROM clinic_app.audit_event a
 WHERE a.organization_id=s.organization_id ORDER BY a.seq DESC LIMIT 1;
 previous_hash:=coalesce(previous_hash,decode(repeat('00',32),'hex'));
 INSERT INTO clinic_app.audit_event
 (organization_id,actor_user_id,event_type,component_id,component_ip,
  affected_record_type,affected_record_id,occurred_at_utc,payload,prev_hash,curr_hash)
 VALUES(s.organization_id,s.principal_id,event_name,'clinic-os-worker',NULL,
 s.record_type,record_id::text,occurred_at_utc,
 jsonb_build_object('clinic_id',s.clinic_id::text,'object_verb',verb),
 previous_hash,clinic_app.digest(content_hash||previous_hash,'sha256'))
 RETURNING seq INTO inserted_seq;
 RETURN inserted_seq;
END $function$
"

function agent_audit_scope(uuid, text).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_audit_scope(record_id uuid, event_name text)
 RETURNS TABLE(organization_id uuid, clinic_id uuid, principal_id uuid, record_type text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT x.organization_id,x.clinic_id,x.principal_id,x.record_type FROM (
 SELECT p.organization_id,p.clinic_id,r.principal_id,'ai.action_proposal' AS record_type
 FROM clinic_app.ai_actionproposal p JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentrun r ON r.id=p.run_id
 WHERE p.id=record_id AND event_name='ai.action.'||p.state
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.organization_id,e.clinic_id,r.principal_id,'ai.action_execution'
 FROM clinic_app.ai_actionexecution e
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_actionproposal p ON p.id=e.proposal_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentrun r ON r.id=p.run_id
 WHERE e.id=record_id AND (event_name='ai.execution.'||e.state
 OR (event_name='ai.execution.sending' AND e.send_started_at IS NOT NULL))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT a.organization_id,a.clinic_id,r.principal_id,'ai.action_receipt'
 FROM clinic_app.ai_actionreceipt a
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_actionexecution e ON e.id=a.execution_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_actionproposal p ON p.id=e.proposal_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentrun r ON r.id=p.run_id
 WHERE a.id=record_id AND event_name='ai.receipt.recorded'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT c.organization_id,c.clinic_id,r.principal_id,'ai.compensation'
 FROM clinic_app.ai_compensation c
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_actionexecution e ON e.id=c.execution_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_actionproposal p ON p.id=e.proposal_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentrun r ON r.id=p.run_id
 WHERE c.id=record_id AND event_name='ai.compensation.'||c.state
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.organization_id,r.clinic_id,r.principal_id,'ai.agent_run'
 FROM clinic_app.ai_agentrun r
 WHERE r.id=record_id AND event_name='ai.agent_run.'||r.outcome
 ) x WHERE x.organization_id=
 NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND x.principal_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'')::uuid
 AND clinic_app.principal_has('agent.execute',x.clinic_id)
$function$
"

 'memberships',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id::text,
 'role',r.role,'bundle_version',r.workflow_bundle_version)
 -- Action payload v1 requires RFC 8785 byte order: bundle_version, id, role.

 r.role COLLATE pg_catalog."C"),'[]'::jsonb))

 AND r.revoked_at IS NULL

$function$
"

function agent_controls(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_controls(requested uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('latest_policy_id',
 (SELECT latest.id::text FROM clinic_app.ai_agentpolicyversion latest
 WHERE latest.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND latest.capability=p.capability
 ORDER BY latest.version DESC LIMIT 1),'enabled',
 coalesce((SELECT enabled FROM clinic_app.ai_gatewayswitch WHERE id=1),false)
 AND coalesce((org.policy->>'enabled')::boolean,false)
 AND coalesce((org.policy->'purposes') ? p.capability,false)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration m
 WHERE m.id=r.configuration_id AND m.state='active'
 AND m.approval_ref<>'' AND m.provider IN ('synthetic','recorded_fixture')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_gatewayswitch gs
 WHERE gs.id=1 AND gs.approved_regions ? m.region)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_aicircuit circuit
 WHERE circuit.configuration_id=m.id AND circuit.organization_id=p.organization_id
 AND circuit.closed_at IS NULL)),
 'policy_authority',coalesce(
 clinic_app.identity_actor_permission('automation.admin',p.clinic_id,NULL,
 p.created_by_id,p.organization_id)
 OR clinic_app.identity_actor_permission('automation.organization',p.clinic_id,NULL,
 p.created_by_id,p.organization_id),false),
 'provider',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('capability_version',v.id::text,
 'account',v.account,'environment',v.environment,'api_version',v.api_version,
 'state',v.state,'provider',v.provider)
 FROM clinic_app.providers_capabilityversion v
 WHERE v.id=(SELECT c.current_version_id FROM clinic_app.providers_providercapability c
 WHERE c.key='email' AND (c.clinic_id=p.clinic_id OR c.clinic_id IS NULL)
 ORDER BY c.clinic_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)))
 FROM clinic_app.ai_actionproposal a
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentrun r ON r.id=a.run_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentpolicyversion p ON p.id=r.policy_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT ai_policy AS policy
 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinicconfiguration
 WHERE organization_id=p.organization_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) org
 ON true WHERE a.id=requested
 AND a.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND CASE WHEN pg_has_role(session_user,'clinic_agent','USAGE')
 THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.agent_proposal_scope(requested))
 ELSE clinic_app.agent_staff(a.clinic_id) END
$function$
"

function agent_transition(text, text).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_transition(previous text, following text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE previous
 WHEN 'proposal' THEN following IN ('validated','rejected')
 WHEN 'validated' THEN following IN ('approved','rejected')
 WHEN 'approved' THEN following IN ('executing','rejected')
 WHEN 'executing' THEN following IN ('receipt','unknown','failure','rejected')
 WHEN 'unknown' THEN following IN ('reconciled','exception')
 WHEN 'failure' THEN following='compensating'
 WHEN 'compensating' THEN following IN ('compensated','manual_required')
 ELSE false END
$function$
"

function scribe_citation_allowed(uuid, u.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_citation_allowed(requested_version uuid, requested_transcript uuid, reference jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE e clinic_app.ehr_encounter; t clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion;
 identifier uuid; cited_version integer; source_kind text;
BEGIN
 IF NOT clinic_app.scribe_note_author(requested_version)
  OR jsonb_typeof(reference)<>'object'
  OR coalesce(reference->>'digest','')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT encounter.* INTO e FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter encounter
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.encounter_id=encounter.id
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v ON v.document_id=d.id
 WHERE v.id=requested_version;
 SELECT * INTO t FROM clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion
 WHERE id=requested_transcript;
 IF t.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession s
  WHERE s.id=t.session_id AND s.encounter_id=e.id AND NOT s.discarded)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 BEGIN
  identifier:=(reference->>'id')::uuid;
  source_kind:=reference->>'kind';
  IF source_kind='transcript' THEN
   RETURN coalesce(reference-'kind'-'id'-'version'-'revision'-'digest'='{}'::jsonb
    AND (reference->>'version')::uuid=t.id
    AND (reference->>'revision')::integer=t.revision
    AND t.coverage->'sources' @> jsonb_build_array(identifier)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_transcriptsegment s
     JOIN clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion v ON v.id=s.version_id
     WHERE s.source_id=identifier AND s.session_id=t.session_id
      AND v.revision<=t.revision),false);
  END IF;
  cited_version:=(reference->>'version')::integer;
 EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range
 THEN RETURN false;
 END;
 IF identifier IS NULL OR cited_version IS NULL OR cited_version<1
  OR reference-'section'-'kind'-'id'-'version'-'date'-'digest'-'evidence'<>'{}'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(
  WITH patients AS(SELECT patient_id FROM clinic_app.patient_alias_set(e.patient_id)),
  sources AS(
   SELECT 'encounter'::text AS kind,x.id,x.revision AS revision
    FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter x
    WHERE x.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND x.patient_id IN(SELECT patient_id FROM patients)
   UNION ALL SELECT 'note',v.id,v.version FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
    JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.id=v.document_id
    JOIN clinic_app.ehr_encounter x ON x.id=d.encounter_id

function scribe_citation_allowed(uuid, u.prosrc:

 identifier uuid; cited_version integer; source_kind text;
BEGIN
 IF NOT clinic_app.scribe_note_author(requested_version)
  OR jsonb_typeof(reference)<>'object'
  OR coalesce(reference->>'digest','')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT encounter.* INTO e FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter encounter
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.encounter_id=encounter.id
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v ON v.document_id=d.id
 WHERE v.id=requested_version;
 SELECT * INTO t FROM clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion
 WHERE id=requested_transcript;
 IF t.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession s
  WHERE s.id=t.session_id AND s.encounter_id=e.id AND NOT s.discarded)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 BEGIN
  identifier:=(reference->>'id')::uuid;
  source_kind:=reference->>'kind';
  IF source_kind='transcript' THEN
   RETURN coalesce(reference-'kind'-'id'-'version'-'revision'-'digest'='{}'::jsonb
    AND (reference->>'version')::uuid=t.id
    AND (reference->>'revision')::integer=t.revision
    AND t.coverage->'sources' @> jsonb_build_array(identifier)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_transcriptsegment s
     JOIN clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion v ON v.id=s.version_id
     WHERE s.source_id=identifier AND s.session_id=t.session_id
      AND v.revision<=t.revision),false);
  END IF;
  cited_version:=(reference->>'version')::integer;
 EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range
 THEN RETURN false;

  OR reference-'section'-'kind'-'id'-'version'-'date'-'digest'-'evidence'<>'{}'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;

    JOIN clinic_app.ehr_historyassessment h ON h.id=x.assessment_id
    WHERE h.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND h.patient_id IN(SELECT patient_id FROM patients)
   UNION ALL SELECT 'allergy',x.id,x.version FROM clinic_app.ehr_allergy x
    JOIN clinic_app.ehr_historyassessment h ON h.id=x.assessment_id
    WHERE h.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND h.patient_id IN(SELECT patient_id FROM patients)
   UNION ALL SELECT h.kind||'_assessment',h.id,h.revision
    FROM clinic_app.ehr_historyassessment h WHERE h.clinic_id=e.clinic_id
     AND h.patient_id IN(SELECT patient_id FROM patients) AND h.state='none_documented'
   UNION ALL SELECT 'medication',x.id,x.revision
    FROM clinic_app.ehr_medicationstatement x
    WHERE x.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND x.patient_id IN(SELECT patient_id FROM patients)
   UNION ALL SELECT 'observation',x.id,x.revision FROM clinic_app.ehr_observation x
    WHERE x.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND x.patient_id IN(SELECT patient_id FROM patients)
   UNION ALL SELECT 'result',v.id,v.number FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion v
    JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m ON m.version_id=v.id
    JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.id=m.order_id
    JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment p ON p.id=o.enrollment_id
    WHERE o.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND p.patient_id IN(SELECT patient_id FROM patients)
   UNION ALL SELECT 'task',x.id,x.revision FROM clinic_app.workflows_task x
    WHERE x.clinic_id=e.clinic_id
     AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view',e.clinic_id,NULL)

        AND a.patient_id IN(SELECT patient_id FROM patients)))))

function scribe_draft_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_draft_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion; e clinic_app.ehr_encounter;
 a clinic_app.scribe_aidraft; s clinic_app.scribe_draftsectionsuggestion;
 i clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation; c clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration;
 t clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion; reference jsonb; section jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft provenance is retained' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('scribe-draft:'||NEW.version_id,0));
 SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion WHERE id=NEW.version_id;
 SELECT encounter.* INTO e FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter encounter
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.encounter_id=encounter.id
 WHERE d.id=v.document_id;
 IF v.id IS NULL OR v.state<>'draft' OR e.state<>'open'
  OR NEW.organization_id<>v.organization_id
  OR NOT clinic_app.scribe_note_author(v.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_aidraft' THEN
  SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=NEW.invocation_id;
  SELECT * INTO t FROM clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion WHERE id=NEW.transcript_id;
  IF (NEW.clinic_id,NEW.encounter_id,NEW.requested_by_id)
    IS DISTINCT FROM(e.clinic_id,e.id,v.author_id)
   OR i.id IS NULL OR (i.organization_id,i.clinic_id,i.user_id,i.purpose,i.status)
    IS DISTINCT FROM(v.organization_id,e.clinic_id,v.author_id,
     'scribe_draft'::text,'reserved'::text)
   OR i.operation_id IS NULL OR NEW.base_revision<>v.revision
   OR NEW.generation<>coalesce((SELECT max(generation) FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft
    WHERE version_id=v.id),0)+1
   OR NEW.base_epochs IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce((SELECT section_edit_epochs
    FROM clinic_app.ehr_drafteditstate WHERE version_id=v.id),
    '{"subjective":0,"objective":0,"assessment":0,"plan":0}'::jsonb)
   OR t.id IS NULL OR t.state<>'final'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession r
    WHERE r.id=t.session_id AND r.encounter_id=e.id AND NOT r.discarded)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion newer
    WHERE newer.session_id=t.session_id AND newer.revision>t.revision)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance acceptance
    JOIN clinic_app.consent_consenttext text ON text.id=acceptance.text_id
    JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment p ON p.id=acceptance.enrollment_id
    JOIN clinic_app.consent_aiusedisclosure disclosure ON disclosure.encounter_id=e.id
    WHERE acceptance.id=NEW.consent_id AND acceptance.organization_id=v.organization_id
     AND acceptance.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND p.patient_id=e.patient_id
     AND i.inputs_ref_id IN(SELECT input.id FROM clinic_app.ai_aiartifact input
      WHERE input.patient_enrollment_id=p.id AND input.kind='input')
     AND text.purpose='ai_assistance' AND disclosure.informed AND NOT disclosure.refused
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentrevocation r
      WHERE r.acceptance_id=acceptance.id)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consenttext newer
      WHERE newer.clinic_id=text.clinic_id AND newer.purpose=text.purpose
       AND newer.version>text.version))
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.sections) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.sections) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4
   OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.sections)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT value)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.sections))
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.source_refs) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.source_refs) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 250
   OR octet_length(NEW.base_content) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft generation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  FOR section IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.sections) LOOP
   IF section NOT IN('"subjective"'::jsonb,'"objective"'::jsonb,
    '"assessment"'::jsonb,'"plan"'::jsonb) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft section' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  FOR reference IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_refs) LOOP
   IF NOT clinic_app.scribe_citation_allowed(v.id,t.id,reference) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft citation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
 ELSE
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_reviewdecision' THEN
   SELECT * INTO s FROM clinic_app.scribe_draftsectionsuggestion
    WHERE id=NEW.suggestion_id;
   SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft WHERE id=s.draft_id;
  ELSE
   SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft WHERE id=NEW.draft_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=a.invocation_id;
  IF a.id IS NULL OR a.version_id<>v.id OR a.organization_id<>NEW.organization_id
   OR i.status<>'succeeded' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_reviewdecision' THEN
   SELECT * INTO c FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration WHERE id=i.configuration_id;
   IF s.id IS NULL OR s.version_id<>v.id OR NEW.section<>s.section
    OR NEW.reviewed_by_id<>v.author_id
    OR NEW.action NOT IN('accepted','modified','rejected')
    OR NEW.result_revision<>v.revision OR NEW.result_sha256<>v.content_sha256
    OR NEW.result_revision NOT IN(NEW.expected_revision,NEW.expected_revision+1)
    OR (NEW.action='rejected' AND NEW.result_revision<>NEW.expected_revision)
    OR NEW.request_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR (NEW.action='rejected' AND NEW.applied_text IS NOT NULL)
    OR (NEW.action IN('accepted','modified') AND (
     NEW.applied_text IS NULL
     OR octet_length(NEW.applied_text) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144))
    OR NEW.capability_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
     'purpose','scribe_draft','capability',c.capability_key,
     'configuration_id',c.id,'version',i.config_version)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid clinician review' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.action<>'rejected' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft newer
    WHERE newer.version_id=v.id AND newer.generation>a.generation
     AND newer.sections @> jsonb_build_array(s.section)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft generation superseded' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.citations) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.citations) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    OR NOT a.source_refs @> NEW.citations
    OR octet_length(NEW.text) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft source' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_draftsectionsuggestion' THEN
    IF NOT a.sections @> jsonb_build_array(NEW.section)
     OR NEW.assertion_class NOT IN('reported','observed','hypothesis')
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft newer
      WHERE newer.version_id=v.id AND newer.generation>a.generation
       AND newer.sections @> jsonb_build_array(NEW.section)) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid section suggestion' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.kind NOT IN('order','task') OR NEW.ordinal NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 7 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid separate proposal' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp();
 RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

function scribe_note_author(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_note_author(requested_version uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.id=v.document_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_encounter e ON e.id=d.encounter_id
 JOIN clinic_app.identity_user actor
  ON actor.id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
 WHERE v.id=requested_version
  AND actor.is_active
  AND v.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND v.author_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  AND e.physician_id=v.author_id
  AND clinic_app.ehr_note_author(d.id) AND clinic_app.ehr_note_visible(d.id))
$function$
"
function scribe_note_author(uuid).prosrc:
"

 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.id=v.document_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_encounter e ON e.id=d.encounter_id
 JOIN clinic_app.identity_user actor
  ON actor.id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
 WHERE v.id=requested_version
  AND actor.is_active
  AND v.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND v.author_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  AND e.physician_id=v.author_id
  AND clinic_app.ehr_note_author(d.id) AND clinic_app.ehr_note_visible(d.id))
"
