"

function workflows_care_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.workflows_care_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 now_ timestamptz := clinic_app.workflows_now();
 v_plan clinic_app.workflows_careplan;
 v_asg clinic_app.workflows_proassignment;
 v_ver clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion;
 v_enc clinic_app.ehr_encounter;
 v_doc clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondraft;
 allowed boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_prooccurrence' AND TG_WHEN='AFTER' THEN
  -- A recorded response always reaches its response role's human queue as one
  -- source-backed review task; concern only raises the priority. No staff
  -- identity routes it, so a nurse or clinician can record without manager
  -- authority. workflows_care_system_task_valid admits exactly this row.
  SELECT * INTO v_asg FROM clinic_app.workflows_proassignment a
   WHERE a.id=NEW.assignment_id;
  INSERT INTO clinic_app.workflows_task
   (id,organization_id,clinic_id,kind,subject_ref,created_by_id,owner_user_id,
   owner_role,due_at,priority,state,escalation_policy_version,escalated_at,
   depends_on_id,completion_evidence,revision,idempotency_key,fingerprint,
   last_command_key,last_command_digest,created_at,updated_at)
  VALUES (NEW.response_task_id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,'review',
   jsonb_build_object('kind','enrollment','id',v_asg.enrollment_id::text),NULL,NULL,
   v_asg.response_role,NEW.recorded_at,
   CASE WHEN NEW.concerning THEN 'urgent' ELSE 'normal' END,'assigned',1,NULL,NULL,
   '{}',1,NEW.id,encode(clinic_app.digest('workflows-pro-review:'||NEW.id::text,
   'sha256'),'hex'),NULL,'',statement_timestamp(),statement_timestamp());
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' THEN
  -- Deferred to commit: whichever path wrote a care-owned task, its action
  -- must end the transaction mirroring the task's owner and state.
  IF TG_WHEN='AFTER' THEN
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_careaction a
    JOIN clinic_app.workflows_task t ON t.id=a.task_id
    WHERE a.task_id=NEW.id AND NOT (ROW(a.owner_user_id,a.owner_role) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role) AND ((t.state='open' AND a.state IN ('open','overdue')) OR (t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress') AND a.state IN ('assigned','overdue')) OR (t.state IN ('done','cancelled') AND a.state=t.state))))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care task left its action behind' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  -- The trigger fires only for a new owner or a step towards completion.
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_careaction a
   JOIN clinic_app.workflows_careplan p ON p.id=a.plan_id
   WHERE a.task_id=NEW.id AND (a.review_state='required'
   OR (a.review_state<>'confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
    FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
    WHERE v.id=p.source_version_id AND v.state='finalized'))))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care task awaits clinician review' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'care history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',
 true),'')::uuid THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'care scope mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
  OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
  OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'care command identity is invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 ELSIF NEW.revision<>1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL
 OR NEW.last_command_digest<>'' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'care command identity is invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;

 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_careplan' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO v_ver FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
    WHERE v.id=NEW.source_version_id AND v.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   SELECT * INTO v_enc FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter e
    WHERE e.id=NEW.encounter_id AND e.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND e.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   IF v_ver.id IS NULL OR v_enc.id IS NULL OR v_ver.state<>'finalized'
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d
     WHERE d.id=v_ver.document_id AND d.encounter_id=v_enc.id)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment n
     WHERE n.id=NEW.enrollment_id AND n.patient_id=v_enc.patient_id)
    OR NEW.clinician_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'active'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid care plan' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision',
    'last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state<>'active' OR NEW.state<>'superseded'
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
     WHERE v.id=NEW.source_version_id AND v.state='finalized')
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid care plan transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_careaction' THEN
  SELECT * INTO v_plan FROM clinic_app.workflows_careplan p WHERE p.id=NEW.plan_id;
  IF v_plan.id IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action plan is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF v_plan.state<>'active' OR NEW.origin_version_id<>v_plan.source_version_id
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'open'
    OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'' OR NEW.review_state<>'none'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid care action' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.kind IN ('return_window','staff_coordination') THEN
    IF NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL
     OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NOT
    clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,v_plan.enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action requires clinician approval'
    USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t
    WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id AND t.state='open'
    AND t.kind='follow_up' AND t.due_at=NEW.window_end
    AND t.subject_ref->>'kind'='enrollment'
    AND t.subject_ref->>'id'=v_plan.enrollment_id::text)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action task mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','review_state',
    'revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state',
    'review_state','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state IN ('done','cancelled')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.review_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.review_state THEN
    IF OLD.review_state='none' AND NEW.review_state='required' THEN
     IF v_plan.state<>'superseded' OR NEW.state<>OLD.state OR NOT
      clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'review flag denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    ELSIF OLD.review_state='required' AND NEW.review_state='confirmed' THEN
     IF NEW.state<>OLD.state OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',
      NEW.clinic_id,v_plan.enrollment_id)
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'review decision denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid review transition' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.review_state='required' AND (NEW.state NOT IN (OLD.state,'cancelled')
    OR ROW(NEW.owner_user_id,NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM
     ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action awaits clinician review'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state<>OLD.state THEN
    allowed := (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state IN ('assigned','overdue','cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state='done' AND NEW.task_id IS NULL)
     OR (OLD.state='assigned' AND NEW.state IN ('overdue','done','cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='overdue' AND NEW.state IN ('done','cancelled'));
    IF NOT allowed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid care action transition'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF NEW.state='overdue' AND (NEW.window_end>now_ OR NOT
     clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid overdue marking' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF NEW.state IN ('done','cancelled') AND NEW.task_id IS NULL AND NOT
     clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,v_plan.enrollment_id)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'clinician decision required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF ((NEW.state IN ('assigned','done') AND NEW.state<>OLD.state)
    OR ROW(NEW.owner_user_id,NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM
     ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role)) AND NEW.review_state<>'confirmed'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
     WHERE v.id=v_plan.source_version_id AND v.state='finalized')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action source is stale' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   -- A task-owned action only ever follows its task: owner and state move on
   -- the task first, in the same transaction, never on the action alone.
   IF NEW.task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
    FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND (ROW(NEW.owner_user_id,NEW.owner_role) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role) AND ((t.state='open' AND NEW.state IN ('open','overdue')) OR (t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress') AND NEW.state IN ('assigned','overdue')) OR (t.state IN ('done','cancelled') AND NEW.state=t.state))))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action must follow its task' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_referral' THEN
  IF NEW.plan_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO v_plan FROM clinic_app.workflows_careplan p WHERE p.id=NEW.plan_id;
   IF v_plan.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral plan is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO v_doc FROM clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondraft d
    WHERE d.id=NEW.document_id AND d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND d.kind='referral';
   IF v_doc.id IS NULL OR (NEW.plan_id IS NOT NULL
    AND v_doc.encounter_id<>v_plan.encounter_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral document mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid referral' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   -- Runtime referrals are planned; documents that predate plans were linked
   -- once by migration 0007 (trusted operator code).
   IF NEW.plan_id IS NULL OR NEW.status<>'requested' OR NEW.target_kind='unspecified'
    OR NEW.target_label IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
     FROM clinic_app.workflows_careaction a WHERE a.id=NEW.action_id
     AND a.plan_id=NEW.plan_id AND a.kind='referral')
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,
     v_plan.enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid referral' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','document_id','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY[
    'status','document_id','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest',
    'updated_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.document_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.document_id AND (OLD.document_id IS NOT NULL
    OR OLD.plan_id IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',
     NEW.clinic_id,v_plan.enrollment_id))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral link denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
    allowed := (OLD.status='requested' AND NEW.status IN ('scheduled','cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.status='scheduled' AND NEW.status IN ('completed','cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.status='documented' AND NEW.status IN ('scheduled','cancelled'));
    IF NOT allowed OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid referral transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_recall' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'scheduled'
    OR NEW.task_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT (NEW.owner_role=ANY(ARRAY['owner','physician','receptionist','clinic_admin','nurse','allied_professional','scheduler','clinic_manager','finance','org_admin']::text[]))
    OR NEW.due_at<>NEW.anchor_at+NEW.interval_days*interval '1 day'
    OR NEW.anchor_at NOT BETWEEN now_-interval '5 minutes'
     AND now_+interval '5 minutes'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid recall' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','task_id','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state',
    'task_id','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state<>'scheduled' OR NEW.state<>'materialized' OR NEW.due_at>now_
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id
     AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id AND t.owner_role=NEW.owner_role
     AND t.kind='follow_up' AND t.subject_ref->>'kind'='enrollment'
     AND t.subject_ref->>'id'=NEW.enrollment_id::text)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid recall transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_proassignment' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'active'
    OR NOT (NEW.response_role=ANY(ARRAY['physician','nurse','allied_professional']::text[]))
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
    OR (NEW.plan_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
     FROM clinic_app.workflows_careplan p WHERE p.id=NEW.plan_id
     AND p.enrollment_id=NEW.enrollment_id))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pro assignment' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision',
    'last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state<>'active' OR NEW.state<>'completed'
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_prooccurrence o
     WHERE o.assignment_id=NEW.id AND o.state='pending')
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pro assignment transition'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO v_asg FROM clinic_app.workflows_proassignment a
   WHERE a.id=NEW.assignment_id;
  IF v_asg.id IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence assignment is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF v_asg.state<>'active' OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NEW.created_by_id<>v_asg.created_by_id
    OR NEW.sequence NOT BETWEEN 1 AND v_asg.occurrences
    OR NEW.due_at<>v_asg.first_due_at+(NEW.sequence-1)*v_asg.interval_days
     *interval '1 day'
    OR NEW.state<>'pending' OR NEW.recorded_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,v_asg.enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pro occurrence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','answers','concerning','response_task_id',
    'recorded_at','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','answers','concerning',
    'response_task_id','recorded_at','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) OR OLD.state<>'pending'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pro occurrence identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='responded' THEN
    -- A response is an observation of this patient: the nurse or clinician
    -- on the patient's care records it, never staff routing authority.
    IF NEW.recorded_at IS NULL OR NEW.answers IS NULL OR NEW.response_task_id IS NULL
     OR NOT (clinic_app.has_permission('observation.write',NEW.clinic_id,
      v_asg.enrollment_id) OR clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',
      NEW.clinic_id,v_asg.enrollment_id))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pro response denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state='no_response' THEN
    IF NEW.due_at+3*interval '1 day'>now_ OR NOT
     clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pro nonresponse denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pro occurrence transition' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"
function workflows_care_guard().prosrc:
"
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 now_ timestamptz := clinic_app.workflows_now();
 v_plan clinic_app.workflows_careplan;
 v_asg clinic_app.workflows_proassignment;
 v_ver clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion;
 v_enc clinic_app.ehr_encounter;
 v_doc clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondraft;
 allowed boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_prooccurrence' AND TG_WHEN='AFTER' THEN
  -- A recorded response always reaches its response role's human queue as one
  -- source-backed review task; concern only raises the priority. No staff
  -- identity routes it, so a nurse or clinician can record without manager
  -- authority. workflows_care_system_task_valid admits exactly this row.
  SELECT * INTO v_asg FROM clinic_app.workflows_proassignment a
   WHERE a.id=NEW.assignment_id;
  INSERT INTO clinic_app.workflows_task
   (id,organization_id,clinic_id,kind,subject_ref,created_by_id,owner_user_id,
   owner_role,due_at,priority,state,escalation_policy_version,escalated_at,
   depends_on_id,completion_evidence,revision,idempotency_key,fingerprint,
   last_command_key,last_command_digest,created_at,updated_at)
  VALUES (NEW.response_task_id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,'review',
   jsonb_build_object('kind','enrollment','id',v_asg.enrollment_id::text),NULL,NULL,
   v_asg.response_role,NEW.recorded_at,
   CASE WHEN NEW.concerning THEN 'urgent' ELSE 'normal' END,'assigned',1,NULL,NULL,
   '{}',1,NEW.id,encode(clinic_app.digest('workflows-pro-review:'||NEW.id::text,
   'sha256'),'hex'),NULL,'',statement_timestamp(),statement_timestamp());
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' THEN
  -- Deferred to commit: whichever path wrote a care-owned task, its action
  -- must end the transaction mirroring the task's owner and state.
  IF TG_WHEN='AFTER' THEN
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_careaction a
    JOIN clinic_app.workflows_task t ON t.id=a.task_id
    WHERE a.task_id=NEW.id AND NOT (ROW(a.owner_user_id,a.owner_role) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role) AND ((t.state='open' AND a.state IN ('open','overdue')) OR (t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress') AND a.state IN ('assigned','overdue')) OR (t.state IN ('done','cancelled') AND a.state=t.state))))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care task left its action behind' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  -- The trigger fires only for a new owner or a step towards completion.
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_careaction a
   JOIN clinic_app.workflows_careplan p ON p.id=a.plan_id
   WHERE a.task_id=NEW.id AND (a.review_state='required'
   OR (a.review_state<>'confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
    FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
    WHERE v.id=p.source_version_id AND v.state='finalized'))))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care task awaits clinician review' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'care history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',
 true),'')::uuid THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'care scope mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
  OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
  OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'care command identity is invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 ELSIF NEW.revision<>1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL
 OR NEW.last_command_digest<>'' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'care command identity is invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;

 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_careplan' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO v_ver FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
    WHERE v.id=NEW.source_version_id AND v.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   SELECT * INTO v_enc FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter e
    WHERE e.id=NEW.encounter_id AND e.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND e.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   IF v_ver.id IS NULL OR v_enc.id IS NULL OR v_ver.state<>'finalized'
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d
     WHERE d.id=v_ver.document_id AND d.encounter_id=v_enc.id)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment n
     WHERE n.id=NEW.enrollment_id AND n.patient_id=v_enc.patient_id)
    OR NEW.clinician_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'active'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid care plan' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision',
    'last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state<>'active' OR NEW.state<>'superseded'
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
     WHERE v.id=NEW.source_version_id AND v.state='finalized')
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid care plan transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_careaction' THEN
  SELECT * INTO v_plan FROM clinic_app.workflows_careplan p WHERE p.id=NEW.plan_id;
  IF v_plan.id IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action plan is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF v_plan.state<>'active' OR NEW.origin_version_id<>v_plan.source_version_id
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'open'
    OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'' OR NEW.review_state<>'none'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid care action' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.kind IN ('return_window','staff_coordination') THEN
    IF NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL
     OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NOT
    clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,v_plan.enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action requires clinician approval'
    USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t
    WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id AND t.state='open'
    AND t.kind='follow_up' AND t.due_at=NEW.window_end
    AND t.subject_ref->>'kind'='enrollment'
    AND t.subject_ref->>'id'=v_plan.enrollment_id::text)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action task mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','review_state',
    'revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state',
    'review_state','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state IN ('done','cancelled')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.review_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.review_state THEN
    IF OLD.review_state='none' AND NEW.review_state='required' THEN
     IF v_plan.state<>'superseded' OR NEW.state<>OLD.state OR NOT
      clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'review flag denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    ELSIF OLD.review_state='required' AND NEW.review_state='confirmed' THEN
     IF NEW.state<>OLD.state OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',
      NEW.clinic_id,v_plan.enrollment_id)
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'review decision denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid review transition' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.review_state='required' AND (NEW.state NOT IN (OLD.state,'cancelled')
    OR ROW(NEW.owner_user_id,NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM
     ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action awaits clinician review'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state<>OLD.state THEN
    allowed := (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state IN ('assigned','overdue','cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state='done' AND NEW.task_id IS NULL)
     OR (OLD.state='assigned' AND NEW.state IN ('overdue','done','cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='overdue' AND NEW.state IN ('done','cancelled'));
    IF NOT allowed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid care action transition'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF NEW.state='overdue' AND (NEW.window_end>now_ OR NOT
     clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid overdue marking' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF NEW.state IN ('done','cancelled') AND NEW.task_id IS NULL AND NOT
     clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,v_plan.enrollment_id)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'clinician decision required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF ((NEW.state IN ('assigned','done') AND NEW.state<>OLD.state)
    OR ROW(NEW.owner_user_id,NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM
     ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role)) AND NEW.review_state<>'confirmed'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
     WHERE v.id=v_plan.source_version_id AND v.state='finalized')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action source is stale' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   -- A task-owned action only ever follows its task: owner and state move on
   -- the task first, in the same transaction, never on the action alone.
   IF NEW.task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
    FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND (ROW(NEW.owner_user_id,NEW.owner_role) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role) AND ((t.state='open' AND NEW.state IN ('open','overdue')) OR (t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress') AND NEW.state IN ('assigned','overdue')) OR (t.state IN ('done','cancelled') AND NEW.state=t.state))))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'care action must follow its task' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_referral' THEN
  IF NEW.plan_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO v_plan FROM clinic_app.workflows_careplan p WHERE p.id=NEW.plan_id;
   IF v_plan.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral plan is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO v_doc FROM clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondraft d
    WHERE d.id=NEW.document_id AND d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND d.kind='referral';
   IF v_doc.id IS NULL OR (NEW.plan_id IS NOT NULL
    AND v_doc.encounter_id<>v_plan.encounter_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral document mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid referral' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   -- Runtime referrals are planned; documents that predate plans were linked
   -- once by migration 0007 (trusted operator code).
   IF NEW.plan_id IS NULL OR NEW.status<>'requested' OR NEW.target_kind='unspecified'
    OR NEW.target_label IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
     FROM clinic_app.workflows_careaction a WHERE a.id=NEW.action_id
     AND a.plan_id=NEW.plan_id AND a.kind='referral')
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,
     v_plan.enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid referral' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','document_id','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY[
    'status','document_id','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest',
    'updated_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.document_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.document_id AND (OLD.document_id IS NOT NULL
    OR OLD.plan_id IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',
     NEW.clinic_id,v_plan.enrollment_id))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral link denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
    allowed := (OLD.status='requested' AND NEW.status IN ('scheduled','cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.status='scheduled' AND NEW.status IN ('completed','cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.status='documented' AND NEW.status IN ('scheduled','cancelled'));
    IF NOT allowed OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid referral transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_recall' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'scheduled'
    OR NEW.task_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT (NEW.owner_role=ANY(ARRAY['owner','physician','receptionist','clinic_admin','nurse','allied_professional','scheduler','clinic_manager','finance','org_admin']::text[]))
    OR NEW.due_at<>NEW.anchor_at+NEW.interval_days*interval '1 day'
    OR NEW.anchor_at NOT BETWEEN now_-interval '5 minutes'
     AND now_+interval '5 minutes'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid recall' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','task_id','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state',
    'task_id','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state<>'scheduled' OR NEW.state<>'materialized' OR NEW.due_at>now_
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id
     AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id AND t.owner_role=NEW.owner_role
     AND t.kind='follow_up' AND t.subject_ref->>'kind'='enrollment'
     AND t.subject_ref->>'id'=NEW.enrollment_id::text)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid recall transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_proassignment' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'active'
    OR NOT (NEW.response_role=ANY(ARRAY['physician','nurse','allied_professional']::text[]))
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
    OR (NEW.plan_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
     FROM clinic_app.workflows_careplan p WHERE p.id=NEW.plan_id
     AND p.enrollment_id=NEW.enrollment_id))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pro assignment' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision',
    'last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state<>'active' OR NEW.state<>'completed'
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_prooccurrence o
     WHERE o.assignment_id=NEW.id AND o.state='pending')
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pro assignment transition'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;

 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO v_asg FROM clinic_app.workflows_proassignment a
   WHERE a.id=NEW.assignment_id;
  IF v_asg.id IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence assignment is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF v_asg.state<>'active' OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NEW.created_by_id<>v_asg.created_by_id
    OR NEW.sequence NOT BETWEEN 1 AND v_asg.occurrences
    OR NEW.due_at<>v_asg.first_due_at+(NEW.sequence-1)*v_asg.interval_days
     *interval '1 day'
    OR NEW.state<>'pending' OR NEW.recorded_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',NEW.clinic_id,v_asg.enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pro occurrence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','answers','concerning','response_task_id',
    'recorded_at','revision','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','answers','concerning',
    'response_task_id','recorded_at','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) OR OLD.state<>'pending'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pro occurrence identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='responded' THEN
    -- A response is an observation of this patient: the nurse or clinician
    -- on the patient's care records it, never staff routing authority.
    IF NEW.recorded_at IS NULL OR NEW.answers IS NULL OR NEW.response_task_id IS NULL
     OR NOT (clinic_app.has_permission('observation.write',NEW.clinic_id,
      v_asg.enrollment_id) OR clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',
      NEW.clinic_id,v_asg.enrollment_id))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pro response denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state='no_response' THEN
    IF NEW.due_at+3*interval '1 day'>now_ OR NOT
     clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pro nonresponse denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pro occurrence transition' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END "

function workflows_care_items(timestamp.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.workflows_care_items(due_by timestamp with time zone, requested uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(kind text, record_id uuid, organization_id uuid, clinic_id uuid, actor_id uuid, due timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT 'recall'::text,r.id,r.organization_id,r.clinic_id,r.created_by_id,r.due_at
  FROM clinic_app.workflows_recall r
  WHERE r.state='scheduled' AND r.due_at<=due_by
  AND (requested IS NULL OR r.id=requested)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'overdue',a.id,a.organization_id,a.clinic_id,a.created_by_id,a.window_end
  FROM clinic_app.workflows_careaction a
  WHERE a.state IN ('open','assigned') AND a.review_state<>'required'
  AND a.window_end<=due_by AND (requested IS NULL OR a.id=requested)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'pro_missed',o.id,o.organization_id,o.clinic_id,o.created_by_id,
  o.due_at+3*interval '1 day'
  FROM clinic_app.workflows_prooccurrence o
  WHERE o.state='pending' AND o.due_at+3*interval '1 day'<=due_by
  AND (requested IS NULL OR o.id=requested)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'stale',p.id,p.organization_id,p.clinic_id,p.clinician_id,p.created_at
  FROM clinic_app.workflows_careplan p
  WHERE (requested IS NULL OR p.id=requested)
  AND ((p.state='active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
   FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion v
   WHERE v.id=p.source_version_id AND v.state='finalized'))
  OR (p.state='superseded' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_careaction a
   WHERE a.plan_id=p.id AND a.review_state='none'
   AND a.state IN ('open','assigned','overdue'))))
$function$
"

function workflows_care_occurrence_scope.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.workflows_care_occurrence_scope(clinic uuid, requested_occurrence uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql

function workflows_care_system_task_vali.definition:

 JOIN clinic_app.workflows_proassignment a ON a.id=o.assignment_id
 WHERE o.response_task_id=(row_data->>'id')::uuid AND o.state='responded'
 AND o.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND row_data->'due_at'=to_jsonb(o.recorded_at)
 AND (row_data-'id'-'due_at'-'created_at'-'updated_at')=jsonb_build_object(
  'organization_id',o.organization_id,'clinic_id',o.clinic_id,'kind','review',

  'created_by_id',NULL,'owner_user_id',NULL,'owner_role',a.response_role,
  'priority',CASE WHEN o.concerning THEN 'urgent' ELSE 'normal' END,
  'state','assigned','escalation_policy_version',1,'escalated_at',NULL,
  'depends_on_id',NULL,'completion_evidence','{}'::jsonb,'revision',1,
  'idempotency_key',o.id,'fingerprint',encode(clinic_app.digest(
   'workflows-pro-review:'||o.id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),'last_command_key',NULL,
  'last_command_digest',''))
$function$
"

function workflows_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.workflows_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 run clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun;
 definition clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion;
 ref jsonb; item jsonb; allowed boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',
 true), '')::uuid
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow scope mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;


 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='UPDATE'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_close_valid(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW))
 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.retention_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.orders_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.workflows_care_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'open'
   OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'' OR NEW.revision<>1
   OR NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' OR NEW.escalated_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL OR NEW.last_command_digest<>''
   OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task parent
    WHERE parent.id=NEW.depends_on_id AND parent.id<>NEW.id
    AND parent.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND parent.organization_id=NEW.organization_id))
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.subject_ref, NEW.organization_id,
   NEW.clinic_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.state IN ('done','cancelled') OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
   OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision', 'escalated_at', 'last_command_key', 'last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision','escalated_at','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF ROW(NEW.owner_user_id, NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,
   OLD.owner_role) THEN
    -- owner_valid decides tasks.assign; the UPDATE policy already limits a
    -- non-manager's rows to own open tasks and owned work, so a self-claim
    -- needs no second, unobservable copy of that visibility here.
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_owner_valid(NEW.clinic_id, NEW.owner_user_id,
    NEW.owner_role)
    OR NOT (clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM actor)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task assignment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   allowed := NEW.state=OLD.state OR (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state='assigned')
    OR (OLD.state='assigned' AND NEW.state='in_progress')
    OR (OLD.state='in_progress' AND NEW.state='done') OR NEW.state='cancelled';
   IF NOT allowed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task transition' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state IN ('in_progress','done') AND NEW.state<>OLD.state THEN
    IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.complete',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_owned(OLD.clinic_id,OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role)
    OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS
     (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.depends_on_id
      AND t.state='done'))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task completion denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task cancellation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.escalated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escalated_at AND
    (OLD.escalated_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.escalated_at IS NULL
     OR NEW.due_at>statement_timestamp()
     OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid escalation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.state='open' AND (NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'')
   OR NEW.state IN ('assigned', 'in_progress', 'done') AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NULL
   AND NEW.owner_role=''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='done' THEN
   IF NEW.kind='checklist' THEN allowed :=
   NEW.completion_evidence='{"checked":true}'::jsonb;
   ELSE allowed := jsonb_typeof(NEW.completion_evidence)='object'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence ?& ARRAY['record','outcome']
    AND NEW.completion_evidence-ARRAY['record','outcome']='{}'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence->>'outcome' IN ('reviewed','resolved','escalated')
    AND clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.completion_evidence->'record',
    NEW.organization_id, NEW.clinic_id);
   END IF;
   IF allowed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task evidence' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'premature task evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_taskcomment' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment is immutable' USING
  ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.author_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NOT
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR octet_length(NEW.body)>65536 OR NOT EXISTS
   (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND ((t.state='open' AND
    t.created_by_id=actor)
     OR clinic_app.workflows_owned(t.clinic_id,t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role)
     OR clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',t.clinic_id,NULL)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowdefinitionversion' THEN
  IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.key!~'^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$'
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_steps_valid(NEW.steps)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    'clinic-workflow-definition-v1:'||NEW.clinic_id::text||':'||NEW.key,0));
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'draft'
    OR NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.revision<>1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_digest<>'' OR NEW.creation_fingerprint<>NEW.fingerprint
    OR NEW.version<>(SELECT COALESCE(max(d.version),0)+1 FROM
     clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
     WHERE d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND d.key=NEW.key)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   NEW.created_at := statement_timestamp();
  ELSE
   IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
    OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest']) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state IN ('draft','validated') AND NEW.state='draft' THEN
    IF NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.state='draft' AND NEW.state='validated' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.published_by_id,NEW.published_at,
     NEW.retired_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at,OLD.retired_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition validation changed content'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.validated_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='validated' AND NEW.state='published' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.retired_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,OLD.validated_at,OLD.retired_at)
     OR NEW.published_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'publication changed content' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.published_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='published' AND NEW.state='retired' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.published_by_id,
     NEW.published_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.validated_at,OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'published definition is immutable'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.retired_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition transition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowrun' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
    WHERE d.id=NEW.definition_version_id AND d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND
    d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   IF definition.id IS NULL OR definition.state<>'published'
    OR NEW.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR
   NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.context_refs)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   FOR ref IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.context_refs) LOOP
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(ref,NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
   FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition.steps) LOOP
    IF item->>'handler'='task' AND
    (item->>'subject')::int>=jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled') OR NOT (
     (OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state IN ('running','cancelled')) OR
     (OLD.state IN ('running', 'waiting') AND NEW.state IN ('running', 'waiting',
     'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' THEN
    IF OLD.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
     OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state='failed')
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND (s.state='cancelled' OR
       (s.state='failed' AND
        (s.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR s.created_task_id IS NOT NULL))))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run retry denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF ROW(NEW.last_command_key,NEW.last_command_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM
    ROW(OLD.last_command_key,OLD.last_command_digest) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'run command identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   -- tasks.view is decided by the UPDATE policy before any row reaches here.
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR (NEW.state<>'cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run transition denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
   clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
    WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state<>'completed')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unfinished run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO run FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun r WHERE r.id=NEW.run_id
   AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF run.id IS NULL OR NOT (run.started_by_id=actor AND
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.state='cancelled' AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL) AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id,
   NULL))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
   IF NEW.position>=jsonb_array_length(definition.steps) OR NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NEW.fencing_token<>0 OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL OR
    NEW.error_code<>''
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until', 'wake_at',
   'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until',
    'wake_at', 'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled')
    OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NOT (
     NEW.state='pending' AND run.state='pending'
     AND OLD.operation_id IS NULL AND OLD.created_task_id IS NULL))
    OR OLD.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.operation_id
    OR OLD.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.created_task_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.created_task_id
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.error_code<>''
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step retry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state='running' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token+1 OR NEW.claim_until IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid fencing claim' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state IN ('waiting','completed','failed','cancelled') THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR (OLD.state<>'running' AND
    NEW.state<>'cancelled')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
   WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   o.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND o.kind='action' AND o.subject_type='workflows.step' AND o.subject_id=NEW.id
    AND o.actor_id=run.started_by_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step operation mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.workflows_task t
   WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step task mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='completed' THEN
   item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
   IF item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
     AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
     AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
     AND t.state='done')
    OR item->>'handler'='timer' AND (
     NEW.wake_at IS NULL OR NEW.wake_at>clinic_app.workflows_now())
    OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
     WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.status='delivered')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow effect is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='waiting' THEN
    item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
    IF NEW.wake_at IS NULL
     OR item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
      AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
      AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
      AND t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress'))
     OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NEW.operation_id IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow waiting receipt is missing'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"
function workflows_guard().prosrc:
"
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 run clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun;
 definition clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion;
 ref jsonb; item jsonb; allowed boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',
 true), '')::uuid
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow scope mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;


 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='UPDATE'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_close_valid(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW))
 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.retention_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.orders_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.workflows_care_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'open'
   OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'' OR NEW.revision<>1
   OR NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' OR NEW.escalated_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL OR NEW.last_command_digest<>''
   OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task parent
    WHERE parent.id=NEW.depends_on_id AND parent.id<>NEW.id
    AND parent.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND parent.organization_id=NEW.organization_id))
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.subject_ref, NEW.organization_id,
   NEW.clinic_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.state IN ('done','cancelled') OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
   OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision', 'escalated_at', 'last_command_key', 'last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision','escalated_at','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF ROW(NEW.owner_user_id, NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,
   OLD.owner_role) THEN
    -- owner_valid decides tasks.assign; the UPDATE policy already limits a
    -- non-manager's rows to own open tasks and owned work, so a self-claim
    -- needs no second, unobservable copy of that visibility here.
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_owner_valid(NEW.clinic_id, NEW.owner_user_id,
    NEW.owner_role)
    OR NOT (clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM actor)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task assignment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   allowed := NEW.state=OLD.state OR (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state='assigned')
    OR (OLD.state='assigned' AND NEW.state='in_progress')
    OR (OLD.state='in_progress' AND NEW.state='done') OR NEW.state='cancelled';
   IF NOT allowed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task transition' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state IN ('in_progress','done') AND NEW.state<>OLD.state THEN
    IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.complete',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_owned(OLD.clinic_id,OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role)
    OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS
     (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.depends_on_id
      AND t.state='done'))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task completion denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task cancellation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.escalated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escalated_at AND
    (OLD.escalated_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.escalated_at IS NULL
     OR NEW.due_at>statement_timestamp()
     OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid escalation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.state='open' AND (NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'')
   OR NEW.state IN ('assigned', 'in_progress', 'done') AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NULL
   AND NEW.owner_role=''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='done' THEN
   IF NEW.kind='checklist' THEN allowed :=
   NEW.completion_evidence='{"checked":true}'::jsonb;
   ELSE allowed := jsonb_typeof(NEW.completion_evidence)='object'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence ?& ARRAY['record','outcome']
    AND NEW.completion_evidence-ARRAY['record','outcome']='{}'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence->>'outcome' IN ('reviewed','resolved','escalated')
    AND clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.completion_evidence->'record',
    NEW.organization_id, NEW.clinic_id);
   END IF;
   IF allowed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task evidence' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'premature task evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_taskcomment' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment is immutable' USING
  ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.author_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NOT
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR octet_length(NEW.body)>65536 OR NOT EXISTS
   (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND ((t.state='open' AND
    t.created_by_id=actor)
     OR clinic_app.workflows_owned(t.clinic_id,t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role)
     OR clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',t.clinic_id,NULL)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowdefinitionversion' THEN
  IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.key!~'^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$'
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_steps_valid(NEW.steps)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    'clinic-workflow-definition-v1:'||NEW.clinic_id::text||':'||NEW.key,0));
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'draft'
    OR NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.revision<>1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_digest<>'' OR NEW.creation_fingerprint<>NEW.fingerprint
    OR NEW.version<>(SELECT COALESCE(max(d.version),0)+1 FROM
     clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
     WHERE d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND d.key=NEW.key)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   NEW.created_at := statement_timestamp();
  ELSE
   IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
    OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest']) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state IN ('draft','validated') AND NEW.state='draft' THEN
    IF NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.state='draft' AND NEW.state='validated' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.published_by_id,NEW.published_at,
     NEW.retired_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at,OLD.retired_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition validation changed content'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.validated_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='validated' AND NEW.state='published' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.retired_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,OLD.validated_at,OLD.retired_at)
     OR NEW.published_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'publication changed content' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.published_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='published' AND NEW.state='retired' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.published_by_id,
     NEW.published_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.validated_at,OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'published definition is immutable'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.retired_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition transition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowrun' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
    WHERE d.id=NEW.definition_version_id AND d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND
    d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   IF definition.id IS NULL OR definition.state<>'published'
    OR NEW.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR
   NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.context_refs)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   FOR ref IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.context_refs) LOOP
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(ref,NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
   FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition.steps) LOOP
    IF item->>'handler'='task' AND
    (item->>'subject')::int>=jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled') OR NOT (
     (OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state IN ('running','cancelled')) OR
     (OLD.state IN ('running', 'waiting') AND NEW.state IN ('running', 'waiting',
     'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' THEN
    IF OLD.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
     OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state='failed')
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND (s.state='cancelled' OR
       (s.state='failed' AND
        (s.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR s.created_task_id IS NOT NULL))))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run retry denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF ROW(NEW.last_command_key,NEW.last_command_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM
    ROW(OLD.last_command_key,OLD.last_command_digest) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'run command identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   -- tasks.view is decided by the UPDATE policy before any row reaches here.
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR (NEW.state<>'cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run transition denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
   clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
    WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state<>'completed')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unfinished run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO run FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun r WHERE r.id=NEW.run_id
   AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF run.id IS NULL OR NOT (run.started_by_id=actor AND
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.state='cancelled' AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL) AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id,
   NULL))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
   IF NEW.position>=jsonb_array_length(definition.steps) OR NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NEW.fencing_token<>0 OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL OR
    NEW.error_code<>''
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until', 'wake_at',
   'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until',
    'wake_at', 'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled')
    OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NOT (
     NEW.state='pending' AND run.state='pending'
     AND OLD.operation_id IS NULL AND OLD.created_task_id IS NULL))
    OR OLD.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.operation_id
    OR OLD.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.created_task_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.created_task_id
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.error_code<>''
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step retry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state='running' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token+1 OR NEW.claim_until IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid fencing claim' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state IN ('waiting','completed','failed','cancelled') THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR (OLD.state<>'running' AND
    NEW.state<>'cancelled')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
   WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   o.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND o.kind='action' AND o.subject_type='workflows.step' AND o.subject_id=NEW.id
    AND o.actor_id=run.started_by_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step operation mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.workflows_task t
   WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step task mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='completed' THEN
   item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
   IF item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
     AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
     AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
     AND t.state='done')
    OR item->>'handler'='timer' AND (
     NEW.wake_at IS NULL OR NEW.wake_at>clinic_app.workflows_now())
    OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
     WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.status='delivered')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow effect is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='waiting' THEN
    item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
    IF NEW.wake_at IS NULL
     OR item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
      AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
      AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
      AND t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress'))
     OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NEW.operation_id IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow waiting receipt is missing'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END "

function comms_ingest_account(uuid, text.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.comms_ingest_account(clinic uuid, channel_name text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT a.id
 FROM clinic_app.comms_provideraccount a
 JOIN clinic_app.identity_serviceprincipal p ON p.id = a.principal_id
  AND p.organization_id = a.organization_id AND p.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
 WHERE a.clinic_id = clinic AND a.channel = channel_name
   AND a.active AND p.active AND p.purpose = 'messaging_ingest'
   AND a.organization_id =
       NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::pg_catalog.uuid
   AND a.principal_id =
       NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal', true), '')::pg_catalog.uuid
   AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), '') IS NULL
   AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session', true), '') IS NULL
   AND a.signing_key_digest = pg_catalog.encode(
       clinic_app.digest(current_setting('app.comms_inbound_proof', true), 'sha256'),
       'hex')
 LIMIT 1
$function$
"

function comms_open_window(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.comms_open_window(conversation uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 UPDATE clinic_app.comms_conversation c
    SET last_inbound_at = statement_timestamp(),
        last_activity_at = statement_timestamp()
  WHERE c.id = conversation
    AND c.provider_account_id =
        clinic_app.comms_ingest_account(c.clinic_id, c.channel);
 IF NOT FOUND THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'inbound requires the provider principal' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
END $function$
"

function comms_resolve_inbound(uuid, tex.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.comms_resolve_inbound(account uuid, proof text)
 RETURNS TABLE(organization_id uuid, clinic_id uuid, principal_id uuid, channel text, provider text, external_account_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT a.organization_id, a.clinic_id, a.principal_id, a.channel, a.provider,
        a.external_account_id
 FROM clinic_app.comms_provideraccount a
 JOIN clinic_app.identity_serviceprincipal p ON p.id = a.principal_id
  AND p.organization_id = a.organization_id AND p.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
 WHERE a.id = account AND a.active AND p.active
   AND p.purpose = 'messaging_ingest'
   AND pg_catalog.length(proof) BETWEEN 16 AND 256
   AND a.signing_key_digest =
       pg_catalog.encode(clinic_app.digest(proof, 'sha256'), 'hex')
   AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), '') IS NULL
   AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session', true), '') IS NULL
   AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal', true), '') IS NULL
$function$
"
