function workflows_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.workflows_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 run clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun;
 definition clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion;
 ref jsonb; item jsonb; allowed boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',
 true), '')::uuid
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow scope mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;


 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='UPDATE'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_close_valid(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW))
 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.retention_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.orders_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.workflows_care_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.workflows_release_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'open'
   OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'' OR NEW.revision<>1
   OR NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' OR NEW.escalated_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL OR NEW.last_command_digest<>''
   OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task parent
    WHERE parent.id=NEW.depends_on_id AND parent.id<>NEW.id
    AND parent.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND parent.organization_id=NEW.organization_id))
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.subject_ref, NEW.organization_id,
   NEW.clinic_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.state IN ('done','cancelled') OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
   OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision', 'escalated_at', 'last_command_key', 'last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision','escalated_at','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF ROW(NEW.owner_user_id, NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,
   OLD.owner_role) THEN
    -- owner_valid decides tasks.assign; the UPDATE policy already limits a
    -- non-manager's rows to own open tasks and owned work, so a self-claim
    -- needs no second, unobservable copy of that visibility here.
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_owner_valid(NEW.clinic_id, NEW.owner_user_id,
    NEW.owner_role)
    OR NOT (clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM actor)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task assignment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   allowed := NEW.state=OLD.state OR (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state='assigned')
    OR (OLD.state='assigned' AND NEW.state='in_progress')
    OR (OLD.state='in_progress' AND NEW.state='done') OR NEW.state='cancelled';
   IF NOT allowed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task transition' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state IN ('in_progress','done') AND NEW.state<>OLD.state THEN
    IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.complete',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_owned(OLD.clinic_id,OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role)
    OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS
     (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.depends_on_id
      AND t.state='done'))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task completion denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task cancellation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.escalated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escalated_at AND
    (OLD.escalated_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.escalated_at IS NULL
     OR NEW.due_at>statement_timestamp()
     OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid escalation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.state='open' AND (NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'')
   OR NEW.state IN ('assigned', 'in_progress', 'done') AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NULL
   AND NEW.owner_role=''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='done' THEN
   IF NEW.kind='checklist' THEN allowed :=
   NEW.completion_evidence='{"checked":true}'::jsonb;
   ELSE allowed := jsonb_typeof(NEW.completion_evidence)='object'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence ?& ARRAY['record','outcome']
    AND NEW.completion_evidence-ARRAY['record','outcome']='{}'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence->>'outcome' IN ('reviewed','resolved','escalated')
    AND clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.completion_evidence->'record',
    NEW.organization_id, NEW.clinic_id);
   END IF;
   IF allowed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task evidence' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'premature task evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_taskcomment' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment is immutable' USING
  ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.author_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NOT
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR octet_length(NEW.body)>65536 OR NOT EXISTS
   (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND ((t.state='open' AND
    t.created_by_id=actor)
     OR clinic_app.workflows_owned(t.clinic_id,t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role)
     OR clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',t.clinic_id,NULL)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowdefinitionversion' THEN
  IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.key!~'^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$'
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_steps_valid(NEW.steps)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    'clinic-workflow-definition-v1:'||NEW.clinic_id::text||':'||NEW.key,0));
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'draft'
    OR NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.revision<>1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_digest<>'' OR NEW.creation_fingerprint<>NEW.fingerprint
    OR NEW.version<>(SELECT COALESCE(max(d.version),0)+1 FROM
     clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
     WHERE d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND d.key=NEW.key)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   NEW.created_at := statement_timestamp();
  ELSE
   IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
    OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest']) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state IN ('draft','validated') AND NEW.state='draft' THEN
    IF NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.state='draft' AND NEW.state='validated' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.published_by_id,NEW.published_at,
     NEW.retired_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at,OLD.retired_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition validation changed content'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.validated_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='validated' AND NEW.state='published' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.retired_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,OLD.validated_at,OLD.retired_at)
     OR NEW.published_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'publication changed content' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.published_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='published' AND NEW.state='retired' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.published_by_id,
     NEW.published_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.validated_at,OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'published definition is immutable'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.retired_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition transition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowrun' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
    WHERE d.id=NEW.definition_version_id AND d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND
    d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   IF definition.id IS NULL OR definition.state<>'published'
    OR NEW.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR
   NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.context_refs)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   FOR ref IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.context_refs) LOOP
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(ref,NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
   FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition.steps) LOOP
    IF item->>'handler'='task' AND
    (item->>'subject')::int>=jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled') OR NOT (
     (OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state IN ('running','cancelled')) OR
     (OLD.state IN ('running', 'waiting') AND NEW.state IN ('running', 'waiting',
     'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' THEN
    IF OLD.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
     OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state='failed')
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND (s.state='cancelled' OR
       (s.state='failed' AND
        (s.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR s.created_task_id IS NOT NULL))))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run retry denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF ROW(NEW.last_command_key,NEW.last_command_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM
    ROW(OLD.last_command_key,OLD.last_command_digest) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'run command identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   -- tasks.view is decided by the UPDATE policy before any row reaches here.
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR (NEW.state<>'cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run transition denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
   clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
    WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state<>'completed')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unfinished run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO run FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun r WHERE r.id=NEW.run_id
   AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF run.id IS NULL OR NOT (run.started_by_id=actor AND
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.state='cancelled' AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL) AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id,
   NULL))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
   IF NEW.position>=jsonb_array_length(definition.steps) OR NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NEW.fencing_token<>0 OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL OR
    NEW.error_code<>''
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until', 'wake_at',
   'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until',
    'wake_at', 'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled')
    OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NOT (
     NEW.state='pending' AND run.state='pending'
     AND OLD.operation_id IS NULL AND OLD.created_task_id IS NULL))
    OR OLD.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.operation_id
    OR OLD.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.created_task_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.created_task_id
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.error_code<>''
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step retry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state='running' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token+1 OR NEW.claim_until IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid fencing claim' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state IN ('waiting','completed','failed','cancelled') THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR (OLD.state<>'running' AND
    NEW.state<>'cancelled')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
   WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   o.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND o.kind='action' AND o.subject_type='workflows.step' AND o.subject_id=NEW.id
    AND o.actor_id=run.started_by_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step operation mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.workflows_task t
   WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step task mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='completed' THEN
   item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
   IF item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
     AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
     AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
     AND t.state='done')
    OR item->>'handler'='timer' AND (
     NEW.wake_at IS NULL OR NEW.wake_at>clinic_app.workflows_now())
    OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
     WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.status='delivered')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow effect is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='waiting' THEN
    item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
    IF NEW.wake_at IS NULL
     OR item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
      AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
      AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
      AND t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress'))
     OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NEW.operation_id IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow waiting receipt is missing'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"
function workflows_guard().prosrc:
"
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 run clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun;
 definition clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion;
 ref jsonb; item jsonb; allowed boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',
 true), '')::uuid
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow scope mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;


 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='UPDATE'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_close_valid(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW))
 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.retention_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.orders_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.workflows_care_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.workflows_release_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'open'
   OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'' OR NEW.revision<>1
   OR NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' OR NEW.escalated_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL OR NEW.last_command_digest<>''
   OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task parent
    WHERE parent.id=NEW.depends_on_id AND parent.id<>NEW.id
    AND parent.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND parent.organization_id=NEW.organization_id))
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.subject_ref, NEW.organization_id,
   NEW.clinic_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.state IN ('done','cancelled') OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
   OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision', 'escalated_at', 'last_command_key', 'last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision','escalated_at','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF ROW(NEW.owner_user_id, NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,
   OLD.owner_role) THEN
    -- owner_valid decides tasks.assign; the UPDATE policy already limits a
    -- non-manager's rows to own open tasks and owned work, so a self-claim
    -- needs no second, unobservable copy of that visibility here.
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_owner_valid(NEW.clinic_id, NEW.owner_user_id,
    NEW.owner_role)
    OR NOT (clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM actor)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task assignment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   allowed := NEW.state=OLD.state OR (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state='assigned')
    OR (OLD.state='assigned' AND NEW.state='in_progress')
    OR (OLD.state='in_progress' AND NEW.state='done') OR NEW.state='cancelled';
   IF NOT allowed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task transition' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state IN ('in_progress','done') AND NEW.state<>OLD.state THEN
    IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.complete',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_owned(OLD.clinic_id,OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role)
    OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS
     (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.depends_on_id
      AND t.state='done'))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task completion denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task cancellation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.escalated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escalated_at AND
    (OLD.escalated_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.escalated_at IS NULL
     OR NEW.due_at>statement_timestamp()
     OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid escalation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.state='open' AND (NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'')
   OR NEW.state IN ('assigned', 'in_progress', 'done') AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NULL
   AND NEW.owner_role=''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='done' THEN
   IF NEW.kind='checklist' THEN allowed :=
   NEW.completion_evidence='{"checked":true}'::jsonb;
   ELSE allowed := jsonb_typeof(NEW.completion_evidence)='object'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence ?& ARRAY['record','outcome']
    AND NEW.completion_evidence-ARRAY['record','outcome']='{}'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence->>'outcome' IN ('reviewed','resolved','escalated')
    AND clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.completion_evidence->'record',
    NEW.organization_id, NEW.clinic_id);
   END IF;
   IF allowed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task evidence' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'premature task evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_taskcomment' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment is immutable' USING
  ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.author_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NOT
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR octet_length(NEW.body)>65536 OR NOT EXISTS
   (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND ((t.state='open' AND
    t.created_by_id=actor)
     OR clinic_app.workflows_owned(t.clinic_id,t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role)
     OR clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',t.clinic_id,NULL)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowdefinitionversion' THEN
  IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.key!~'^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$'
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_steps_valid(NEW.steps)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    'clinic-workflow-definition-v1:'||NEW.clinic_id::text||':'||NEW.key,0));
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'draft'
    OR NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.revision<>1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_digest<>'' OR NEW.creation_fingerprint<>NEW.fingerprint
    OR NEW.version<>(SELECT COALESCE(max(d.version),0)+1 FROM
     clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
     WHERE d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND d.key=NEW.key)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   NEW.created_at := statement_timestamp();
  ELSE
   IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
    OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest']) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state IN ('draft','validated') AND NEW.state='draft' THEN
    IF NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.state='draft' AND NEW.state='validated' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.published_by_id,NEW.published_at,
     NEW.retired_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at,OLD.retired_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition validation changed content'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.validated_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='validated' AND NEW.state='published' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.retired_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,OLD.validated_at,OLD.retired_at)
     OR NEW.published_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'publication changed content' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.published_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='published' AND NEW.state='retired' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.published_by_id,
     NEW.published_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.validated_at,OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'published definition is immutable'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.retired_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition transition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowrun' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
    WHERE d.id=NEW.definition_version_id AND d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND
    d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   IF definition.id IS NULL OR definition.state<>'published'
    OR NEW.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR
   NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.context_refs)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   FOR ref IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.context_refs) LOOP
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(ref,NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
   FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition.steps) LOOP
    IF item->>'handler'='task' AND
    (item->>'subject')::int>=jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled') OR NOT (
     (OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state IN ('running','cancelled')) OR
     (OLD.state IN ('running', 'waiting') AND NEW.state IN ('running', 'waiting',
     'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' THEN
    IF OLD.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
     OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state='failed')
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND (s.state='cancelled' OR
       (s.state='failed' AND
        (s.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR s.created_task_id IS NOT NULL))))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run retry denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF ROW(NEW.last_command_key,NEW.last_command_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM
    ROW(OLD.last_command_key,OLD.last_command_digest) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'run command identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   -- tasks.view is decided by the UPDATE policy before any row reaches here.
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR (NEW.state<>'cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run transition denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
   clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
    WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state<>'completed')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unfinished run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO run FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun r WHERE r.id=NEW.run_id
   AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF run.id IS NULL OR NOT (run.started_by_id=actor AND
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.state='cancelled' AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL) AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id,
   NULL))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
   IF NEW.position>=jsonb_array_length(definition.steps) OR NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NEW.fencing_token<>0 OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL OR
    NEW.error_code<>''
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until', 'wake_at',
   'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until',
    'wake_at', 'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled')
    OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NOT (
     NEW.state='pending' AND run.state='pending'
     AND OLD.operation_id IS NULL AND OLD.created_task_id IS NULL))
    OR OLD.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.operation_id
    OR OLD.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.created_task_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.created_task_id
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.error_code<>''
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step retry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state='running' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token+1 OR NEW.claim_until IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid fencing claim' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state IN ('waiting','completed','failed','cancelled') THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR (OLD.state<>'running' AND
    NEW.state<>'cancelled')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
   WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   o.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND o.kind='action' AND o.subject_type='workflows.step' AND o.subject_id=NEW.id
    AND o.actor_id=run.started_by_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step operation mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.workflows_task t
   WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step task mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='completed' THEN
   item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
   IF item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
     AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
     AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
     AND t.state='done')
    OR item->>'handler'='timer' AND (
     NEW.wake_at IS NULL OR NEW.wake_at>clinic_app.workflows_now())
    OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
     WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.status='delivered')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow effect is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='waiting' THEN
    item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
    IF NEW.wake_at IS NULL
     OR item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
      AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
      AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
      AND t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress'))
     OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NEW.operation_id IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow waiting receipt is missing'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;

function ai_extraction_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_extraction_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE j clinic_app.ai_extractionjob; i clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation;
 a clinic_app.ai_aiartifact;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction history retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_extractionjob' THEN
  SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=NEW.invocation_id;
  SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.ai_aiartifact WHERE id=i.inputs_ref_id;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.user_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (i.organization_id,i.clinic_id,i.user_id)
  OR a.patient_enrollment_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.patient_enrollment_id
  OR i.purpose<>'extraction' OR a.method<>'extract'
  OR NEW.sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.rotations)<>'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.rotations) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.rotations) x
   WHERE x::text NOT IN ('0','90','180','270'))
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_extraction_source_allowed(NEW.clinic_id,
   NEW.patient_enrollment_id,NEW.result_version_id,NEW.attachment_id,NEW.sha256)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO j FROM clinic_app.ai_extractionjob WHERE id=NEW.job_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (j.organization_id,j.clinic_id) OR NOT clinic_app.ai_extraction_job_allowed(j.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('ai-extraction:'||j.id,0));
   SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.ai_aiartifact
    WHERE invocation_id=j.invocation_id AND kind='output';
   SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=j.invocation_id;
   IF j.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid OR i.status<>'succeeded'
   OR NEW.status NOT IN ('candidate','ambiguous') OR a.id IS NULL
   OR NEW.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM a.expires_at
   OR NEW.expires_at<=statement_timestamp()
   OR octet_length(NEW.payload) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 16384
   OR NEW.observation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reviewed_by_id IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.position NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 127
   OR NEW.position<>(SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.ai_extractioncandidate c
    WHERE c.job_id=j.id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction proposal denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','observation_id','reviewed_by_id','reviewed_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','observation_id','reviewed_by_id','reviewed_at'])
   OR OLD.status NOT IN ('candidate','ambiguous')
   OR NOT (NEW.status='rejected' OR (OLD.status='candidate' AND NEW.status='confirmed'))
   OR NEW.reviewed_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
   OR NEW.reviewed_at IS NULL OR NEW.expires_at<=statement_timestamp()
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission(
    'clinical.write',j.clinic_id,j.patient_enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction decision denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   NEW.reviewed_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function ai_extraction_job_allowed(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_extraction_job_allowed(job uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_extractionjob j
 WHERE j.id=job AND j.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND clinic_app.ai_extraction_source_allowed(j.clinic_id,j.patient_enrollment_id,
  j.result_version_id,j.attachment_id,j.sha256))
$function$
"
function ai_extraction_job_allowed(uuid).prosrc:
"
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_extractionjob j
 WHERE j.id=job AND j.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND clinic_app.ai_extraction_source_allowed(j.clinic_id,j.patient_enrollment_id,
  j.result_version_id,j.attachment_id,j.sha256))
"

function ai_extraction_source_allowed(uu.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_extraction_source_allowed(clinic uuid, enrollment uuid, version uuid, attachment uuid, digest text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 AND ((version IS NOT NULL AND attachment IS NULL AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion v
  JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m ON m.version_id=v.id
   AND m.clinic_id=v.clinic_id AND m.organization_id=v.organization_id
  JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.id=m.order_id
   AND o.clinic_id=v.clinic_id AND o.organization_id=v.organization_id
  WHERE v.id=version AND v.clinic_id=clinic AND v.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
   AND v.sha256=digest AND o.enrollment_id=enrollment
   AND clinic_app.orders_is_current(v.id)
   AND clinic_app.has_permission('result.read',clinic,enrollment)))
 OR (version IS NULL AND attachment IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicalattachment a
  JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e ON e.patient_id=a.patient_id

  WHERE a.id=attachment AND a.clinic_id=clinic AND a.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
   AND a.state='available' AND a.sha256=digest AND e.id=enrollment
   AND clinic_app.ehr_care(a.encounter_id))))
$function$
"

"

 AND ((version IS NOT NULL AND attachment IS NULL AND EXISTS(

 OR (version IS NULL AND attachment IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(

function ai_imported_observation(uuid, u.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_imported_observation(observation uuid, version uuid, clinic uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$

 JOIN clinic_app.ai_extractionjob j ON j.id=c.job_id
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultversion v ON v.id=version
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m ON m.version_id=v.id
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.id=m.order_id
 WHERE c.observation_id=observation AND c.status='confirmed'
 AND c.reviewed_by_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid AND c.clinic_id=clinic
 AND c.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND j.clinic_id=clinic
 AND j.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND v.clinic_id=clinic

 AND o.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND o.enrollment_id=j.patient_enrollment_id

function ai_review_extraction(uuid, uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_review_extraction(requested uuid, target uuid, decision text, source bytea, kek text)
 RETURNS TABLE(observation_id uuid, created boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE c clinic_app.ai_extractioncandidate; j clinic_app.ai_extractionjob;
 v clinic_app.orders_resultversion; p jsonb; expected jsonb; parsed text;
 identifier uuid; actor uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO c FROM clinic_app.ai_extractioncandidate WHERE id=requested;
 SELECT * INTO j FROM clinic_app.ai_extractionjob WHERE id=c.job_id;
 IF c.id IS NULL OR c.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 OR NOT clinic_app.ai_extraction_job_allowed(j.id)
 OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',j.clinic_id,j.patient_enrollment_id)
 OR decision IS NULL OR decision NOT IN ('confirmed','rejected') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF decision='confirmed' THEN
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion WHERE id=target;
  IF v.id IS NULL OR (v.organization_id,v.clinic_id,v.sha256) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (j.organization_id,j.clinic_id,j.sha256)
  OR (j.result_version_id IS NOT NULL AND j.result_version_id<>v.id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||v.result_id,0));
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO c FROM clinic_app.ai_extractioncandidate WHERE id=requested FOR UPDATE;
 IF c.status=decision AND c.reviewed_by_id=actor AND
   (decision='rejected' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultobservation o
     WHERE o.id=c.observation_id AND o.version_id=target))
 THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT c.observation_id,false; RETURN; END IF;
 IF c.status NOT IN ('candidate','ambiguous') OR c.expires_at<=statement_timestamp()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction decision stale' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
 IF decision='rejected' THEN
  UPDATE clinic_app.ai_extractioncandidate SET status='rejected',
   reviewed_by_id=actor,reviewed_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=c.id;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT NULL::uuid,true; RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF c.status<>'candidate' OR NOT clinic_app.orders_is_current(v.id)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m
  JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.id=m.order_id
   AND o.organization_id=j.organization_id AND o.clinic_id=j.clinic_id
  WHERE m.version_id=v.id AND m.organization_id=j.organization_id
  AND m.clinic_id=j.clinic_id AND o.enrollment_id=j.patient_enrollment_id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultacknowledgment a
  WHERE a.version_id=v.id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction filing denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 p:=convert_from(clinic_app.tenant_decrypt(
  kek,'ai.extraction.candidate.v1',c.payload),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction value unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT p ?& ARRAY['field','kind','raw_text','value','parsed_value','unit',
  'reference_interval','region','status','reason']
 OR p-ARRAY['field','kind','raw_text','value','parsed_value','unit',
  'reference_interval','region','status','reason']<>'{}'::jsonb
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(p) x WHERE x.key<>'region'
  AND jsonb_typeof(x.value)<>'string')
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'region') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction value unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT (p->'region') ?& ARRAY['page','bbox']
 OR (p->'region')-ARRAY['page','bbox']<>'{}'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'region'->'page') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR p->'region'->>'page'!~'^[1-9][0-9]?$'
 OR (p->'region'->>'page')::int>jsonb_array_length(j.rotations)
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'region'->'bbox') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction region unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p->'region'->'bbox')<>4
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'region'->'bbox') x
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'number' OR x::text!~'^[0-9]{1,5}$'
  OR x::text::int>10000)
 OR (p->'region'->'bbox'->>0)::int>=(p->'region'->'bbox'->>2)::int
 OR (p->'region'->'bbox'->>1)::int>=(p->'region'->'bbox'->>3)::int THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction region unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF p->>'status'<>'candidate' OR p->>'reason'<>''
 OR p->>'field'!~'^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$'
 OR length(p->>'raw_text')>1024 OR length(p->>'value') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128
 OR length(p->>'reference_interval')>256
 OR position(p->>'value' IN p->>'raw_text')=0
 OR (p->>'reference_interval'<>'' AND
  position(p->>'reference_interval' IN p->>'raw_text')=0)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction value unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF p->>'kind'='decimal' THEN
  IF p->>'value'!~('^[+-]?((0|[1-9][0-9]*)(,[0-9]+)?|'
   '[1-9][0-9]{0,2}(\.[0-9]{3})+,[0-9]+)$')
  OR p->>'unit'<>ALL(ARRAY['mg/dL','g/dL','mmol/L','mEq/L','U/L','ng/mL','pg/mL',
   'mcg/L',U&'\00B5g/L',U&'10^3/\00B5L',U&'10^6/\00B5L',
   '%','mL','L','kg','g','cm','m',
   'mmHg','bpm','kg/m2','1'])
  OR position(p->>'unit' IN p->>'raw_text')=0 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction value unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  parsed:=replace(replace(p->>'value','.',''),',','.');
 ELSIF p->>'kind'='date' AND p->>'unit'='' AND
  p->>'value'~'^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$' THEN
  BEGIN
   parsed:=to_char(make_date(substring(p->>'value',7,4)::int,
    substring(p->>'value',4,2)::int,substring(p->>'value',1,2)::int),'YYYY-MM-DD');
  EXCEPTION WHEN datetime_field_overflow THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction value unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction value unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF parsed IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'parsed_value' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction value unresolved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('code',p->>'field','value',p->>'value',
  'parsed_value',parsed,'unit',p->>'unit','reference_interval',p->>'reference_interval',
  'abnormal_flag','','provenance','imported','confirmer',actor::text,
  'page',p->'region'->'page','bbox',p->'region'->'bbox','raw_text',p->>'raw_text',
  'extraction_candidate',c.id::text);
 IF convert_from(clinic_app.tenant_decrypt(
  kek,'orders.observation.source',source),'UTF8')::jsonb
  IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction payload mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 identifier:=gen_random_uuid();
 -- The FK is deferred. The uncommitted marker admits only this exact row,
 -- created in this function, and cannot be forged through runtime table ACLs.
 UPDATE clinic_app.ai_extractioncandidate SET status='confirmed',
  reviewed_by_id=actor,reviewed_at=statement_timestamp(),observation_id=identifier
  WHERE id=c.id;
 INSERT INTO clinic_app.orders_resultobservation
 (id,organization_id,clinic_id,created_at,version_id,position,source)
 VALUES(identifier,j.organization_id,j.clinic_id,statement_timestamp(),v.id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.orders_resultobservation o
   WHERE o.version_id=v.id),source);
 RETURN QUERY SELECT identifier,true;
EXCEPTION WHEN data_exception THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction data invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END $function$
"

function orders_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.orders_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE o clinic_app.orders_order; v clinic_app.orders_resultversion;
 previous clinic_app.orders_orderevent; matched clinic_app.orders_resultmatch;
 enrollment uuid; permission text; valid boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_labaccount' AND TG_OP='UPDATE'
  AND session_user='clinic_owner' AND current_setting('role')<>'clinic_app'
  AND OLD.active AND NOT NEW.active AND
  (to_jsonb(NEW)-'active')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'active') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'order/result history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid result scope' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
 WHEN 'orders_labaccount' THEN
  IF session_user<>'clinic_owner' OR current_setting('role')='clinic_app'
  OR NEW.provider<>'synthetic-lab-v1' OR NEW.signing_key_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_serviceprincipal p
   WHERE p.id=NEW.principal_id AND p.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.active AND p.purpose='lab_ingest')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid lab account' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_order' THEN
  IF NEW.ordered_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('order.place',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
  WHERE e.id=NEW.enrollment_id AND e.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
  AND e.organization_id=NEW.organization_id)
  OR NEW.fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR (NEW.lab_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_labaccount a
  WHERE a.id=NEW.lab_account_id AND a.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
  AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.active))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'order denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_orderitem', 'orders_orderevent' THEN
  SELECT * INTO o FROM clinic_app.orders_order r WHERE r.id=NEW.order_id
  AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF o.id IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission(
  'order.place',NEW.clinic_id,o.enrollment_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'order denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||o.id,0));
  SELECT * INTO previous FROM clinic_app.orders_orderevent e
   WHERE e.order_id=o.id ORDER BY e.sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_orderitem' THEN
   IF previous.state IS NOT NULL OR NEW.catalog_version<>1
   OR NEW.exam_code NOT IN ('cbc','urinalysis') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'order items immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF NEW.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
   OR NEW.sequence<>coalesce(previous.sequence,0)+1 OR NOT (
    (previous.id IS NULL AND NEW.state='draft') OR
    (previous.state='draft' AND NEW.state='placed') OR
    (previous.state='placed' AND NEW.state IN ('collected','in_process')) OR
    (previous.state='collected' AND NEW.state='in_process'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'order transition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_result' THEN
  IF NOT (clinic_app.orders_lab_account(NEW.clinic_id) IS NOT NULL
  OR clinic_app.has_permission('demographics.read',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'result denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_resultversion' THEN
  IF NOT clinic_app.orders_ingest_allowed(NEW.clinic_id,NEW.proposed_order_id)
  OR NEW.uploader_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR NEW.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM clinic_app.orders_lab_account(NEW.clinic_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_result r
  WHERE r.id=NEW.result_id AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
  AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'result denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||NEW.result_id,0));
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r
   WHERE r.result_id=NEW.result_id ORDER BY r.number DESC LIMIT 1;
  SELECT * INTO matched FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m
   WHERE m.version_id=v.id;
  IF NEW.number<>coalesce(v.number,0)+1 OR NEW.predecessor_id IS DISTINCT FROM v.id
  OR (v.id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.proposed_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM
   coalesce(matched.order_id,v.proposed_order_id)
   OR NEW.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM v.lab_account_id))
  OR NEW.storage_key!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR NEW.sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR octet_length(NEW.identity)<68
  OR NEW.size_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760
  OR NEW.content_type NOT IN ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid source version' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_resultobservation' THEN
  IF octet_length(NEW.source)>=68 AND clinic_app.ai_imported_observation(
    NEW.id,NEW.version_id,NEW.clinic_id) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r WHERE r.id=NEW.version_id;
  IF v.clinic_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.clinic_id
  OR v.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id
  OR NOT clinic_app.orders_ingest_allowed(NEW.clinic_id,v.proposed_order_id)
  OR v.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM clinic_app.orders_lab_account(NEW.clinic_id)
  OR v.uploader_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR octet_length(NEW.source)<68
  OR NEW.position<>(SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.orders_resultobservation r
    WHERE r.version_id=v.id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m WHERE m.version_id=v.id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultquarantine q WHERE q.version_id=v.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid source observation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r WHERE r.id=NEW.version_id;
  IF v.clinic_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.clinic_id
  OR v.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid result scope' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('orders_resultacknowledgment','orders_resultrelease',
    'orders_resultrejection') THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||v.result_id,0));
   IF NOT clinic_app.orders_is_current(v.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'source superseded' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
   SELECT * INTO matched FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m WHERE m.version_id=v.id;
   SELECT r.enrollment_id INTO enrollment FROM clinic_app.orders_order r
    WHERE r.id=matched.order_id;
   IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultrejection' THEN
    valid:=clinic_app.has_permission('order.route',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     AND NEW.operator_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
     AND matched.id IS NULL AND NEW.evidence_code IN (
      'wrong_patient_confirmed','invalid_source_confirmed')
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultquarantine q
       WHERE q.version_id=v.id);
   ELSE
    permission:=CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultacknowledgment'
     THEN 'result.acknowledge' ELSE 'result.release' END;
    valid:=matched.id IS NOT NULL AND
     clinic_app.has_permission(permission,NEW.clinic_id,enrollment);
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultacknowledgment' THEN
     valid:=valid AND NEW.reviewer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
      AND NEW.disposition IN ('no_action','follow_up','urgent_review');
    ELSE
     valid:=valid AND NEW.released_by_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultacknowledgment a
       WHERE a.id=NEW.acknowledgment_id AND a.version_id=v.id)
      AND ((NEW.audience='patient' AND NEW.delegate_grant_id IS NULL)
       OR (NEW.audience='delegate' AND clinic_app.orders_delegate_allowed(
        v.id,NEW.delegate_grant_id)));
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF valid IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'result action denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  END IF;
 END CASE;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

  OR NEW.provider<>'synthetic-lab-v1' OR NEW.signing_key_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_serviceprincipal p
   WHERE p.id=NEW.principal_id AND p.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.active AND p.purpose='lab_ingest')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid lab account' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_order' THEN
  IF NEW.ordered_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('order.place',NEW.clinic_id,NEW.enrollment_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
  WHERE e.id=NEW.enrollment_id AND e.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
  AND e.organization_id=NEW.organization_id)
  OR NEW.fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR (NEW.lab_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_labaccount a
  WHERE a.id=NEW.lab_account_id AND a.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
  AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.active))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'order denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_orderitem', 'orders_orderevent' THEN
  SELECT * INTO o FROM clinic_app.orders_order r WHERE r.id=NEW.order_id
  AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF o.id IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission(
  'order.place',NEW.clinic_id,o.enrollment_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'order denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||o.id,0));
  SELECT * INTO previous FROM clinic_app.orders_orderevent e
   WHERE e.order_id=o.id ORDER BY e.sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_orderitem' THEN
   IF previous.state IS NOT NULL OR NEW.catalog_version<>1
   OR NEW.exam_code NOT IN ('cbc','urinalysis') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'order items immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF NEW.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
   OR NEW.sequence<>coalesce(previous.sequence,0)+1 OR NOT (
    (previous.id IS NULL AND NEW.state='draft') OR
    (previous.state='draft' AND NEW.state='placed') OR
    (previous.state='placed' AND NEW.state IN ('collected','in_process')) OR
    (previous.state='collected' AND NEW.state='in_process'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'order transition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_result' THEN
  IF NOT (clinic_app.orders_lab_account(NEW.clinic_id) IS NOT NULL
  OR clinic_app.has_permission('demographics.read',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'result denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_resultversion' THEN
  IF NOT clinic_app.orders_ingest_allowed(NEW.clinic_id,NEW.proposed_order_id)
  OR NEW.uploader_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR NEW.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM clinic_app.orders_lab_account(NEW.clinic_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_result r
  WHERE r.id=NEW.result_id AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
  AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'result denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||NEW.result_id,0));
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r
   WHERE r.result_id=NEW.result_id ORDER BY r.number DESC LIMIT 1;
  SELECT * INTO matched FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m
   WHERE m.version_id=v.id;
  IF NEW.number<>coalesce(v.number,0)+1 OR NEW.predecessor_id IS DISTINCT FROM v.id
  OR (v.id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.proposed_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM
   coalesce(matched.order_id,v.proposed_order_id)
   OR NEW.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM v.lab_account_id))
  OR NEW.storage_key!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR NEW.sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR octet_length(NEW.identity)<68
  OR NEW.size_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760
  OR NEW.content_type NOT IN ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid source version' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'orders_resultobservation' THEN
  IF octet_length(NEW.source)>=68 AND clinic_app.ai_imported_observation(
    NEW.id,NEW.version_id,NEW.clinic_id) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r WHERE r.id=NEW.version_id;
  IF v.clinic_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.clinic_id
  OR v.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id
  OR NOT clinic_app.orders_ingest_allowed(NEW.clinic_id,v.proposed_order_id)
  OR v.lab_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM clinic_app.orders_lab_account(NEW.clinic_id)
  OR v.uploader_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR octet_length(NEW.source)<68
  OR NEW.position<>(SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.orders_resultobservation r
    WHERE r.version_id=v.id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m WHERE m.version_id=v.id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultquarantine q WHERE q.version_id=v.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid source observation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.orders_resultversion r WHERE r.id=NEW.version_id;
  IF v.clinic_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.clinic_id
  OR v.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid result scope' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('orders_resultacknowledgment','orders_resultrelease',
    'orders_resultrejection') THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('orders-series:'||v.result_id,0));
   IF NOT clinic_app.orders_is_current(v.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'source superseded' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
   SELECT * INTO matched FROM clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m WHERE m.version_id=v.id;
   SELECT r.enrollment_id INTO enrollment FROM clinic_app.orders_order r
    WHERE r.id=matched.order_id;
   IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultrejection' THEN
    valid:=clinic_app.has_permission('order.route',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     AND NEW.operator_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
     AND matched.id IS NULL AND NEW.evidence_code IN (
      'wrong_patient_confirmed','invalid_source_confirmed')
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultquarantine q
       WHERE q.version_id=v.id);
   ELSE
    permission:=CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultacknowledgment'
     THEN 'result.acknowledge' ELSE 'result.release' END;
    valid:=matched.id IS NOT NULL AND
     clinic_app.has_permission(permission,NEW.clinic_id,enrollment);
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME='orders_resultacknowledgment' THEN
     valid:=valid AND NEW.reviewer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
      AND NEW.disposition IN ('no_action','follow_up','urgent_review');
    ELSE
     valid:=valid AND NEW.released_by_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultacknowledgment a
       WHERE a.id=NEW.acknowledgment_id AND a.version_id=v.id)
      AND ((NEW.audience='patient' AND NEW.delegate_grant_id IS NULL)
       OR (NEW.audience='delegate' AND clinic_app.orders_delegate_allowed(
        v.id,NEW.delegate_grant_id)));
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF valid IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'result action denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  END IF;
 END CASE;
 RETURN NEW;
END "

function ai_eval_activation_allowed(uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_activation_allowed(candidate uuid, clinic uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_modelchangerequest c
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun r ON r.id=c.run_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol p ON p.id=r.protocol_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration m ON m.id=c.configuration_id
 WHERE m.id=candidate AND c.clinic_id=clinic
 AND c.status='approved' AND r.status='passed'
 AND r.configuration_id=m.id AND r.configuration_version=m.version
 AND r.versions->>'prompt'=m.prompt_sha256
 AND r.versions->>'retrieval'=m.retrieval_sha256
 AND r.versions->>'schema'=m.schema_sha256
 AND clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(r.id)='passed'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
  WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
  AND newer.version>p.version))
$function$
"
function ai_eval_activation_allowed(uuid.prosrc:
"
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_modelchangerequest c
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun r ON r.id=c.run_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol p ON p.id=r.protocol_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration m ON m.id=c.configuration_id
 WHERE m.id=candidate AND c.clinic_id=clinic
 AND c.status='approved' AND r.status='passed'

 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
  WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
  AND newer.version>p.version))
"

function ai_eval_model_gate().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_model_gate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND (
 NEW.prompt_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 OR NEW.retrieval_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 OR NEW.schema_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation source binding required' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.state='active' AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_modelchangerequest c
  WHERE c.configuration_id=NEW.id AND c.status='approved'
  AND clinic_app.ai_eval_activation_allowed(NEW.id,c.clinic_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'passing evaluation and owner approval required'
  USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function ai_eval_rating_visible(uuid, te.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_rating_visible(subject uuid, case_key text, human uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT clinic_app.ai_eval_run_visible(subject) AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun r WHERE r.id=subject AND (
 human=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
 OR (r.status IN('passed','failed') AND clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(r.clinic_id,'owner'))
 OR (r.adjudicator_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
 AND 2=(SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating v
  WHERE v.run_id=r.id AND v.case_id=case_key AND v.slot IN('rater_one','rater_two')))))
$function$
"

function ai_eval_record_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_record_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 tenant uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 p clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol; r clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun;
 m clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration; t jsonb; previous integer;
 one jsonb; two jsonb; assigned uuid; expected_capability text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation history retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM tenant OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
 WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationprotocol' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.registered_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
   'ai-eval-protocol:'||NEW.clinic_id||':'||NEW.capability,0));
  SELECT coalesce(max(version),0) INTO previous FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol
   WHERE clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND capability=NEW.capability;
  t:=NEW.thresholds_document::jsonb;
  IF NEW.version<>previous+1 OR NEW.capability!~'^AI-0[1-8]$'
  OR NEW.corpus_version<>'engineering-v1' OR NEW.corpus_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.clinical_owner_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
  OR octet_length(NEW.thresholds_document)>4096
  OR NEW.thresholds_sha256<>encode(clinic_app.digest(
   convert_to(NEW.thresholds_document,'UTF8')::bytea,'sha256'::text),'hex')
  OR jsonb_typeof(t)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(t))<>8
  OR NOT t ?& ARRAY['minimum_cases','minimum_encounters','maximum_critical_errors',
   'maximum_error_rate_ppm','minimum_citation_support_ppm',
   'minimum_action_correctness_ppm','bootstrap_seed','bootstrap_iterations']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(t) x WHERE x.value!~'^[0-9]+$')
  OR (t->>'minimum_cases')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR (t->>'minimum_encounters')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 2 AND (t->>'minimum_cases')::integer
  OR (t->>'maximum_critical_errors')::bigint<>0
  OR (t->>'maximum_error_rate_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_citation_support_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_action_correctness_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_seed')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_iterations')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 10000
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.case_manifest)<>'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x))<>6
   OR NOT x ?& ARRAY['id','encounter','specialty','device','accent','adversarial']
   OR x->>'id'!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$'
   OR x->>'encounter'!~'^synthetic-encounter-[0-9]{2}$'
   OR x->>'specialty' NOT IN('general','pediatrics','internal')
   OR x->>'device' NOT IN('synthetic-microphone','synthetic-phone',
    'synthetic-headset','synthetic-failed-microphone')
   OR x->>'accent' NOT IN('flite-kal','flite-slt','flite-rms')
   OR x->>'adversarial' NOT IN('accents','noise','caregiver_child','interruptions',
    'conflicting_records','mic_failure','decimal_commas','ambiguous_abbreviations',
    'wrong_patient_attachments','stale_permissions','malicious_content','negation')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(x) entry
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value)<>'string'))
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id')
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation registration' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrun' THEN
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=NEW.protocol_id;
  SELECT * INTO m FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration WHERE id=NEW.configuration_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   expected_capability:=CASE m.purpose WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN 'AI-01'
    WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN 'AI-01' WHEN 'brief' THEN 'AI-02'
    WHEN 'extraction' THEN 'AI-03' WHEN 'front_desk' THEN 'AI-04'
    WHEN 'analyst' THEN 'AI-07' WHEN 'decision_support' THEN 'AI-08' END;
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
   OR NEW.status<>'pending' OR NEW.sample_results IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.automatic_failures<>0 OR NEW.configuration_version<>m.version
   OR p.capability IS DISTINCT FROM expected_capability
   OR NEW.versions->>'prompt' IS DISTINCT FROM m.prompt_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'retrieval' IS DISTINCT FROM m.retrieval_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM m.schema_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'model'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.versions)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.versions))<>5
   OR NEW.versions->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM m.version::text
   OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.rater_two_id OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.rater_two_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.created_by_id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
    WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
    AND newer.version>p.version)
   OR 3<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) FROM clinic_app.identity_user u
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole role ON role.user_id=u.id
    WHERE u.id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
    AND u.is_active AND role.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND role.organization_id=tenant AND role.role='physician'
    AND role.revoked_at IS NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'pending' OR
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation run immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status<>OLD.status THEN
    IF NEW.status NOT IN('passed','failed')
    OR NEW.status<>clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(NEW.id)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NULL
    OR (NEW.sample_results,NEW.automatic_failures,NEW.scored_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.sample_results,OLD.automatic_failures,OLD.scored_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation verdict' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.sample_results IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
    OR NEW.scored_at IS NULL OR NEW.sample_results IS NULL
    OR octet_length(NEW.sample_results) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 2097152
    OR NEW.automatic_failures>jsonb_array_length(p.case_manifest)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation observations' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   ELSE NEW.scored_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;

   WHEN 'rater_two' THEN r.rater_two_id WHEN 'adjudicator' THEN r.adjudicator_id END;

  OR assigned IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR assigned IS NULL

   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id) OR r.scored_at IS NULL OR r.status<>'pending'

   WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.case_id)

   OR (x.key='correction_ms' AND (x.value::text!~'^[0-9]+$'
    OR (x.value::text)::bigint>3600000)))

  IF NEW.slot='adjudicator' THEN
   SELECT labels INTO one FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating

   SELECT labels INTO two FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_two';
