   IF NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.status<>'requested'
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approval_ref<>''
   OR NEW.decided_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid model change' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'requested' OR NEW.status NOT IN('approved','rejected')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.decided_at IS NULL
   OR NEW.approved_by_id=NEW.requested_by_id
   OR NEW.approval_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
   OR (NEW.status='approved' AND (r.status<>'passed'
    OR clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(r.id)<>'passed'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
     WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
     AND newer.version>p.version)))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'model change lacks passing evaluation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.decided_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

   WHERE clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND capability=NEW.capability;

   OR 3<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) FROM clinic_app.identity_user u

    OR NEW.automatic_failures>jsonb_array_length(p.case_manifest)

"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_run_visible(subject uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'

 WHERE r.id=subject AND r.organization_id=
  NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid

function ai_eval_staff(uuid, text).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(clinic uuid, mode text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE mode
 WHEN 'clinician' THEN clinic_app.questionnaire_staff(clinic,ARRAY['physician'])
 WHEN 'owner' THEN clinic_app.questionnaire_staff(clinic,ARRAY['owner'])
 WHEN 'clinical_owner' THEN
  clinic_app.questionnaire_staff(clinic,ARRAY['physician'])
  AND clinic_app.questionnaire_staff(clinic,ARRAY['owner'])
 ELSE false END
$function$
"

function agent_staff(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_staff(clinic uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT clinic_app.has_permission('automation.admin',clinic,NULL)
 OR clinic_app.has_permission('automation.organization',clinic,NULL)
$function$
"

function ai_eval_record_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_record_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 tenant uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 p clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol; r clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun;
 m clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration; t jsonb; previous integer;
 one jsonb; two jsonb; assigned uuid; expected_capability text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation history retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM tenant OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
 WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationprotocol' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.registered_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
   'ai-eval-protocol:'||NEW.clinic_id||':'||NEW.capability,0));
  SELECT coalesce(max(version),0) INTO previous FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol
   WHERE clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND capability=NEW.capability;
  t:=NEW.thresholds_document::jsonb;
  IF NEW.version<>previous+1 OR NEW.capability!~'^AI-0[1-8]$'
  OR NEW.corpus_version<>'engineering-v1' OR NEW.corpus_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.clinical_owner_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
  OR octet_length(NEW.thresholds_document)>4096
  OR NEW.thresholds_sha256<>encode(clinic_app.digest(
   convert_to(NEW.thresholds_document,'UTF8')::bytea,'sha256'::text),'hex')
  OR jsonb_typeof(t)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(t))<>8
  OR NOT t ?& ARRAY['minimum_cases','minimum_encounters','maximum_critical_errors',
   'maximum_error_rate_ppm','minimum_citation_support_ppm',
   'minimum_action_correctness_ppm','bootstrap_seed','bootstrap_iterations']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(t) x WHERE x.value!~'^[0-9]+$')
  OR (t->>'minimum_cases')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR (t->>'minimum_encounters')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 2 AND (t->>'minimum_cases')::integer
  OR (t->>'maximum_critical_errors')::bigint<>0
  OR (t->>'maximum_error_rate_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_citation_support_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_action_correctness_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_seed')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_iterations')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 10000
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.case_manifest)<>'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x))<>6
   OR NOT x ?& ARRAY['id','encounter','specialty','device','accent','adversarial']
   OR x->>'id'!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$'
   OR x->>'encounter'!~'^synthetic-encounter-[0-9]{2}$'
   OR x->>'specialty' NOT IN('general','pediatrics','internal')
   OR x->>'device' NOT IN('synthetic-microphone','synthetic-phone',
    'synthetic-headset','synthetic-failed-microphone')
   OR x->>'accent' NOT IN('flite-kal','flite-slt','flite-rms')
   OR x->>'adversarial' NOT IN('accents','noise','caregiver_child','interruptions',
    'conflicting_records','mic_failure','decimal_commas','ambiguous_abbreviations',
    'wrong_patient_attachments','stale_permissions','malicious_content','negation')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(x) entry
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value)<>'string'))
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id')
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation registration' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrun' THEN
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=NEW.protocol_id;
  SELECT * INTO m FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration WHERE id=NEW.configuration_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   expected_capability:=CASE m.purpose WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN 'AI-01'
    WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN 'AI-01' WHEN 'brief' THEN 'AI-02'
    WHEN 'extraction' THEN 'AI-03' WHEN 'front_desk' THEN 'AI-04' WHEN 'care_coordination' THEN 'AI-05'
    WHEN 'analyst' THEN 'AI-07' WHEN 'decision_support' THEN 'AI-08' END;
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
   OR NEW.status<>'pending' OR NEW.sample_results IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.automatic_failures<>0 OR NEW.configuration_version<>m.version
   OR p.capability IS DISTINCT FROM expected_capability
   OR NEW.versions->>'prompt' IS DISTINCT FROM m.prompt_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'retrieval' IS DISTINCT FROM m.retrieval_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM m.schema_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'model'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.versions)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.versions))<>5
   OR NEW.versions->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM m.version::text
   OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.rater_two_id OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.rater_two_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.created_by_id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
    WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
    AND newer.version>p.version)
   OR 3<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) FROM clinic_app.identity_user u
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole role ON role.user_id=u.id
    WHERE u.id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
    AND u.is_active AND role.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND role.organization_id=tenant AND role.role='physician'
    AND role.revoked_at IS NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'pending' OR
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation run immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status<>OLD.status THEN
    IF NEW.status NOT IN('passed','failed')
    OR NEW.status<>clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(NEW.id)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NULL
    OR (NEW.sample_results,NEW.automatic_failures,NEW.scored_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.sample_results,OLD.automatic_failures,OLD.scored_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation verdict' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.sample_results IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
    OR NEW.scored_at IS NULL OR NEW.sample_results IS NULL
    OR octet_length(NEW.sample_results) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 2097152
    OR NEW.automatic_failures>jsonb_array_length(p.case_manifest)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation observations' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   ELSE NEW.scored_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrating' THEN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  assigned:=CASE NEW.slot WHEN 'rater_one' THEN r.rater_one_id
   WHEN 'rater_two' THEN r.rater_two_id WHEN 'adjudicator' THEN r.adjudicator_id END;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR assigned IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR assigned IS NULL
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinician')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id) OR r.scored_at IS NULL OR r.status<>'pending'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.case_manifest) x
   WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.case_id)
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.labels)<>'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.labels))<>16
  OR NOT NEW.labels ?& ARRAY['significant_omission','hallucination',
   'speaker_attribution','negation','chronology','units_decimals',
   'medication_name_dose','allergy_handling','unsupported_citation',
   'incorrect_action','policy_violation','unauthorized_effect','duplicate_effect',
   'missed_escalation','critical_error','correction_ms']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.labels) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value)<>'number'
   OR (x.key<>'correction_ms' AND x.value::text NOT IN('0','1'))
   OR (x.key='correction_ms' AND (x.value::text!~'^[0-9]+$'
    OR (x.value::text)::bigint>3600000)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation rating denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.slot='adjudicator' THEN
   SELECT labels INTO one FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_one';
   SELECT labels INTO two FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_two';
   IF one IS NULL OR two IS NULL OR (one-'correction_ms')=(two-'correction_ms')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adjudication not eligible' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  IF NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'owner')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.configuration_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id,r.configuration_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.status<>'requested'
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approval_ref<>''
   OR NEW.decided_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid model change' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'requested' OR NEW.status NOT IN('approved','rejected')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.decided_at IS NULL
   OR NEW.approved_by_id=NEW.requested_by_id
   OR NEW.approval_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
   OR (NEW.status='approved' AND (r.status<>'passed'
    OR clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(r.id)<>'passed'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
     WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
     AND newer.version>p.version)))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'model change lacks passing evaluation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.decided_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

  SELECT * INTO m FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration WHERE id=NEW.configuration_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   expected_capability:=CASE m.purpose WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN 'AI-01'
    WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN 'AI-01' WHEN 'brief' THEN 'AI-02'
    WHEN 'extraction' THEN 'AI-03' WHEN 'front_desk' THEN 'AI-04' WHEN 'care_coordination' THEN 'AI-05'
    WHEN 'analyst' THEN 'AI-07' WHEN 'decision_support' THEN 'AI-08' END;
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
   OR NEW.status<>'pending' OR NEW.sample_results IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.automatic_failures<>0 OR NEW.configuration_version<>m.version
   OR p.capability IS DISTINCT FROM expected_capability
   OR NEW.versions->>'prompt' IS DISTINCT FROM m.prompt_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'retrieval' IS DISTINCT FROM m.retrieval_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM m.schema_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'model'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.versions)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.versions))<>5
   OR NEW.versions->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM m.version::text
   OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.rater_two_id OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.rater_two_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.created_by_id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
    WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
    AND newer.version>p.version)
   OR 3<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) FROM clinic_app.identity_user u
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole role ON role.user_id=u.id
    WHERE u.id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
    AND u.is_active AND role.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND role.organization_id=tenant AND role.role='physician'
    AND role.revoked_at IS NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'pending' OR
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation run immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status<>OLD.status THEN
    IF NEW.status NOT IN('passed','failed')
    OR NEW.status<>clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(NEW.id)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NULL
    OR (NEW.sample_results,NEW.automatic_failures,NEW.scored_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.sample_results,OLD.automatic_failures,OLD.scored_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation verdict' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.sample_results IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
    OR NEW.scored_at IS NULL OR NEW.sample_results IS NULL
    OR octet_length(NEW.sample_results) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 2097152
    OR NEW.automatic_failures>jsonb_array_length(p.case_manifest)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation observations' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   ELSE NEW.scored_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrating' THEN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  assigned:=CASE NEW.slot WHEN 'rater_one' THEN r.rater_one_id
   WHEN 'rater_two' THEN r.rater_two_id WHEN 'adjudicator' THEN r.adjudicator_id END;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR assigned IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR assigned IS NULL
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinician')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id) OR r.scored_at IS NULL OR r.status<>'pending'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.case_manifest) x
   WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.case_id)
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.labels)<>'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.labels))<>16
  OR NOT NEW.labels ?& ARRAY['significant_omission','hallucination',
   'speaker_attribution','negation','chronology','units_decimals',
   'medication_name_dose','allergy_handling','unsupported_citation',
   'incorrect_action','policy_violation','unauthorized_effect','duplicate_effect',
   'missed_escalation','critical_error','correction_ms']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.labels) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value)<>'number'
   OR (x.key<>'correction_ms' AND x.value::text NOT IN('0','1'))
   OR (x.key='correction_ms' AND (x.value::text!~'^[0-9]+$'
    OR (x.value::text)::bigint>3600000)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation rating denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.slot='adjudicator' THEN
   SELECT labels INTO one FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_one';
   SELECT labels INTO two FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_two';
   IF one IS NULL OR two IS NULL OR (one-'correction_ms')=(two-'correction_ms')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adjudication not eligible' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  IF NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'owner')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.configuration_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id,r.configuration_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.status<>'requested'
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approval_ref<>''
   OR NEW.decided_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid model change' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'requested' OR NEW.status NOT IN('approved','rejected')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.decided_at IS NULL
   OR NEW.approved_by_id=NEW.requested_by_id
   OR NEW.approval_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
   OR (NEW.status='approved' AND (r.status<>'passed'
    OR clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(r.id)<>'passed'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
     WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
     AND newer.version>p.version)))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'model change lacks passing evaluation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.decided_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END "

function ai_policy_valid(jsonb).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_policy_valid(policy jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE item record; p text;
BEGIN
 IF policy='{}'::jsonb THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(policy)<>'object'
 OR policy-ARRAY['enabled','purposes','monthly_budget_micros','purpose_budgets']
   <>'{}'::jsonb
 OR NOT policy ?& ARRAY['enabled','purposes','monthly_budget_micros',
   'purpose_budgets']
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'enabled')<>'boolean'
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'purposes')<>'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'purpose_budgets')<>'object'
 OR policy->>'monthly_budget_micros' !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$'
 OR (policy->>'monthly_budget_micros')::numeric>1000000000000000
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(policy->'purposes') x
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'string')
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes'))
 <> (SELECT count(DISTINCT x) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes') x)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 FOR p IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes') LOOP
  IF p<>ALL(ARRAY['scribe_asr','scribe_draft','brief','extraction',
   'front_desk','analyst','decision_support','care_coordination'])
  OR NOT (policy->'purpose_budgets') ? p THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_each(policy->'purpose_budgets') LOOP
  IF item.key<>ALL(ARRAY['scribe_asr','scribe_draft','brief','extraction',
   'front_desk','analyst','decision_support','care_coordination'])
  OR jsonb_typeof(item.value)<>'number'
  OR item.value::text !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$'
  OR item.value::numeric>1000000000000000 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_typeof(policy->'monthly_budget_micros')='number';
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range
 OR invalid_parameter_value THEN RETURN false;
END $function$
"

function ai_staff(uuid, text, uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_staff(clinic uuid, purpose text, enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE purpose
 WHEN 'front_desk' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.read',clinic,NULL)
 WHEN 'analyst' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('charge.read',clinic,NULL)
 WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'brief' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'extraction' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'decision_support' THEN
  clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'care_coordination' THEN
  clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 ELSE false END
$function$
"

function insurance_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.insurance_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE row_data jsonb; prior jsonb; links jsonb; link record; allowed boolean;
 matched boolean; old_state text; new_state text; approval_clinic uuid;
 guide clinic_app.insurance_guide; batch clinic_app.insurance_batch;
 appeal clinic_app.insurance_appeal; invoice clinic_app.billing_invoice;
 membership clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership; source_clinic uuid;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 row_data:=to_jsonb(NEW);
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
 'insurance-clinic-v1:'||NEW.clinic_id::text,0));
 allowed:=clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.manage',NEW.clinic_id,NULL);
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_clinicalapproval' THEN
  allowed:=clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.clinical_approve',NEW.clinic_id,NULL);
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_commandreceipt'
  AND row_data->>'kind'='clinical_approved' THEN
  allowed:=clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.clinical_approve',NEW.clinic_id,NULL);
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_commandreceipt'
  AND row_data->>'kind'='coverage' THEN
  allowed:=clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.book',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.book_own',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.move',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.move_own',NEW.clinic_id,NULL);
 END IF;
 IF NOT allowed THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  prior:=to_jsonb(OLD);
  old_state:=prior->>'state'; new_state:=row_data->>'state';
  IF row_data-'state'<>prior-'state' OR old_state=new_state OR NOT (
   (TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_guide' AND (
    (old_state='draft' AND new_state='validated') OR
    (old_state='validated' AND new_state='sealed')))
   OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_batch' AND (
    (old_state='draft' AND new_state='validated') OR
    (old_state='validated' AND new_state='sealed') OR
    (old_state='sealed' AND new_state='submitting') OR
    (old_state='submitting' AND new_state IN ('submitted','unknown')) OR
    (old_state='unknown' AND new_state IN ('submitted','acknowledged')) OR
    (old_state='submitted' AND new_state='acknowledged') OR
    (old_state='acknowledged' AND new_state='returned')))
   OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_appeal' AND (
    (old_state='draft' AND new_state='approved') OR
    (old_state='approved' AND new_state='submitted')))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance command conflict' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_appeal' THEN
   IF new_state IN ('approved','submitted') AND OLD.clinical_assertions IS NOT NULL THEN
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_clinicalapproval a
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_user u ON u.id=a.approved_by_id AND u.is_active
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r ON r.user_id=u.id
     AND r.clinic_id=OLD.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=OLD.organization_id
     AND r.role='physician' AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_professionalregistration p ON p.user_id=u.id
     AND p.clinic_id=OLD.clinic_id AND p.organization_id=OLD.organization_id
     AND p.role=r.role AND p.status='regular' AND p.synthetic
     AND p.revoked_at IS NULL AND p.valid_from<=statement_timestamp()
     AND statement_timestamp()<p.valid_to
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=OLD.clinic_id
     AND p.jurisdiction=c.crm_uf
    WHERE a.appeal_id=OLD.id AND a.content_sha256=OLD.content_sha256
    AND (p.physician_profile_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_physicianprofile legacy
     WHERE legacy.id=p.physician_profile_id AND legacy.user_id=u.id
      AND legacy.organization_id=OLD.organization_id
      AND legacy.jurisdiction=p.jurisdiction AND legacy.synthetic
      AND legacy.status='regular' AND legacy.last_checked_at<=statement_timestamp()
      AND statement_timestamp()<legacy.recheck_at
      AND (legacy.expires_at IS NULL OR statement_timestamp()<legacy.expires_at)))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_rolegrant n
     WHERE n.organization_id=OLD.organization_id AND n.clinic_id=OLD.clinic_id
     AND n.role=r.role AND n.permission='tiss.clinical_approve'
     AND n.bundle_version=2 AND n.effect='remove'
     AND n.valid_from<=statement_timestamp()
     AND (n.valid_to IS NULL OR statement_timestamp()<n.valid_to))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance command conflict' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid insurance input' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 links:=CASE TG_TABLE_NAME WHEN 'insurance_payercontract' THEN jsonb_build_object('payer_id','insurance_payer') WHEN 'insurance_pricetable' THEN jsonb_build_object('contract_id','insurance_payercontract') WHEN 'insurance_insurancemembership' THEN jsonb_build_object('payer_id','insurance_payer','enrollment_id','intake_patientclinicenrollment') WHEN 'insurance_guide' THEN jsonb_build_object('contract_id','insurance_payercontract','membership_id','insurance_insurancemembership','encounter_id','ehr_encounter','invoice_id','billing_invoice','price_table_id','insurance_pricetable','predecessor_id','insurance_guide') WHEN 'insurance_batch' THEN jsonb_build_object('contract_id','insurance_payercontract') WHEN 'insurance_submission' THEN jsonb_build_object('batch_id','insurance_batch') WHEN 'insurance_batchguide' THEN jsonb_build_object('batch_id','insurance_batch','guide_id','insurance_guide') WHEN 'insurance_return' THEN jsonb_build_object('batch_id','insurance_batch') WHEN 'insurance_glosa' THEN jsonb_build_object('source_id','insurance_return','guide_id','insurance_guide') WHEN 'insurance_appeal' THEN jsonb_build_object('glosa_id','insurance_glosa') WHEN 'insurance_clinicalapproval' THEN jsonb_build_object('appeal_id','insurance_appeal') WHEN 'insurance_paymentmatch' THEN jsonb_build_object('guide_id','insurance_guide','settlement_id','billing_journalsettlement','allocation_id','billing_settlementallocation') WHEN 'insurance_payerrequest' THEN jsonb_build_object('appointment_id','scheduling_appointment','membership_id','insurance_insurancemembership','contract_id','insurance_payercontract','task_id','workflows_task')  ELSE '{}'::jsonb END;
 FOR link IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_each_text(links) LOOP
  IF row_data->>link.key IS NULL THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
  matched:=CASE link.value WHEN 'billing_invoice' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."billing_invoice" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'billing_journalsettlement' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."billing_journalsettlement" t JOIN clinic_app.billing_journalbook b ON b.id=t.book_id WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND b.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'billing_settlementallocation' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."billing_settlementallocation" t JOIN clinic_app.billing_journalbook b ON b.id=t.book_id WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND b.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'ehr_encounter' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."ehr_encounter" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_appeal' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_appeal" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_batch' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_batch" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_glosa' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_glosa" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_guide' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_guide" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_insurancemembership' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_insurancemembership" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_payer' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_payer" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_payercontract' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_payercontract" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_pricetable' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_pricetable" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'insurance_return' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_return" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'intake_patientclinicenrollment' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."intake_patientclinicenrollment" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'scheduling_appointment' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."scheduling_appointment" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
WHEN 'workflows_task' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."workflows_task" t  WHERE t.id=(row_data->>link.key)::uuid AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id) ELSE false END;
  IF NOT matched THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
 WHEN 'insurance_payer' THEN
  IF NEW.ans_registry!~'^[0-9]{6}$' OR length(NEW.name)=0 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid payer identity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_payercontract' THEN
  IF NEW.version<1 OR (NEW.ends_on IS NOT NULL AND NEW.ends_on<NEW.starts_on) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid payer contract' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_pricetable' THEN
  IF NEW.version<1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid price version' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_tussterm' THEN
  IF NEW.component_version!~'^[0-9]{6}$' OR NEW.source_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR NEW.table_code!~'^[0-9]{2}$' OR NEW.code!~'^[0-9]{1,10}$'
   OR length(NEW.description) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid terminology version' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_guide' THEN
  SELECT * INTO membership FROM clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership
   WHERE id=NEW.membership_id;
  SELECT * INTO invoice FROM clinic_app.billing_invoice WHERE id=NEW.invoice_id;
  IF NEW.state<>'draft' OR NEW.kind NOT IN ('consulta','spsadt','honorarios')
   OR NEW.number!~'^[0-9]{1,20}$' OR NEW.total_minor<=0 OR NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter e
    JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment p ON p.id=membership.enrollment_id
    JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payercontract c ON c.id=NEW.contract_id
    JOIN clinic_app.insurance_pricetable t ON t.id=NEW.price_table_id
    JOIN clinic_app.billing_invoiceterms terms ON terms.invoice_id=invoice.id
    WHERE e.id=NEW.encounter_id AND p.patient_id=e.patient_id
    AND invoice.patient_id=e.patient_id AND c.payer_id=membership.payer_id
    AND t.contract_id=c.id AND terms.payer='insurer'
    AND terms.net_minor=NEW.total_minor AND terms.completion_entry_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (invoice.encounter_id=e.id OR invoice.appointment_id=e.appointment_id)
   ) OR (NEW.predecessor_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_guide g WHERE g.id=NEW.predecessor_id
    AND g.encounter_id=NEW.encounter_id AND g.invoice_id=NEW.invoice_id
    AND g.membership_id=NEW.membership_id AND g.contract_id=NEW.contract_id
    AND g.state='sealed')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid source-backed guide' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_batch' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'draft' OR NEW.number!~'^[0-9]{1,12}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.guide_ids)<>'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.guide_ids) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
   OR NEW.content_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(NEW.guide_ids) gid
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_guide g
     WHERE g.id=gid::uuid AND g.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
     AND g.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND g.contract_id=NEW.contract_id
     AND g.state='validated')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid immutable batch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_submission' THEN
  SELECT * INTO batch FROM clinic_app.insurance_batch WHERE id=NEW.batch_id;
  IF batch.state<>'submitting' OR NEW.content_sha256<>batch.content_sha256
   OR NEW.channel NOT IN ('portal','synthetic_webservice') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid sealed submission' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_batchguide' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_batch b
   JOIN clinic_app.insurance_guide g ON g.id=NEW.guide_id
   WHERE b.id=NEW.batch_id AND b.state='draft' AND g.state='validated'
   AND b.contract_id=g.contract_id AND b.guide_ids ? g.id::text) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid batch guide binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_return' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_batch b WHERE b.id=NEW.batch_id
   AND b.state IN ('acknowledged','returned')) OR NEW.source_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unacknowledged return' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_glosa' THEN
  IF NEW.sequence<1 OR NEW.charged_minor<>NEW.accepted_minor+NEW.denied_minor
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_return r
    JOIN clinic_app.insurance_batch b ON b.id=r.batch_id
    WHERE r.id=NEW.source_id AND b.guide_ids ? NEW.guide_id::text) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid adjudication binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_appeal' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'draft' OR NEW.content_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_glosa g
    WHERE g.id=NEW.glosa_id AND g.denied_minor>0) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid denied appeal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_clinicalapproval' THEN
  SELECT * INTO appeal FROM clinic_app.insurance_appeal WHERE id=NEW.appeal_id;
  IF NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid OR appeal.state<>'draft'
   OR appeal.content_sha256<>NEW.content_sha256 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_paymentmatch' THEN
  SELECT * INTO guide FROM clinic_app.insurance_guide WHERE id=NEW.guide_id;
  IF NEW.amount_minor<=0 OR NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.billing_settlementallocation a
   JOIN clinic_app.billing_journalsettlement s ON s.id=a.settlement_id
   JOIN clinic_app.billing_invoiceterms t ON t.id=a.terms_id
   WHERE a.id=NEW.allocation_id AND a.settlement_id=NEW.settlement_id
   AND a.amount_minor=NEW.amount_minor AND t.invoice_id=guide.invoice_id
   AND t.payer='insurer' AND s.kind='insurer' AND s.state='posted'
   AND a.entry_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unverified payer payment' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_payerrequest' THEN
  IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('eligibility','authorization')
   OR NEW.outcome NOT IN ('eligible','authorized','denied','unknown')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_payercontract c
    JOIN clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership m ON m.payer_id=c.payer_id
    WHERE c.id=NEW.contract_id AND m.id=NEW.membership_id
    AND ((NEW.kind='eligibility' AND c.eligibility_supported)
    OR (NEW.kind='authorization' AND c.authorization_supported))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported payer request' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_commandreceipt' THEN
  IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('guide','batch','appeal','coverage') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid transition receipt' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  matched:=CASE NEW.kind WHEN 'coverage' THEN NEW.next_state='covered'
   WHEN 'guide' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_guide" WHERE id=NEW.subject_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND state=NEW.next_state)
WHEN 'batch' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_batch" WHERE id=NEW.subject_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND state=NEW.next_state)
WHEN 'appeal' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_appeal" WHERE id=NEW.subject_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND state=NEW.next_state) ELSE false END;
  IF NOT matched THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid transition receipt' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSE NULL;
 END CASE;
 NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp();
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 'insurance-clinic-v1:'||NEW.clinic_id::text,0));
 allowed:=clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.manage',NEW.clinic_id,NULL);
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_clinicalapproval' THEN
  allowed:=clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.clinical_approve',NEW.clinic_id,NULL);

 END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  prior:=to_jsonb(OLD);

   (TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_guide' AND (
    (old_state='draft' AND new_state='validated') OR
    (old_state='validated' AND new_state='sealed')))

  IF NEW.sequence<1 OR NEW.charged_minor<>NEW.accepted_minor+NEW.denied_minor
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_return r
    JOIN clinic_app.insurance_batch b ON b.id=r.batch_id
    WHERE r.id=NEW.source_id AND b.guide_ids ? NEW.guide_id::text) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid adjudication binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_appeal' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'draft' OR NEW.content_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_glosa g
    WHERE g.id=NEW.glosa_id AND g.denied_minor>0) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid denied appeal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_clinicalapproval' THEN
  SELECT * INTO appeal FROM clinic_app.insurance_appeal WHERE id=NEW.appeal_id;
  IF NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid OR appeal.state<>'draft'
   OR appeal.content_sha256<>NEW.content_sha256 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_paymentmatch' THEN
  SELECT * INTO guide FROM clinic_app.insurance_guide WHERE id=NEW.guide_id;
  IF NEW.amount_minor<=0 OR NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.billing_settlementallocation a
   JOIN clinic_app.billing_journalsettlement s ON s.id=a.settlement_id
   JOIN clinic_app.billing_invoiceterms t ON t.id=a.terms_id
   WHERE a.id=NEW.allocation_id AND a.settlement_id=NEW.settlement_id
   AND a.amount_minor=NEW.amount_minor AND t.invoice_id=guide.invoice_id
   AND t.payer='insurer' AND s.kind='insurer' AND s.state='posted'
   AND a.entry_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unverified payer payment' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_payerrequest' THEN
  IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('eligibility','authorization')
   OR NEW.outcome NOT IN ('eligible','authorized','denied','unknown')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_payercontract c
    JOIN clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership m ON m.payer_id=c.payer_id
    WHERE c.id=NEW.contract_id AND m.id=NEW.membership_id
    AND ((NEW.kind='eligibility' AND c.eligibility_supported)
    OR (NEW.kind='authorization' AND c.authorization_supported))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported payer request' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WHEN 'insurance_commandreceipt' THEN
  IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('guide','batch','appeal','coverage') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid transition receipt' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  matched:=CASE NEW.kind WHEN 'coverage' THEN NEW.next_state='covered'
   WHEN 'guide' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_guide" WHERE id=NEW.subject_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND state=NEW.next_state)
WHEN 'batch' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_batch" WHERE id=NEW.subject_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND state=NEW.next_state)
WHEN 'appeal' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "clinic_app"."insurance_appeal" WHERE id=NEW.subject_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND state=NEW.next_state) ELSE false END;
  IF NOT matched THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid transition receipt' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSE NULL;
 END CASE;
 NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp();
 RETURN NEW;
END "

function insurance_guide_source(uuid, uu.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.insurance_guide_source(clinic uuid, encounter uuid, invoice uuid, membership uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(organization_id uuid, physician_id uuid, service_type_id uuid, performed_on date, amount_minor bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT e.organization_id,e.physician_id,a.service_type_id,
 (coalesce(a.start_at,e.created_at) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)::date,t.net_minor
 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter e
 JOIN clinic_app.identity_clinic c ON c.id=e.clinic_id
 JOIN clinic_app.billing_invoice i ON i.id=invoice AND i.clinic_id=e.clinic_id
  AND i.organization_id=e.organization_id AND i.patient_id=e.patient_id
  AND (i.encounter_id=e.id OR i.appointment_id=e.appointment_id)
 JOIN clinic_app.billing_invoiceterms t ON t.invoice_id=i.id AND t.payer='insurer'
  AND t.completion_entry_id IS NOT NULL
 JOIN clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership m ON m.id=membership
  AND m.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND m.organization_id=e.organization_id
 JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment p ON p.id=m.enrollment_id
  AND p.patient_id=e.patient_id AND p.clinic_id=e.clinic_id
 LEFT JOIN clinic_app.scheduling_appointment a ON a.id=e.appointment_id
 WHERE e.id=encounter AND e.clinic_id=clinic AND e.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND i.state IN ('open','paid')
 AND clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.manage',clinic,NULL)
$function$
"

function agent_approval_current(uuid, uu.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_approval_current(requested uuid, approval_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_approval a
 WHERE a.id=approval_id AND a.proposal_id=requested
 AND a.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND CASE WHEN pg_has_role(session_user,'clinic_agent','USAGE')
 THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.agent_proposal_scope(requested))
 ELSE (clinic_app.agent_staff(a.clinic_id) OR clinic_app.ai_revenue_row(a.clinic_id,'proposal',a.proposal_id)) END
 AND a.authority_snapshot=clinic_app.agent_bound_snapshot(a.clinic_id,a.approver_id,
 a.authority_snapshot->>'permission',a.organization_id))
$function$
"

function agent_controls(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_controls(requested uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('latest_policy_id',
 (SELECT latest.id::text FROM clinic_app.ai_agentpolicyversion latest
 WHERE latest.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND latest.capability=p.capability
 ORDER BY latest.version DESC LIMIT 1),'enabled',
 coalesce((SELECT enabled FROM clinic_app.ai_gatewayswitch WHERE id=1),false)
 AND coalesce((org.policy->>'enabled')::boolean,false)
 AND coalesce((org.policy->'purposes') ? p.capability,false)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration m
 WHERE m.id=r.configuration_id AND m.state='active'
 AND m.approval_ref<>'' AND m.provider IN ('synthetic','recorded_fixture')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_gatewayswitch gs
 WHERE gs.id=1 AND gs.approved_regions ? m.region)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_aicircuit circuit
 WHERE circuit.configuration_id=m.id AND circuit.organization_id=p.organization_id
 AND circuit.closed_at IS NULL)),
 'policy_authority',coalesce(
 clinic_app.identity_actor_permission('automation.admin',p.clinic_id,NULL,
 p.created_by_id,p.organization_id)
 OR clinic_app.identity_actor_permission('automation.organization',p.clinic_id,NULL,
 p.created_by_id,p.organization_id),false),
 'provider',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('capability_version',v.id::text,
 'account',v.account,'environment',v.environment,'api_version',v.api_version,
 'state',v.state,'provider',v.provider)
 FROM clinic_app.providers_capabilityversion v
 WHERE v.id=(SELECT c.current_version_id FROM clinic_app.providers_providercapability c
 WHERE c.key='email' AND (c.clinic_id=p.clinic_id OR c.clinic_id IS NULL)
 ORDER BY c.clinic_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)))
 FROM clinic_app.ai_actionproposal a
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentrun r ON r.id=a.run_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentpolicyversion p ON p.id=r.policy_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT ai_policy AS policy
 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinicconfiguration
 WHERE organization_id=p.organization_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) org
 ON true WHERE a.id=requested
 AND a.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND CASE WHEN pg_has_role(session_user,'clinic_agent','USAGE')
 THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.agent_proposal_scope(requested))
 ELSE (clinic_app.agent_staff(a.clinic_id) OR clinic_app.ai_revenue_row(a.clinic_id,'proposal',a.id)) END
$function$
"

function ai_eval_record_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_record_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 tenant uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 p clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol; r clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun;
 m clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration; t jsonb; previous integer;
 one jsonb; two jsonb; assigned uuid; expected_capability text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation history retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM tenant OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
 WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationprotocol' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.registered_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
   'ai-eval-protocol:'||NEW.clinic_id||':'||NEW.capability,0));
  SELECT coalesce(max(version),0) INTO previous FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol
   WHERE clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND capability=NEW.capability;
  t:=NEW.thresholds_document::jsonb;
  IF NEW.version<>previous+1 OR NEW.capability!~'^AI-0[1-8]$'
  OR NEW.corpus_version<>'engineering-v1' OR NEW.corpus_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.clinical_owner_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
  OR octet_length(NEW.thresholds_document)>4096
  OR NEW.thresholds_sha256<>encode(clinic_app.digest(
   convert_to(NEW.thresholds_document,'UTF8')::bytea,'sha256'::text),'hex')
  OR jsonb_typeof(t)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(t))<>8
  OR NOT t ?& ARRAY['minimum_cases','minimum_encounters','maximum_critical_errors',
   'maximum_error_rate_ppm','minimum_citation_support_ppm',
   'minimum_action_correctness_ppm','bootstrap_seed','bootstrap_iterations']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(t) x WHERE x.value!~'^[0-9]+$')
  OR (t->>'minimum_cases')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR (t->>'minimum_encounters')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 2 AND (t->>'minimum_cases')::integer
  OR (t->>'maximum_critical_errors')::bigint<>0
  OR (t->>'maximum_error_rate_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_citation_support_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_action_correctness_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_seed')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_iterations')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 10000
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.case_manifest)<>'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x))<>6
   OR NOT x ?& ARRAY['id','encounter','specialty','device','accent','adversarial']
   OR x->>'id'!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$'
   OR x->>'encounter'!~'^synthetic-encounter-[0-9]{2}$'
   OR x->>'specialty' NOT IN('general','pediatrics','internal')
   OR x->>'device' NOT IN('synthetic-microphone','synthetic-phone',
    'synthetic-headset','synthetic-failed-microphone')
   OR x->>'accent' NOT IN('flite-kal','flite-slt','flite-rms')
   OR x->>'adversarial' NOT IN('accents','noise','caregiver_child','interruptions',
    'conflicting_records','mic_failure','decimal_commas','ambiguous_abbreviations',
    'wrong_patient_attachments','stale_permissions','malicious_content','negation')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(x) entry
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value)<>'string'))
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id')
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation registration' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrun' THEN
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=NEW.protocol_id;
  SELECT * INTO m FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration WHERE id=NEW.configuration_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   expected_capability:=CASE m.purpose WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN 'AI-01'
    WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN 'AI-01' WHEN 'brief' THEN 'AI-02'
    WHEN 'extraction' THEN 'AI-03' WHEN 'front_desk' THEN 'AI-04' WHEN 'care_coordination' THEN 'AI-05' WHEN 'revenue_cycle' THEN 'AI-06'
    WHEN 'analyst' THEN 'AI-07' WHEN 'decision_support' THEN 'AI-08' END;
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
   OR NEW.status<>'pending' OR NEW.sample_results IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.automatic_failures<>0 OR NEW.configuration_version<>m.version
   OR p.capability IS DISTINCT FROM expected_capability
   OR NEW.versions->>'prompt' IS DISTINCT FROM m.prompt_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'retrieval' IS DISTINCT FROM m.retrieval_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM m.schema_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'model'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.versions)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.versions))<>5
   OR NEW.versions->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM m.version::text
   OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.rater_two_id OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.rater_two_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.created_by_id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
    WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
    AND newer.version>p.version)
   OR 3<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) FROM clinic_app.identity_user u
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole role ON role.user_id=u.id
    WHERE u.id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
    AND u.is_active AND role.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND role.organization_id=tenant AND role.role='physician'
    AND role.revoked_at IS NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'pending' OR
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation run immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status<>OLD.status THEN
    IF NEW.status NOT IN('passed','failed')
    OR NEW.status<>clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(NEW.id)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NULL
    OR (NEW.sample_results,NEW.automatic_failures,NEW.scored_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.sample_results,OLD.automatic_failures,OLD.scored_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation verdict' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.sample_results IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
    OR NEW.scored_at IS NULL OR NEW.sample_results IS NULL
    OR octet_length(NEW.sample_results) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 2097152
    OR NEW.automatic_failures>jsonb_array_length(p.case_manifest)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation observations' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   ELSE NEW.scored_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrating' THEN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  assigned:=CASE NEW.slot WHEN 'rater_one' THEN r.rater_one_id
   WHEN 'rater_two' THEN r.rater_two_id WHEN 'adjudicator' THEN r.adjudicator_id END;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR assigned IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR assigned IS NULL
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinician')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id) OR r.scored_at IS NULL OR r.status<>'pending'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.case_manifest) x
   WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.case_id)
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.labels)<>'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.labels))<>16
  OR NOT NEW.labels ?& ARRAY['significant_omission','hallucination',
   'speaker_attribution','negation','chronology','units_decimals',
   'medication_name_dose','allergy_handling','unsupported_citation',
   'incorrect_action','policy_violation','unauthorized_effect','duplicate_effect',
   'missed_escalation','critical_error','correction_ms']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.labels) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value)<>'number'
   OR (x.key<>'correction_ms' AND x.value::text NOT IN('0','1'))
   OR (x.key='correction_ms' AND (x.value::text!~'^[0-9]+$'
    OR (x.value::text)::bigint>3600000)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation rating denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.slot='adjudicator' THEN
   SELECT labels INTO one FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_one';
   SELECT labels INTO two FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_two';
   IF one IS NULL OR two IS NULL OR (one-'correction_ms')=(two-'correction_ms')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adjudication not eligible' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  IF NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'owner')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.configuration_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id,r.configuration_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.status<>'requested'
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approval_ref<>''
   OR NEW.decided_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid model change' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'requested' OR NEW.status NOT IN('approved','rejected')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.decided_at IS NULL
   OR NEW.approved_by_id=NEW.requested_by_id
   OR NEW.approval_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
   OR (NEW.status='approved' AND (r.status<>'passed'
    OR clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(r.id)<>'passed'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
     WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
     AND newer.version>p.version)))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'model change lacks passing evaluation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.decided_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

BEGIN

  SELECT coalesce(max(version),0) INTO previous FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol
   WHERE clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND capability=NEW.capability;
  t:=NEW.thresholds_document::jsonb;
  IF NEW.version<>previous+1 OR NEW.capability!~'^AI-0[1-8]$'
  OR NEW.corpus_version<>'engineering-v1' OR NEW.corpus_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.clinical_owner_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
  OR octet_length(NEW.thresholds_document)>4096
  OR NEW.thresholds_sha256<>encode(clinic_app.digest(
   convert_to(NEW.thresholds_document,'UTF8')::bytea,'sha256'::text),'hex')
  OR jsonb_typeof(t)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(t))<>8
  OR NOT t ?& ARRAY['minimum_cases','minimum_encounters','maximum_critical_errors',
   'maximum_error_rate_ppm','minimum_citation_support_ppm',
   'minimum_action_correctness_ppm','bootstrap_seed','bootstrap_iterations']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(t) x WHERE x.value!~'^[0-9]+$')
  OR (t->>'minimum_cases')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR (t->>'minimum_encounters')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 2 AND (t->>'minimum_cases')::integer
  OR (t->>'maximum_critical_errors')::bigint<>0
  OR (t->>'maximum_error_rate_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_citation_support_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_action_correctness_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_seed')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_iterations')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 10000
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.case_manifest)<>'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x))<>6
   OR NOT x ?& ARRAY['id','encounter','specialty','device','accent','adversarial']
   OR x->>'id'!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$'
   OR x->>'encounter'!~'^synthetic-encounter-[0-9]{2}$'
   OR x->>'specialty' NOT IN('general','pediatrics','internal')
   OR x->>'device' NOT IN('synthetic-microphone','synthetic-phone',
    'synthetic-headset','synthetic-failed-microphone')
   OR x->>'accent' NOT IN('flite-kal','flite-slt','flite-rms')
   OR x->>'adversarial' NOT IN('accents','noise','caregiver_child','interruptions',
    'conflicting_records','mic_failure','decimal_commas','ambiguous_abbreviations',
    'wrong_patient_attachments','stale_permissions','malicious_content','negation')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(x) entry
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value)<>'string'))
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id')
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation registration' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrun' THEN
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=NEW.protocol_id;
  SELECT * INTO m FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration WHERE id=NEW.configuration_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   expected_capability:=CASE m.purpose WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN 'AI-01'
    WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN 'AI-01' WHEN 'brief' THEN 'AI-02'
    WHEN 'extraction' THEN 'AI-03' WHEN 'front_desk' THEN 'AI-04' WHEN 'care_coordination' THEN 'AI-05' WHEN 'revenue_cycle' THEN 'AI-06'
    WHEN 'analyst' THEN 'AI-07' WHEN 'decision_support' THEN 'AI-08' END;
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
   OR NEW.status<>'pending' OR NEW.sample_results IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.automatic_failures<>0 OR NEW.configuration_version<>m.version
   OR p.capability IS DISTINCT FROM expected_capability
   OR NEW.versions->>'prompt' IS DISTINCT FROM m.prompt_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'retrieval' IS DISTINCT FROM m.retrieval_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM m.schema_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'model'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.versions)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.versions))<>5
   OR NEW.versions->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM m.version::text
   OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.rater_two_id OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.rater_two_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.created_by_id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
    WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
    AND newer.version>p.version)
   OR 3<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) FROM clinic_app.identity_user u
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole role ON role.user_id=u.id
    WHERE u.id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
    AND u.is_active AND role.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND role.organization_id=tenant AND role.role='physician'
    AND role.revoked_at IS NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'pending' OR
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation run immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status<>OLD.status THEN
    IF NEW.status NOT IN('passed','failed')
    OR NEW.status<>clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(NEW.id)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NULL
    OR (NEW.sample_results,NEW.automatic_failures,NEW.scored_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.sample_results,OLD.automatic_failures,OLD.scored_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation verdict' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.sample_results IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
    OR NEW.scored_at IS NULL OR NEW.sample_results IS NULL
    OR octet_length(NEW.sample_results) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 2097152
    OR NEW.automatic_failures>jsonb_array_length(p.case_manifest)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation observations' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   ELSE NEW.scored_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrating' THEN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  assigned:=CASE NEW.slot WHEN 'rater_one' THEN r.rater_one_id
   WHEN 'rater_two' THEN r.rater_two_id WHEN 'adjudicator' THEN r.adjudicator_id END;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR assigned IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR assigned IS NULL
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinician')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id) OR r.scored_at IS NULL OR r.status<>'pending'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.case_manifest) x
   WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.case_id)
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.labels)<>'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.labels))<>16
  OR NOT NEW.labels ?& ARRAY['significant_omission','hallucination',
   'speaker_attribution','negation','chronology','units_decimals',
   'medication_name_dose','allergy_handling','unsupported_citation',
   'incorrect_action','policy_violation','unauthorized_effect','duplicate_effect',
   'missed_escalation','critical_error','correction_ms']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.labels) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value)<>'number'
   OR (x.key<>'correction_ms' AND x.value::text NOT IN('0','1'))
   OR (x.key='correction_ms' AND (x.value::text!~'^[0-9]+$'
    OR (x.value::text)::bigint>3600000)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation rating denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.slot='adjudicator' THEN
   SELECT labels INTO one FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_one';
   SELECT labels INTO two FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_two';
   IF one IS NULL OR two IS NULL OR (one-'correction_ms')=(two-'correction_ms')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adjudication not eligible' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  IF NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'owner')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.configuration_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id,r.configuration_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.status<>'requested'
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approval_ref<>''
   OR NEW.decided_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid model change' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'requested' OR NEW.status NOT IN('approved','rejected')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.decided_at IS NULL
   OR NEW.approved_by_id=NEW.requested_by_id
   OR NEW.approval_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
   OR (NEW.status='approved' AND (r.status<>'passed'
    OR clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(r.id)<>'passed'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
     WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
     AND newer.version>p.version)))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'model change lacks passing evaluation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.decided_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END "

function ai_policy_valid(jsonb).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_policy_valid(policy jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE item record; p text;
BEGIN
 IF policy='{}'::jsonb THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(policy)<>'object'
 OR policy-ARRAY['enabled','purposes','monthly_budget_micros','purpose_budgets']
   <>'{}'::jsonb
 OR NOT policy ?& ARRAY['enabled','purposes','monthly_budget_micros',
   'purpose_budgets']
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'enabled')<>'boolean'
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'purposes')<>'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(policy->'purpose_budgets')<>'object'
 OR policy->>'monthly_budget_micros' !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$'
 OR (policy->>'monthly_budget_micros')::numeric>1000000000000000
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(policy->'purposes') x
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'string')
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes'))
 <> (SELECT count(DISTINCT x) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes') x)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 FOR p IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(policy->'purposes') LOOP
  IF p<>ALL(ARRAY['scribe_asr','scribe_draft','brief','extraction',
   'front_desk','analyst','decision_support','care_coordination','revenue_cycle'])
  OR NOT (policy->'purpose_budgets') ? p THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_each(policy->'purpose_budgets') LOOP
  IF item.key<>ALL(ARRAY['scribe_asr','scribe_draft','brief','extraction',
   'front_desk','analyst','decision_support','care_coordination','revenue_cycle'])
  OR jsonb_typeof(item.value)<>'number'
  OR item.value::text !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$'
  OR item.value::numeric>1000000000000000 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_typeof(policy->'monthly_budget_micros')='number';
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range
 OR invalid_parameter_value THEN RETURN false;
END $function$
"

function ai_staff(uuid, text, uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_staff(clinic uuid, purpose text, enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE purpose
 WHEN 'front_desk' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.read',clinic,NULL)
 WHEN 'analyst' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('charge.read',clinic,NULL)
 WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'brief' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'extraction' THEN clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'decision_support' THEN
  clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'care_coordination' THEN
  clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',clinic,enrollment)
 WHEN 'revenue_cycle' THEN
  clinic_app.has_permission('charge.read',clinic,NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.read',clinic,NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.manage',clinic,NULL)
  AND enrollment IS NULL
 ELSE false END
$function$
"

function agent_approval_current(uuid, uu.definition:

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'

 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_approval a
 WHERE a.id=approval_id AND a.proposal_id=requested
 AND a.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND CASE WHEN pg_has_role(session_user,'clinic_agent','USAGE')

 WHEN clinic_app.ai_revenue_ancestry(a.clinic_id,'proposal',a.proposal_id)

 ELSE clinic_app.agent_staff(a.clinic_id) END
 AND a.authority_snapshot=clinic_app.agent_bound_snapshot(a.clinic_id,a.approver_id,
 a.authority_snapshot->>'permission',a.organization_id))
$function$
"

function agent_controls(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.agent_controls(requested uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('latest_policy_id',
 (SELECT latest.id::text FROM clinic_app.ai_agentpolicyversion latest
 WHERE latest.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND latest.capability=p.capability
 ORDER BY latest.version DESC LIMIT 1),'enabled',
 coalesce((SELECT enabled FROM clinic_app.ai_gatewayswitch WHERE id=1),false)
 AND coalesce((org.policy->>'enabled')::boolean,false)
 AND coalesce((org.policy->'purposes') ? p.capability,false)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration m
 WHERE m.id=r.configuration_id AND m.state='active'
 AND m.approval_ref<>'' AND m.provider IN ('synthetic','recorded_fixture')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_gatewayswitch gs
 WHERE gs.id=1 AND gs.approved_regions ? m.region)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_aicircuit circuit
 WHERE circuit.configuration_id=m.id AND circuit.organization_id=p.organization_id
 AND circuit.closed_at IS NULL)),
 'policy_authority',coalesce(
 clinic_app.identity_actor_permission('automation.admin',p.clinic_id,NULL,
 p.created_by_id,p.organization_id)
 OR clinic_app.identity_actor_permission('automation.organization',p.clinic_id,NULL,
 p.created_by_id,p.organization_id),false),
 'provider',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('capability_version',v.id::text,
 'account',v.account,'environment',v.environment,'api_version',v.api_version,
 'state',v.state,'provider',v.provider)
 FROM clinic_app.providers_capabilityversion v
 WHERE v.id=(SELECT c.current_version_id FROM clinic_app.providers_providercapability c
 WHERE c.key='email' AND (c.clinic_id=p.clinic_id OR c.clinic_id IS NULL)
 ORDER BY c.clinic_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)))
 FROM clinic_app.ai_actionproposal a
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentrun r ON r.id=a.run_id
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_agentpolicyversion p ON p.id=r.policy_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT ai_policy AS policy
 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinicconfiguration
 WHERE organization_id=p.organization_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) org
 ON true WHERE a.id=requested
 AND a.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND CASE WHEN pg_has_role(session_user,'clinic_agent','USAGE')
 THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.agent_proposal_scope(requested))
 WHEN p.capability='revenue_cycle'
 THEN clinic_app.ai_revenue_row(a.clinic_id,'proposal',a.id)
 ELSE clinic_app.agent_staff(a.clinic_id) END
$function$
"
