function ai_eval_record_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_eval_record_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 tenant uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 p clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol; r clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun;
 m clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration; t jsonb; previous integer;
 one jsonb; two jsonb; assigned uuid; expected_capability text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation history retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM tenant OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
 WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_modelchangerequest' THEN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.status='approved'
  AND NEW.status IN('killed','invalidated') THEN
   IF NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'owner')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'status') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'status')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rollout stop denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationprotocol' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.registered_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
   'ai-eval-protocol:'||NEW.clinic_id||':'||NEW.capability,0));
  SELECT coalesce(max(version),0) INTO previous FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol
   WHERE clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND capability=NEW.capability;
  t:=NEW.thresholds_document::jsonb;
  IF NEW.version<>previous+1 OR NEW.capability!~'^AI-0[1-8]$'
  OR NEW.corpus_version<>'engineering-v1' OR NEW.corpus_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.clinical_owner_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
  OR octet_length(NEW.thresholds_document)>4096
  OR NEW.thresholds_sha256<>encode(clinic_app.digest(
   convert_to(NEW.thresholds_document,'UTF8')::bytea,'sha256'::text),'hex')
  OR jsonb_typeof(t)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(t))<>8
  OR NOT t ?& ARRAY['minimum_cases','minimum_encounters','maximum_critical_errors',
   'maximum_error_rate_ppm','minimum_citation_support_ppm',
   'minimum_action_correctness_ppm','bootstrap_seed','bootstrap_iterations']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(t) x WHERE x.value!~'^[0-9]+$')
  OR (t->>'minimum_cases')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR (t->>'minimum_encounters')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 2 AND (t->>'minimum_cases')::integer
  OR (t->>'maximum_critical_errors')::bigint<>0
  OR (t->>'maximum_error_rate_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_citation_support_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_action_correctness_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_seed')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_iterations')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 10000
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.case_manifest)<>'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x))<>6
   OR NOT x ?& ARRAY['id','encounter','specialty','device','accent','adversarial']
   OR x->>'id'!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$'
   OR x->>'encounter'!~'^synthetic-encounter-[0-9]{2}$'
   OR x->>'specialty' NOT IN('general','pediatrics','internal')
   OR x->>'device' NOT IN('synthetic-microphone','synthetic-phone',
    'synthetic-headset','synthetic-failed-microphone')
   OR x->>'accent' NOT IN('flite-kal','flite-slt','flite-rms')
   OR x->>'adversarial' NOT IN('accents','noise','caregiver_child','interruptions',
    'conflicting_records','mic_failure','decimal_commas','ambiguous_abbreviations',
    'wrong_patient_attachments','stale_permissions','malicious_content','negation')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(x) entry
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value)<>'string'))
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id')
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation registration' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrun' THEN
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=NEW.protocol_id;
  SELECT * INTO m FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration WHERE id=NEW.configuration_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   expected_capability:=CASE m.purpose WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN 'AI-01'
    WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN 'AI-01' WHEN 'brief' THEN 'AI-02'
    WHEN 'extraction' THEN 'AI-03' WHEN 'front_desk' THEN 'AI-04' WHEN 'care_coordination' THEN 'AI-05' WHEN 'revenue_cycle' THEN 'AI-06'
    WHEN 'analyst' THEN 'AI-07' WHEN 'decision_support' THEN 'AI-08' END;
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
   OR NEW.status<>'pending' OR NEW.sample_results IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.automatic_failures<>0 OR NEW.configuration_version<>m.version
   OR p.capability IS DISTINCT FROM expected_capability
   OR NEW.versions->>'prompt' IS DISTINCT FROM m.prompt_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'retrieval' IS DISTINCT FROM m.retrieval_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM m.schema_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'model'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.versions)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.versions))<>5
   OR NEW.versions->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM m.version::text
   OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.rater_two_id OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.rater_two_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.created_by_id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
    WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
    AND newer.version>p.version)
   OR 3<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) FROM clinic_app.identity_user u
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole role ON role.user_id=u.id
    WHERE u.id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
    AND u.is_active AND role.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND role.organization_id=tenant AND role.role='physician'
    AND role.revoked_at IS NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'pending' OR
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation run immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status<>OLD.status THEN
    IF NEW.status NOT IN('passed','failed')
    OR NEW.status<>clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(NEW.id)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NULL
    OR (NEW.sample_results,NEW.automatic_failures,NEW.scored_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.sample_results,OLD.automatic_failures,OLD.scored_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation verdict' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.sample_results IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
    OR NEW.scored_at IS NULL OR NEW.sample_results IS NULL
    OR octet_length(NEW.sample_results) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 2097152
    OR NEW.automatic_failures>jsonb_array_length(p.case_manifest)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation observations' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   ELSE NEW.scored_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrating' THEN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  assigned:=CASE NEW.slot WHEN 'rater_one' THEN r.rater_one_id
   WHEN 'rater_two' THEN r.rater_two_id WHEN 'adjudicator' THEN r.adjudicator_id END;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR assigned IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR assigned IS NULL
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinician')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id) OR r.scored_at IS NULL OR r.status<>'pending'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.case_manifest) x
   WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.case_id)
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.labels)<>'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.labels))<>16
  OR NOT NEW.labels ?& ARRAY['significant_omission','hallucination',
   'speaker_attribution','negation','chronology','units_decimals',
   'medication_name_dose','allergy_handling','unsupported_citation',
   'incorrect_action','policy_violation','unauthorized_effect','duplicate_effect',
   'missed_escalation','critical_error','correction_ms']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.labels) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value)<>'number'
   OR (x.key<>'correction_ms' AND x.value::text NOT IN('0','1'))
   OR (x.key='correction_ms' AND (x.value::text!~'^[0-9]+$'
    OR (x.value::text)::bigint>3600000)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation rating denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.slot='adjudicator' THEN
   SELECT labels INTO one FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_one';
   SELECT labels INTO two FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_two';
   IF one IS NULL OR two IS NULL OR (one-'correction_ms')=(two-'correction_ms')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adjudication not eligible' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  IF NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'owner')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.configuration_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id,r.configuration_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.status<>'requested'
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approval_ref<>''
   OR NEW.decided_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid model change' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'requested' OR NEW.status NOT IN('approved','rejected')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.decided_at IS NULL
   OR NEW.approved_by_id=NEW.requested_by_id
   OR NEW.approval_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
   OR (NEW.status='approved' AND (r.status<>'passed'
    OR clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(r.id)<>'passed'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
     WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
     AND newer.version>p.version)))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'model change lacks passing evaluation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.decided_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"
function ai_eval_record_guard().prosrc:
"
DECLARE actor uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 tenant uuid:=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 p clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol; r clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun;
 m clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration; t jsonb; previous integer;
 one jsonb; two jsonb; assigned uuid; expected_capability text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation history retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM tenant OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c
 WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id AND c.organization_id=tenant)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_modelchangerequest' THEN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.status='approved'
  AND NEW.status IN('killed','invalidated') THEN
   IF NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'owner')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'status') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'status')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rollout stop denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationprotocol' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.registered_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
   'ai-eval-protocol:'||NEW.clinic_id||':'||NEW.capability,0));
  SELECT coalesce(max(version),0) INTO previous FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol
   WHERE clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND capability=NEW.capability;
  t:=NEW.thresholds_document::jsonb;
  IF NEW.version<>previous+1 OR NEW.capability!~'^AI-0[1-8]$'
  OR NEW.corpus_version<>'engineering-v1' OR NEW.corpus_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.clinical_owner_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
  OR octet_length(NEW.thresholds_document)>4096
  OR NEW.thresholds_sha256<>encode(clinic_app.digest(
   convert_to(NEW.thresholds_document,'UTF8')::bytea,'sha256'::text),'hex')
  OR jsonb_typeof(t)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(t))<>8
  OR NOT t ?& ARRAY['minimum_cases','minimum_encounters','maximum_critical_errors',
   'maximum_error_rate_ppm','minimum_citation_support_ppm',
   'minimum_action_correctness_ppm','bootstrap_seed','bootstrap_iterations']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(t) x WHERE x.value!~'^[0-9]+$')
  OR (t->>'minimum_cases')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR (t->>'minimum_encounters')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 2 AND (t->>'minimum_cases')::integer
  OR (t->>'maximum_critical_errors')::bigint<>0
  OR (t->>'maximum_error_rate_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_citation_support_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'minimum_action_correctness_ppm')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_seed')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647
  OR (t->>'bootstrap_iterations')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 10000
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.case_manifest)<>'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x))<>6
   OR NOT x ?& ARRAY['id','encounter','specialty','device','accent','adversarial']
   OR x->>'id'!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$'
   OR x->>'encounter'!~'^synthetic-encounter-[0-9]{2}$'
   OR x->>'specialty' NOT IN('general','pediatrics','internal')
   OR x->>'device' NOT IN('synthetic-microphone','synthetic-phone',
    'synthetic-headset','synthetic-failed-microphone')
   OR x->>'accent' NOT IN('flite-kal','flite-slt','flite-rms')
   OR x->>'adversarial' NOT IN('accents','noise','caregiver_child','interruptions',
    'conflicting_records','mic_failure','decimal_commas','ambiguous_abbreviations',
    'wrong_patient_attachments','stale_permissions','malicious_content','negation')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(x) entry
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value)<>'string'))
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.case_manifest)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id')
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.case_manifest) x)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation registration' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrun' THEN
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=NEW.protocol_id;
  SELECT * INTO m FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration WHERE id=NEW.configuration_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (p.organization_id,p.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   expected_capability:=CASE m.purpose WHEN 'scribe_asr' THEN 'AI-01'
    WHEN 'scribe_draft' THEN 'AI-01' WHEN 'brief' THEN 'AI-02'
    WHEN 'extraction' THEN 'AI-03' WHEN 'front_desk' THEN 'AI-04' WHEN 'care_coordination' THEN 'AI-05' WHEN 'revenue_cycle' THEN 'AI-06'
    WHEN 'analyst' THEN 'AI-07' WHEN 'decision_support' THEN 'AI-08' END;
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
   OR NEW.status<>'pending' OR NEW.sample_results IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.automatic_failures<>0 OR NEW.configuration_version<>m.version
   OR p.capability IS DISTINCT FROM expected_capability
   OR NEW.versions->>'prompt' IS DISTINCT FROM m.prompt_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'retrieval' IS DISTINCT FROM m.retrieval_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM m.schema_sha256
   OR NEW.versions->>'model'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.versions)<>'object'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.versions))<>5
   OR NEW.versions->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM m.version::text
   OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.rater_two_id OR NEW.rater_one_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.rater_two_id=NEW.adjudicator_id
   OR NEW.created_by_id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
    WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
    AND newer.version>p.version)
   OR 3<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) FROM clinic_app.identity_user u
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole role ON role.user_id=u.id
    WHERE u.id IN(NEW.rater_one_id,NEW.rater_two_id,NEW.adjudicator_id)
    AND u.is_active AND role.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND role.organization_id=tenant AND role.role='physician'
    AND role.revoked_at IS NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'pending' OR
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['sample_results','automatic_failures','scored_at','status','finished_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation run immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status<>OLD.status THEN
    IF NEW.status NOT IN('passed','failed')
    OR NEW.status<>clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(NEW.id)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NULL
    OR (NEW.sample_results,NEW.automatic_failures,NEW.scored_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.sample_results,OLD.automatic_failures,OLD.scored_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation verdict' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.scored_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.sample_results IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinical_owner')
    OR NEW.scored_at IS NULL OR NEW.sample_results IS NULL
    OR octet_length(NEW.sample_results) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 2097152
    OR NEW.automatic_failures>jsonb_array_length(p.case_manifest)
    OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid evaluation observations' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   ELSE NEW.scored_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_evaluationrating' THEN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  assigned:=CASE NEW.slot WHEN 'rater_one' THEN r.rater_one_id
   WHEN 'rater_two' THEN r.rater_two_id WHEN 'adjudicator' THEN r.adjudicator_id END;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR assigned IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR assigned IS NULL
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'clinician')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id) OR r.scored_at IS NULL OR r.status<>'pending'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.case_manifest) x
   WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.case_id)
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.labels)<>'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.labels))<>16
  OR NOT NEW.labels ?& ARRAY['significant_omission','hallucination',
   'speaker_attribution','negation','chronology','units_decimals',
   'medication_name_dose','allergy_handling','unsupported_citation',
   'incorrect_action','policy_violation','unauthorized_effect','duplicate_effect',
   'missed_escalation','critical_error','correction_ms']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.labels) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value)<>'number'
   OR (x.key<>'correction_ms' AND x.value::text NOT IN('0','1'))
   OR (x.key='correction_ms' AND (x.value::text!~'^[0-9]+$'
    OR (x.value::text)::bigint>3600000)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation rating denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.slot='adjudicator' THEN
   SELECT labels INTO one FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_one';
   SELECT labels INTO two FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrating
    WHERE run_id=r.id AND case_id=NEW.case_id AND slot='rater_two';
   IF one IS NULL OR two IS NULL OR (one-'correction_ms')=(two-'correction_ms')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adjudication not eligible' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationrun WHERE id=NEW.run_id;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol WHERE id=r.protocol_id;
  IF NOT clinic_app.ai_eval_staff(NEW.clinic_id,'owner')
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.configuration_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (r.organization_id,r.clinic_id,r.configuration_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.requested_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.status<>'requested'
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approval_ref<>''
   OR NEW.decided_at IS NOT NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid model change' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.status<>'requested' OR NEW.status NOT IN('approved','rejected')
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','approved_by_id','approval_ref','decided_at'])
   OR NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.decided_at IS NULL
   OR NEW.approved_by_id=NEW.requested_by_id
   OR NEW.approval_ref!~'^synthetic-[a-z0-9-]{1,112}$'
   OR (NEW.status='approved' AND (r.status<>'passed'
    OR clinic_app.ai_eval_verdict(r.id)<>'passed'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_evaluationprotocol newer
     WHERE newer.clinic_id=p.clinic_id AND newer.capability=p.capability
     AND newer.version>p.version)))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'model change lacks passing evaluation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   NEW.decided_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END "

function ai_extraction_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_extraction_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE j clinic_app.ai_extractionjob; i clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation;
 a clinic_app.ai_aiartifact;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction history retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='ai_extractionjob' THEN
  SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=NEW.invocation_id;
  SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.ai_aiartifact WHERE id=i.inputs_ref_id;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
  OR (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.user_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (i.organization_id,i.clinic_id,i.user_id)
  OR a.patient_enrollment_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.patient_enrollment_id
  OR i.purpose<>'extraction' OR a.method<>'extract'
  OR NEW.sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.rotations)<>'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.rotations) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.rotations) x
   WHERE x::text NOT IN ('0','90','180','270'))
  OR NOT clinic_app.ai_extraction_source_allowed(NEW.clinic_id,
   NEW.patient_enrollment_id,NEW.result_version_id,NEW.attachment_id,NEW.sha256)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO j FROM clinic_app.ai_extractionjob WHERE id=NEW.job_id;
  IF (NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (j.organization_id,j.clinic_id) OR NOT clinic_app.ai_extraction_job_allowed(j.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('ai-extraction:'||j.id,0));
   SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.ai_aiartifact
    WHERE invocation_id=j.invocation_id AND kind='output';
   SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=j.invocation_id;
   IF j.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid OR i.status<>'succeeded'
   OR NEW.status NOT IN ('candidate','ambiguous') OR a.id IS NULL
   OR NEW.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM a.expires_at
   OR NEW.expires_at<=statement_timestamp()
   OR octet_length(NEW.payload) NOT BETWEEN 68 AND 16384
   OR NEW.observation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reviewed_by_id IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.position NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 127
   OR NEW.position<>(SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.ai_extractioncandidate c
    WHERE c.job_id=j.id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction proposal denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','observation_id','reviewed_by_id','reviewed_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','observation_id','reviewed_by_id','reviewed_at'])
   OR OLD.status NOT IN ('candidate','ambiguous')
   OR NOT (NEW.status='rejected' OR (OLD.status='candidate' AND NEW.status='confirmed'))
   OR NEW.reviewed_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
   OR NEW.reviewed_at IS NULL OR NEW.expires_at<=statement_timestamp()
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission(
    'clinical.write',j.clinic_id,j.patient_enrollment_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction decision denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.status='confirmed'
   AND NOT clinic_app.ai_effect_current(j.invocation_id,j.clinic_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'extraction invocation permission required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
   END IF;
   NEW.reviewed_at:=statement_timestamp();
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function ai_imported_observation(uuid, u.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.ai_imported_observation(observation uuid, version uuid, clinic uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_extractioncandidate c
 JOIN clinic_app.ai_extractionjob j ON j.id=c.job_id
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultversion v ON v.id=version
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_resultmatch m ON m.version_id=v.id
 JOIN clinic_app.orders_order o ON o.id=m.order_id
 WHERE c.observation_id=observation AND c.status='confirmed'
 AND c.reviewed_by_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid AND c.clinic_id=clinic
 AND c.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND j.clinic_id=clinic
 AND j.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND v.clinic_id=clinic
 AND v.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND m.clinic_id=clinic
 AND m.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND o.clinic_id=clinic
 AND o.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND o.enrollment_id=j.patient_enrollment_id
 AND v.sha256=j.sha256 AND (j.result_version_id IS NULL OR j.result_version_id=v.id)
 AND clinic_app.ai_extraction_job_allowed(j.id)
 AND clinic_app.ai_effect_current(j.invocation_id,clinic)
 AND clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.write',clinic,j.patient_enrollment_id)
 AND clinic_app.orders_is_current(v.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_resultacknowledgment a
  WHERE a.version_id=v.id))
$function$
"

function scribe_draft_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scribe_draft_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion; e clinic_app.ehr_encounter;
 a clinic_app.scribe_aidraft; s clinic_app.scribe_draftsectionsuggestion;
 i clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation; c clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration;
 t clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion; reference jsonb; section jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft provenance is retained' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('scribe-draft:'||NEW.version_id,0));
 SELECT * INTO v FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocumentversion WHERE id=NEW.version_id;
 SELECT encounter.* INTO e FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter encounter
 JOIN clinic_app.ehr_clinicaldocument d ON d.encounter_id=encounter.id
 WHERE d.id=v.document_id;
 IF v.id IS NULL OR v.state<>'draft' OR e.state<>'open'
  OR NEW.organization_id<>v.organization_id
  OR NOT clinic_app.scribe_note_author(v.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_aidraft' THEN
  SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=NEW.invocation_id;
  SELECT * INTO t FROM clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion WHERE id=NEW.transcript_id;
  IF (NEW.clinic_id,NEW.encounter_id,NEW.requested_by_id)
    IS DISTINCT FROM(e.clinic_id,e.id,v.author_id)
   OR i.id IS NULL OR (i.organization_id,i.clinic_id,i.user_id,i.purpose,i.status)
    IS DISTINCT FROM(v.organization_id,e.clinic_id,v.author_id,
     'scribe_draft'::text,'reserved'::text)
   OR i.operation_id IS NULL OR NEW.base_revision<>v.revision
   OR NEW.generation<>coalesce((SELECT max(generation) FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft
    WHERE version_id=v.id),0)+1
   OR NEW.base_epochs IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce((SELECT section_edit_epochs
    FROM clinic_app.ehr_drafteditstate WHERE version_id=v.id),
    '{"subjective":0,"objective":0,"assessment":0,"plan":0}'::jsonb)
   OR t.id IS NULL OR t.state<>'final'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession r
    WHERE r.id=t.session_id AND r.encounter_id=e.id AND NOT r.discarded)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_transcriptversion newer
    WHERE newer.session_id=t.session_id AND newer.revision>t.revision)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance acceptance
    JOIN clinic_app.consent_consenttext text ON text.id=acceptance.text_id
    JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment p ON p.id=acceptance.enrollment_id
    JOIN clinic_app.consent_aiusedisclosure disclosure ON disclosure.encounter_id=e.id
    WHERE acceptance.id=NEW.consent_id AND acceptance.organization_id=v.organization_id
     AND acceptance.clinic_id=e.clinic_id AND p.patient_id=e.patient_id
     AND i.inputs_ref_id IN(SELECT input.id FROM clinic_app.ai_aiartifact input
      WHERE input.patient_enrollment_id=p.id AND input.kind='input')
     AND text.purpose='ai_assistance' AND disclosure.informed AND NOT disclosure.refused
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentrevocation r
      WHERE r.acceptance_id=acceptance.id)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consenttext newer
      WHERE newer.clinic_id=text.clinic_id AND newer.purpose=text.purpose
       AND newer.version>text.version))
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.sections) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.sections) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4
   OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.sections)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT value)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.sections))
   OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.source_refs) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.source_refs) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 250
   OR octet_length(NEW.base_content) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft generation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  FOR section IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.sections) LOOP
   IF section NOT IN('"subjective"'::jsonb,'"objective"'::jsonb,
    '"assessment"'::jsonb,'"plan"'::jsonb) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft section' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  FOR reference IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_refs) LOOP
   IF NOT clinic_app.scribe_citation_allowed(v.id,t.id,reference) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft citation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
 ELSE
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_reviewdecision' THEN
   SELECT * INTO s FROM clinic_app.scribe_draftsectionsuggestion
    WHERE id=NEW.suggestion_id;
   SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft WHERE id=s.draft_id;
  ELSE
   SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft WHERE id=NEW.draft_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=a.invocation_id;
  IF a.id IS NULL OR a.version_id<>v.id OR a.organization_id<>NEW.organization_id
   OR i.status<>'succeeded' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_reviewdecision' THEN
   SELECT * INTO c FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration
    WHERE id=i.configuration_id;
   IF NEW.action<>'rejected'
   AND NOT clinic_app.ai_effect_current(i.id,e.clinic_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft invocation permission required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
   END IF;
   IF s.id IS NULL OR s.version_id<>v.id OR NEW.section<>s.section
    OR NEW.reviewed_by_id<>v.author_id
    OR NEW.action NOT IN('accepted','modified','rejected')
    OR NEW.result_revision<>v.revision OR NEW.result_sha256<>v.content_sha256
    OR NEW.result_revision NOT IN(NEW.expected_revision,NEW.expected_revision+1)
    OR (NEW.action='rejected' AND NEW.result_revision<>NEW.expected_revision)
    OR NEW.request_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR (NEW.action='rejected' AND NEW.applied_text IS NOT NULL)
    OR (NEW.action IN('accepted','modified') AND (
     NEW.applied_text IS NULL
     OR octet_length(NEW.applied_text) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144))
    OR NEW.capability_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
     'purpose','scribe_draft','capability',c.capability_key,
     'configuration_id',c.id,'version',i.config_version)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid clinician review' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.action<>'rejected' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft newer
    WHERE newer.version_id=v.id AND newer.generation>a.generation
     AND newer.sections @> jsonb_build_array(s.section)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft generation superseded' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.citations) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.citations) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    OR NOT a.source_refs @> NEW.citations
    OR octet_length(NEW.text) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft source' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_draftsectionsuggestion' THEN
    IF NOT a.sections @> jsonb_build_array(NEW.section)
     OR NEW.assertion_class NOT IN('reported','observed','hypothesis')
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft newer
      WHERE newer.version_id=v.id AND newer.generation>a.generation
       AND newer.sections @> jsonb_build_array(NEW.section)) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid section suggestion' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.kind NOT IN('order','task') OR NEW.ordinal NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 7 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid separate proposal' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp();
 RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
"

  FOR section IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.sections) LOOP
   IF section NOT IN('"subjective"'::jsonb,'"objective"'::jsonb,
    '"assessment"'::jsonb,'"plan"'::jsonb) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft section' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  FOR reference IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_refs) LOOP
   IF NOT clinic_app.scribe_citation_allowed(v.id,t.id,reference) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft citation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
 ELSE
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_reviewdecision' THEN
   SELECT * INTO s FROM clinic_app.scribe_draftsectionsuggestion
    WHERE id=NEW.suggestion_id;
   SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft WHERE id=s.draft_id;
  ELSE
   SELECT * INTO a FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft WHERE id=NEW.draft_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO i FROM clinic_app.ai_aiinvocation WHERE id=a.invocation_id;
  IF a.id IS NULL OR a.version_id<>v.id OR a.organization_id<>NEW.organization_id
   OR i.status<>'succeeded' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_reviewdecision' THEN
   SELECT * INTO c FROM clinic_app.ai_modelconfiguration
    WHERE id=i.configuration_id;
   IF NEW.action<>'rejected'
   AND NOT clinic_app.ai_effect_current(i.id,e.clinic_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft invocation permission required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
   END IF;
   IF s.id IS NULL OR s.version_id<>v.id OR NEW.section<>s.section
    OR NEW.reviewed_by_id<>v.author_id
    OR NEW.action NOT IN('accepted','modified','rejected')
    OR NEW.result_revision<>v.revision OR NEW.result_sha256<>v.content_sha256
    OR NEW.result_revision NOT IN(NEW.expected_revision,NEW.expected_revision+1)
    OR (NEW.action='rejected' AND NEW.result_revision<>NEW.expected_revision)
    OR NEW.request_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR (NEW.action='rejected' AND NEW.applied_text IS NOT NULL)
    OR (NEW.action IN('accepted','modified') AND (
     NEW.applied_text IS NULL
     OR octet_length(NEW.applied_text) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144))
    OR NEW.capability_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
     'purpose','scribe_draft','capability',c.capability_key,
     'configuration_id',c.id,'version',i.config_version)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid clinician review' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.action<>'rejected' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft newer
    WHERE newer.version_id=v.id AND newer.generation>a.generation
     AND newer.sections @> jsonb_build_array(s.section)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft generation superseded' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.citations) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.citations) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    OR NOT a.source_refs @> NEW.citations
    OR octet_length(NEW.text) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid draft source' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF TG_TABLE_NAME='scribe_draftsectionsuggestion' THEN
    IF NOT a.sections @> jsonb_build_array(NEW.section)
     OR NEW.assertion_class NOT IN('reported','observed','hypothesis')
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_aidraft newer
      WHERE newer.version_id=v.id AND newer.generation>a.generation
       AND newer.sections @> jsonb_build_array(NEW.section)) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid section suggestion' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.kind NOT IN('order','task') OR NEW.ordinal NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 7 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid separate proposal' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 NEW.created_at:=statement_timestamp();
 RETURN NEW;
END
"

AS $function$

 (id,organization_id,document_id,command_id,from_status,to_status,actor_id,created_at)

function intake_membership_payer_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.intake_membership_payer_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE payer clinic_app.insurance_payer;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND NEW.payer_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.payer_id IS NULL AND NEW.payer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'payer_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'payer_id') THEN
  SELECT * INTO payer FROM clinic_app.insurance_payer
   WHERE id=NEW.payer_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF payer.id IS NOT NULL
   AND NEW.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
   AND clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.manage',payer.clinic_id,NULL)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
    WHERE e.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND e.clinic_id=payer.clinic_id
     AND e.patient_id=NEW.patient_id) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'patient identity history is append-only'
  USING ERRCODE='23514',CONSTRAINT='intake_identity_append_only_check';
END $function$
"

function insurance_appointment_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.insurance_appointment_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE m clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership;
 c clinic_app.insurance_payercontract; e clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment;
 r clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership;
 eligible clinic_app.insurance_payerrequest;
 authorized clinic_app.insurance_payerrequest;
 day date; confirming boolean; booking boolean; binding text; clinic_zone text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND ROW(NEW.eligibility_check_id,NEW.authorization_check_id,
  NEW.authorization_reference) IS DISTINCT FROM
  ROW(OLD.eligibility_check_id,OLD.authorization_check_id,OLD.authorization_reference)
  AND NOT (
pg_trigger_depth()>1
AND clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.manage',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['eligibility_check_id','authorization_check_id',
 'authorization_reference','revision','updated_at'])=
 (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['eligibility_check_id','authorization_check_id',
 'authorization_reference','revision','updated_at'])
AND (NEW.eligibility_check_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.eligibility_check_id
 OR NEW.authorization_check_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.authorization_check_id)
) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NEW.payer_membership_id IS NULL THEN
  IF NEW.payer_contract_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.eligibility_check_id IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.authorization_check_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.authorization_reference<>'' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND (NEW.eligibility_check_id IS NOT NULL
  OR NEW.authorization_check_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.authorization_reference<>'') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO m FROM clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership
  WHERE id=NEW.payer_membership_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
 SELECT * INTO c FROM clinic_app.insurance_payercontract
  WHERE id=NEW.payer_contract_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND payer_id=m.payer_id;
 SELECT * INTO e FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment
  WHERE id=m.enrollment_id AND patient_id=NEW.patient_id
   AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership
  WHERE id=m.registration_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id
   AND patient_id=NEW.patient_id;
 IF m.id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL OR e.id IS NULL OR r.id IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT timezone INTO clinic_zone FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic
  WHERE id=NEW.clinic_id;
 day:=(NEW.start_at AT TIME ZONE clinic_zone)::date;
 binding:=
encode(clinic_app.digest(ROW(
 NEW.id,NEW.patient_id,m.id,m.registration_id,m.fingerprint,
 encode(m.valid_from,'hex'),r.version,r.payer_id,
 coalesce(encode(r.valid_until,'hex'),''),
 coalesce(extract(epoch FROM r.retired_at)::text,''),
 c.id,c.version,c.fingerprint,to_char(c.starts_on,'YYYY-MM-DD'),
 to_char(c.ends_on,'YYYY-MM-DD'),c.eligibility_supported,c.authorization_supported,
 to_char(NEW.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US'),
 to_char(NEW.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US')
)::text,'sha256'),'hex')
;
 IF day<c.starts_on OR (c.ends_on IS NOT NULL AND day>c.ends_on)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_commandreceipt proof
   WHERE proof.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND proof.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND proof.kind='coverage' AND proof.subject_id=NEW.id
    AND proof.next_state='covered' AND proof.fingerprint=binding) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'payer refused' USING ERRCODE='23514',
   CONSTRAINT='scheduling_payer_refused'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO eligible FROM clinic_app.insurance_payerrequest
  WHERE id=NEW.eligibility_check_id AND kind='eligibility'
   AND appointment_id=NEW.id AND membership_id=m.id AND contract_id=c.id;
 SELECT * INTO authorized FROM clinic_app.insurance_payerrequest
  WHERE id=NEW.authorization_check_id AND kind='authorization'
   AND appointment_id=NEW.id AND membership_id=m.id AND contract_id=c.id;
 IF (NEW.eligibility_check_id IS NOT NULL AND eligible.id IS NULL)
  OR (NEW.authorization_check_id IS NOT NULL AND authorized.id IS NULL)
  OR NEW.authorization_reference IS DISTINCT FROM
   coalesce(authorized.authorization_reference,'') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 confirming:=NEW.status='scheduled' AND
  (TG_OP='INSERT' OR OLD.status IN ('held','requested'));
 booking:=TG_OP='INSERT' OR confirming OR
  (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND ROW(NEW.start_at,NEW.end_at) IS DISTINCT FROM
   ROW(OLD.start_at,OLD.end_at));
 IF booking AND (r.retired_at IS NOT NULL
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership newer
    WHERE newer.organization_id=r.organization_id AND newer.patient_id=r.patient_id
     AND newer.sequence=r.sequence AND newer.version>r.version)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_payercontract newer
    WHERE newer.organization_id=c.organization_id AND newer.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
     AND newer.payer_id=c.payer_id AND newer.version>c.version)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'payer refused' USING ERRCODE='23514',
   CONSTRAINT='scheduling_payer_refused'; END IF;
 IF confirming THEN
  IF (c.eligibility_supported AND eligible.outcome='denied')
   OR (c.authorization_supported AND authorized.outcome='denied') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'payer refused' USING ERRCODE='23514',
    CONSTRAINT='scheduling_payer_refused'; END IF;
  IF (c.eligibility_supported AND eligible.outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'eligible')
   OR (c.authorization_supported AND authorized.outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'authorized')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'payer check required' USING ERRCODE='23514',
   CONSTRAINT='scheduling_payer_pending'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function insurance_booking_coverage(uuid.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.insurance_booking_coverage(clinic uuid, patient uuid, membership uuid, contract uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(membership_id uuid, contract_id uuid, clinic_id uuid, patient_id uuid, payer_id uuid, contract_payer_id uuid, valid_from bytea, valid_to bytea, starts_on date, ends_on date, eligibility_supported boolean, authorization_supported boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT m.id,c.id,m.clinic_id,e.patient_id,m.payer_id,c.payer_id,
  m.valid_from,r.valid_until,c.starts_on,c.ends_on,
  c.eligibility_supported,c.authorization_supported
 FROM clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership m
 JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e ON e.id=m.enrollment_id
  AND e.organization_id=m.organization_id AND e.clinic_id=m.clinic_id
 JOIN clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership r ON r.id=m.registration_id
  AND r.organization_id=m.organization_id AND r.patient_id=e.patient_id
 JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payer canonical ON canonical.id=r.payer_id
  AND canonical.organization_id=r.organization_id
 JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payer local_payer ON local_payer.id=m.payer_id
  AND local_payer.clinic_id=m.clinic_id
  AND local_payer.ans_registry=canonical.ans_registry
 JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payercontract c ON c.id=contract
  AND c.clinic_id=m.clinic_id AND c.organization_id=m.organization_id
  AND c.payer_id=m.payer_id
 WHERE m.id=membership AND m.clinic_id=clinic AND e.patient_id=patient
  AND r.retired_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership newer
   WHERE newer.organization_id=r.organization_id AND newer.patient_id=r.patient_id
    AND newer.sequence=r.sequence AND newer.version>r.version)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_payercontract newer
   WHERE newer.organization_id=c.organization_id AND newer.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
    AND newer.payer_id=c.payer_id AND newer.version>c.version)
  AND m.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND (clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.book',clinic,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.book_own',clinic,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.move',clinic,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.move_own',clinic,NULL))
$function$
"
function insurance_booking_coverage(uuid.prosrc:
"
 SELECT m.id,c.id,m.clinic_id,e.patient_id,m.payer_id,c.payer_id,
  m.valid_from,r.valid_until,c.starts_on,c.ends_on,
  c.eligibility_supported,c.authorization_supported
 FROM clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership m
 JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e ON e.id=m.enrollment_id
  AND e.organization_id=m.organization_id AND e.clinic_id=m.clinic_id
 JOIN clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership r ON r.id=m.registration_id
  AND r.organization_id=m.organization_id AND r.patient_id=e.patient_id
 JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payer canonical ON canonical.id=r.payer_id
  AND canonical.organization_id=r.organization_id
 JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payer local_payer ON local_payer.id=m.payer_id
  AND local_payer.clinic_id=m.clinic_id
  AND local_payer.ans_registry=canonical.ans_registry
 JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payercontract c ON c.id=contract
  AND c.clinic_id=m.clinic_id AND c.organization_id=m.organization_id
  AND c.payer_id=m.payer_id
 WHERE m.id=membership AND m.clinic_id=clinic AND e.patient_id=patient
  AND r.retired_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership newer
   WHERE newer.organization_id=r.organization_id AND newer.patient_id=r.patient_id
    AND newer.sequence=r.sequence AND newer.version>r.version)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_payercontract newer
   WHERE newer.organization_id=c.organization_id AND newer.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
    AND newer.payer_id=c.payer_id AND newer.version>c.version)
  AND m.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
  AND (clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.book',clinic,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.book_own',clinic,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.move',clinic,NULL)
   OR clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.move_own',clinic,NULL))
"

 END IF;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

function insurance_registration_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.insurance_registration_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_insurancemembership' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership r
   JOIN clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment e
    ON e.patient_id=r.patient_id AND e.organization_id=r.organization_id
   JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payer canonical ON canonical.id=r.payer_id
    AND canonical.organization_id=r.organization_id
   JOIN clinic_app.insurance_payer p ON p.id=NEW.payer_id
    AND p.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
    AND p.ans_registry=canonical.ans_registry
   WHERE r.id=NEW.registration_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
    AND r.retired_at IS NULL AND e.id=NEW.enrollment_id
    AND e.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='insurance_guide' THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter e
   JOIN clinic_app.scheduling_appointment a ON a.id=e.appointment_id
    AND a.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
   WHERE e.id=NEW.encounter_id AND a.payer_membership_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (a.payer_membership_id<>NEW.membership_id
     OR a.payer_contract_id<>NEW.contract_id)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_appointment a
   WHERE a.id=NEW.appointment_id AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
    AND a.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND a.payer_membership_id=NEW.membership_id
    AND a.payer_contract_id=NEW.contract_id
    AND a.status NOT IN ('cancelled','expired','no_show'))
   OR (NEW.kind='authorization' AND NEW.outcome='authorized'
    AND NEW.authorization_reference<>'SYN-'||replace(NEW.command_id::text,'-',''))
   OR ((NEW.kind<>'authorization' OR NEW.outcome<>'authorized')
    AND NEW.authorization_reference<>'') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insurance access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function scheduling_capacity_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.scheduling_capacity_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 s clinic_app.scheduling_servicetype;
 r clinic_app.scheduling_resource;
 span tstzrange;
 chosen integer;
 consumes boolean;
BEGIN
 consumes := NEW.status IN ('held','scheduled','arrived','in_progress');
 IF TG_WHEN='BEFORE' THEN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND ROW(NEW.service_type_id,NEW.resource_ids,NEW.buffer_before,
 NEW.buffer_after)
   IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.service_type_id,OLD.resource_ids,OLD.buffer_before,
 OLD.buffer_after) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'booking requirements are immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.service_type_id IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT (
pg_trigger_depth()>1
AND clinic_app.has_permission('tiss.manage',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['eligibility_check_id','authorization_check_id',
 'authorization_reference','revision','updated_at'])=
 (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['eligibility_check_id','authorization_check_id',
 'authorization_reference','revision','updated_at'])
AND (NEW.eligibility_check_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.eligibility_check_id
 OR NEW.authorization_check_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.authorization_check_id)
)
   AND NOT (OLD.status='held' AND NEW.status='expired'
    AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'') IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_patient_session',true),'')
     IS NULL)
   AND NOT (
   clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.move',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR (clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.move_own',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    AND NEW.practitioner_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')
      ::uuid)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.patient_booking_scope() scope
    WHERE scope.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND scope.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
     AND scope.patient_id=NEW.patient_id)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'scheduling access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND NEW.service_type_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT (clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.book',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     OR (clinic_app.has_permission('appointment.book_own',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
         AND NEW.practitioner_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),
 '')::uuid)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.patient_booking_scope() scope
      WHERE scope.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
       AND scope.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
       AND scope.patient_id=NEW.patient_id)) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'scheduling access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND consumes
   AND OLD.status IN ('held','scheduled','arrived','in_progress')
   AND ROW(NEW.start_at,NEW.end_at)=ROW(OLD.start_at,OLD.end_at) THEN
   RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NOT consumes THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  PERFORM 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic WHERE id=NEW.clinic_id FOR SHARE;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_availabilityblock b
   JOIN clinic_app.scheduling_availabilitytemplate t ON t.id=b.template_id
   WHERE b.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND b.practitioner_id=NEW.practitioner_id
    AND b.retired_at IS NULL AND b.start_at<=NEW.start_at AND b.end_at>=NEW.end_at
 AND NOT t.active) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'outside template' USING ERRCODE='23514',
    CONSTRAINT='scheduling_outside_template';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.service_type_id IS NULL THEN
   IF cardinality(NEW.resource_ids)<>0 OR NEW.buffer_before<>0 OR NEW.buffer_after<>0
 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service required for resources' USING ERRCODE='23514',
 CONSTRAINT='scheduling_buffer_violation';
   END IF;
  ELSE
   SELECT * INTO s FROM clinic_app.scheduling_servicetype
    WHERE id=NEW.service_type_id AND clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND
 organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   IF s.id IS NULL OR (TG_OP='INSERT' AND NOT s.active) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'scheduling access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
   END IF;
   IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
    NEW.buffer_before:=s.buffer_before; NEW.buffer_after:=s.buffer_after;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.end_at-NEW.start_at<>s.duration_min*interval '1 minute' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service duration mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514',
 CONSTRAINT='scheduling_buffer_violation';
   END IF;
   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole role
    JOIN clinic_app.identity_user u ON u.id=role.user_id AND u.is_active
    WHERE role.revoked_at IS NULL AND role.user_id=NEW.practitioner_id AND role.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
     AND role.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
 role.role=ANY(s.required_professional_roles)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'professional role unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514',
 CONSTRAINT='scheduling_buffer_violation';
   END IF;
   IF cardinality(NEW.resource_ids)>16 OR array_position(NEW.resource_ids,NULL) IS
 NOT NULL
    OR cardinality(NEW.resource_ids)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM
 unnest(NEW.resource_ids) id)
    OR cardinality(NEW.resource_ids)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM
 clinic_app.scheduling_resource resource
      WHERE resource.id=ANY(NEW.resource_ids) AND resource.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
       AND resource.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND resource.active)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(s.required_resource_kinds) kind WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_resource resource WHERE
 resource.id=ANY(NEW.resource_ids) AND resource.kind=kind)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'resource selection unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514',
 CONSTRAINT='scheduling_resource_conflict';
   END IF;
  END IF;
  span:=clinic_app.scheduling_effective_interval(NEW.start_at,NEW.end_at,
 NEW.buffer_before,NEW.buffer_after);
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_holiday h WHERE
 h.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND h.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND h.active AND tstzrange(h.start_at,
 h.end_at,'[)') && span)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_absence a WHERE
 a.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.active
    AND (a.practitioner_id=NEW.practitioner_id OR a.resource_id=ANY(NEW.resource_ids))
    AND tstzrange(a.start_at,a.end_at,'[)') && span) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'holiday or absence' USING ERRCODE='23514',
 CONSTRAINT='scheduling_holiday';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.service_type_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_availabilityblock a
   WHERE a.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
    AND a.practitioner_id=NEW.practitioner_id AND a.retired_at IS NULL
    AND a.start_at<=lower(span) AND a.end_at>=upper(span)
    AND (a.template_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
 clinic_app.scheduling_availabilitytemplate t WHERE t.id=a.template_id AND
 t.active))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'buffer outside availability' USING ERRCODE='23514',
 CONSTRAINT='scheduling_buffer_violation';
  END IF;
  FOR r IN SELECT * FROM clinic_app.scheduling_resource WHERE
 id=ANY(NEW.resource_ids) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE LOOP
   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_availabilityblock a
    WHERE a.resource_id=r.id AND a.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND
 a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
     AND a.retired_at IS NULL AND a.start_at<=lower(span) AND a.end_at>=upper(span)
     AND (a.template_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
 clinic_app.scheduling_availabilitytemplate t WHERE t.id=a.template_id AND
 t.active))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'resource outside template' USING ERRCODE='23514',
 CONSTRAINT='scheduling_outside_template';
   END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 span:=clinic_app.scheduling_effective_interval(NEW.start_at,NEW.end_at,
 NEW.buffer_before,NEW.buffer_after);
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND consumes
  AND OLD.status IN ('held','scheduled','arrived','in_progress')
  AND ROW(NEW.start_at,NEW.end_at)=ROW(OLD.start_at,OLD.end_at) THEN
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF NOT consumes THEN
  UPDATE clinic_app.scheduling_appointmentresource SET occupied=false WHERE
 appointment_id=NEW.id;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 FOR r IN SELECT * FROM clinic_app.scheduling_resource WHERE id=ANY(NEW.resource_ids)
 ORDER BY id LOOP
  SELECT slots.unit INTO chosen FROM generate_series(1,r.capacity) slots(unit) WHERE
 NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_appointmentresource ar WHERE ar.resource_id=r.id
    AND ar.unit=slots.unit AND ar.occupied AND ar.appointment_id<>NEW.id
    AND tstzrange(ar.start_at,ar.end_at,'[)') && span) ORDER BY slots.unit LIMIT 1;
  IF chosen IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'resource capacity unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514',
 CONSTRAINT='scheduling_resource_conflict';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO clinic_app.scheduling_appointmentresource
   (id,organization_id,clinic_id,appointment_id,resource_id,unit,start_at,end_at,
 occupied)
  VALUES (gen_random_uuid(),NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id,NEW.id,r.id,chosen,
 lower(span),upper(span),true)
  ON CONFLICT (appointment_id,resource_id) DO UPDATE SET unit=excluded.unit,
   start_at=excluded.start_at,end_at=excluded.end_at,occupied=excluded.occupied;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"
