function inventory_balance(uuid, uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.inventory_balance(batch uuid, location uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE clinic uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT l.clinic_id INTO clinic FROM clinic_app.inventory_location l
 WHERE l.id=location AND l.organization_id=NULLIF(
 current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 IF clinic IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.inventory_batch_allowed(batch,clinic) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN clinic_app.inventory_sum(batch,location);
END $function$
"

function inventory_batch_allowed(uuid, u.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.inventory_batch_allowed(batch uuid, clinic uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NULL AND clinic_app.has_permission('inventory.read',clinic,NULL)
 AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.inventory_batch b WHERE b.id=batch
 AND b.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND (b.clinic_id=clinic OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
 JOIN clinic_app.inventory_location l ON l.id=m.destination_location_id
 WHERE m.batch_id=b.id AND m.kind='transfer' AND l.clinic_id=clinic
 AND l.organization_id=b.organization_id AND m.organization_id=b.organization_id)))
$function$
"
function inventory_batch_allowed(uuid, u.prosrc:
"
 SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NULL AND clinic_app.has_permission('inventory.read',clinic,NULL)
 AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.inventory_batch b WHERE b.id=batch
 AND b.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND (b.clinic_id=clinic OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
 JOIN clinic_app.inventory_location l ON l.id=m.destination_location_id
 WHERE m.batch_id=b.id AND m.kind='transfer' AND l.clinic_id=clinic
 AND l.organization_id=b.organization_id AND m.organization_id=b.organization_id)))
"

function inventory_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.inventory_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 tenant uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 runtime boolean := current_setting('role') IN ('clinic_app','clinic_agent')
 OR (current_setting('role')='none' AND session_user IN ('clinic_app','clinic_agent'));
 row_data jsonb; parent jsonb; field_name text; parent_table text;
 permission text := 'inventory.manage'; b clinic_app.inventory_batch;
 source clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement; purchase
 clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest;
 destination clinic_app.inventory_location; spent bigint;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') OR (TG_OP='UPDATE'
 AND TG_TABLE_NAME<>'inventory_purchaserequest') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM tenant OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=tenant) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- One organization lock also orders cross-clinic transfer and budget writes.
 -- VOLATILE queries after the lock reload committed facts at READ COMMITTED.
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('inventory:'||tenant::text,0));
 IF runtime AND current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_isolation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 row_data:=to_jsonb(NEW);
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_purchaserequest'
 THEN permission:='inventory.use'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_commandreceipt' THEN
  IF NEW.operation IN (
  'use','return_stock','create_purchase_request','propose_replenishment')
  THEN permission:='inventory.use'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_stockmovement' THEN
  IF NEW.kind IN ('use','return') THEN permission:='inventory.use'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN permission:='inventory.manage'; END IF;
 IF runtime AND NOT (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NULL
 AND clinic_app.has_permission(permission,NEW.clinic_id,NULL)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Every foreign binding is checked under the resolver, never around RLS
 -- from Python. Optional absent fields do not weaken populated bindings.
 FOR field_name,parent_table IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES
 ('item_id','inventory_item'),('supplier_id','inventory_supplier'),
 ('location_id','inventory_location'),('budget_id','inventory_purchasebudget'),
 ('equipment_id','inventory_equipment')) AS bindings(field_name,parent_table)
 LOOP
  IF row_data->>field_name IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT CASE parent_table
    WHEN 'inventory_item' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_item p
      WHERE p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
    WHEN 'inventory_supplier' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_supplier p
      WHERE p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
    WHEN 'inventory_location' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_location p
      WHERE p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
    WHEN 'inventory_purchasebudget' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p)
      FROM clinic_app.inventory_purchasebudget p WHERE
 p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
    WHEN 'inventory_equipment' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_equipment p
      WHERE p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
   END INTO parent;
   IF parent IS NULL OR parent->>'organization_id'<>tenant::text
   OR parent->>'clinic_id'<>NEW.clinic_id::text THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_batch' THEN
  IF NEW.lot='' OR length(NEW.lot)>120 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF row_data ? 'quantity' AND
 ((row_data->>'quantity')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_quantity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF row_data ? 'amount_minor' AND
 ((row_data->>'amount_minor')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 9000000000000000) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_amount' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_purchasebudget' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r
   JOIN clinic_app.identity_user u ON u.id=r.user_id AND u.is_active
   WHERE r.user_id=NEW.approved_by_id AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND r.organization_id=tenant AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
   AND r.role IN ('clinic_manager','clinic_admin'))
  OR (runtime AND NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF runtime THEN NEW.approved_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_purchaserequest' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.state<>'draft' OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.last_command_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'purchase_transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','approved_by_id','approved_at','last_command_id'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','approved_by_id','approved_at','last_command_id'])
   OR NEW.last_command_id IS NULL OR NEW.last_command_id=OLD.last_command_id
   OR NOT ((OLD.state='draft' AND NEW.state='approved') OR
       (OLD.state='approved' AND NEW.state='received')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'purchase_transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='approved' THEN
    IF NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    NEW.approved_at:=statement_timestamp();
   ELSE
    IF NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by_id
    OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at OR NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
     WHERE m.purchase_request_id=NEW.id AND m.kind='receipt'
      AND m.quantity=NEW.quantity AND m.command_id=NEW.last_command_id) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'purchase_not_approved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.budget_id IS NOT NULL AND
   (TG_OP='INSERT' OR NEW.state='approved') THEN
   SELECT coalesce(sum(p.amount_minor),0) INTO spent
   FROM clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest p WHERE p.budget_id=NEW.budget_id
   AND p.state IN ('approved','received') AND p.id<>NEW.id;
   IF spent+NEW.amount_minor>(SELECT amount_minor
     FROM clinic_app.inventory_purchasebudget WHERE id=NEW.budget_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'budget_exceeded' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('inventory_calibration','inventory_maintenance') THEN
  IF NEW.performed_on>(SELECT
   (statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)::date
   FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id)
   OR NEW.due_on<NEW.performed_on OR
   (TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_calibration' AND NEW.outcome NOT IN ('passed','failed'))
   OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_maintenance'
   AND NEW.outcome NOT IN ('completed','failed')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_commandreceipt' THEN
  IF NEW.operation NOT IN ('receive','use','return_stock','write_off','transfer',
   'create_purchase_request','propose_replenishment','approve_purchase',
   'receive_purchase','approve_budget','register_equipment','record_calibration',
   'record_maintenance','create_item','create_batch','create_location',
   'create_supplier','set_minimum_stock')
  OR NEW.object_type NOT IN ('stockmovement','purchaserequest','purchasebudget',
   'equipment','calibration','maintenance','item','batch','location','supplier',
   'minimumstock') OR NEW.recorded_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  SELECT CASE NEW.object_type
   WHEN 'item' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_item p WHERE
 p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'batch' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_batch p WHERE
 p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'location' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_location p WHERE
 p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'supplier' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_supplier p WHERE
 p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'minimumstock' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_minimumstock
 p WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'stockmovement' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement p WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'purchaserequest' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest p WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'purchasebudget' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_purchasebudget p WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'equipment' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_equipment p
 WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'calibration' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_calibration p
 WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'maintenance' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_maintenance p
 WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
  END INTO parent;
  IF parent IS NULL OR parent->>'organization_id'<>tenant::text OR
   parent->>'clinic_id'<>NEW.clinic_id::text THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_stockmovement' THEN
  SELECT * INTO b FROM clinic_app.inventory_batch WHERE id=NEW.batch_id;
  IF b.id IS NULL OR b.organization_id<>tenant
  OR NOT clinic_app.inventory_batch_allowed(b.id,NEW.clinic_id)
  OR NEW.kind NOT IN ('receipt','use','return','write_off','transfer')
  OR NEW.recorded_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR (NEW.kind<>'write_off' AND NEW.reason<>'')
  OR (NEW.kind='write_off' AND NEW.reason NOT IN ('damaged','expired','lost'))
  OR (NEW.kind<>'return' AND NEW.source_movement_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (NEW.kind<>'use' AND NEW.procedure_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (NEW.kind<>'receipt' AND NEW.purchase_request_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('use','transfer') AND
   b.expires_on<=clinic_app.inventory_today(NEW.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'batch_expired' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('use','write_off','transfer') AND
   clinic_app.inventory_sum(b.id,NEW.location_id)<NEW.quantity THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_stock' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.procedure_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_specialtyentry p WHERE p.id=NEW.procedure_entry_id
   AND p.kind='procedure' AND p.organization_id=tenant AND p.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.kind='return' THEN
   SELECT * INTO source FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
    WHERE m.id=NEW.source_movement_id AND m.organization_id=tenant
    AND m.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND m.kind='use';
   IF source.id IS NULL OR source.batch_id<>b.id
    OR source.location_id<>NEW.location_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.quantity+coalesce((SELECT sum(m.quantity)
    FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
    WHERE m.source_movement_id=source.id),0)>source.quantity THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'return_exceeds_use' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind='transfer' THEN
   SELECT * INTO destination FROM clinic_app.inventory_location l
    WHERE l.id=NEW.destination_location_id AND l.organization_id=tenant;
   IF destination.id IS NULL OR destination.id=NEW.location_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF destination.clinic_id<>NEW.clinic_id AND NOT (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NULL
    AND clinic_app.has_permission('inventory.transfer_org',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    AND clinic_app.has_permission('inventory.transfer_org',destination.clinic_id,NULL)
    AND clinic_app.has_permission('inventory.manage',destination.clinic_id,NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.destination_location_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.purchase_request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO purchase FROM clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest p
   WHERE p.id=NEW.purchase_request_id AND p.organization_id=tenant
    AND p.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id;
   IF purchase.id IS NULL OR purchase.state<>'approved'
    OR purchase.item_id<>b.item_id OR purchase.quantity<>NEW.quantity THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'purchase_not_approved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"
function inventory_guard().prosrc:
"
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 tenant uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 runtime boolean := current_setting('role') IN ('clinic_app','clinic_agent')
 OR (current_setting('role')='none' AND session_user IN ('clinic_app','clinic_agent'));
 row_data jsonb; parent jsonb; field_name text; parent_table text;
 permission text := 'inventory.manage'; b clinic_app.inventory_batch;
 source clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement; purchase
 clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest;
 destination clinic_app.inventory_location; spent bigint;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') OR (TG_OP='UPDATE'
 AND TG_TABLE_NAME<>'inventory_purchaserequest') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM tenant OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=tenant) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- One organization lock also orders cross-clinic transfer and budget writes.
 -- VOLATILE queries after the lock reload committed facts at READ COMMITTED.
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('inventory:'||tenant::text,0));
 IF runtime AND current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_isolation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 row_data:=to_jsonb(NEW);
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_purchaserequest'
 THEN permission:='inventory.use'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_commandreceipt' THEN
  IF NEW.operation IN (
  'use','return_stock','create_purchase_request','propose_replenishment')
  THEN permission:='inventory.use'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_stockmovement' THEN
  IF NEW.kind IN ('use','return') THEN permission:='inventory.use'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN permission:='inventory.manage'; END IF;
 IF runtime AND NOT (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NULL
 AND clinic_app.has_permission(permission,NEW.clinic_id,NULL)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Every foreign binding is checked under the resolver, never around RLS
 -- from Python. Optional absent fields do not weaken populated bindings.
 FOR field_name,parent_table IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES
 ('item_id','inventory_item'),('supplier_id','inventory_supplier'),
 ('location_id','inventory_location'),('budget_id','inventory_purchasebudget'),
 ('equipment_id','inventory_equipment')) AS bindings(field_name,parent_table)
 LOOP
  IF row_data->>field_name IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT CASE parent_table
    WHEN 'inventory_item' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_item p
      WHERE p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
    WHEN 'inventory_supplier' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_supplier p
      WHERE p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
    WHEN 'inventory_location' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_location p
      WHERE p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
    WHEN 'inventory_purchasebudget' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p)
      FROM clinic_app.inventory_purchasebudget p WHERE
 p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
    WHEN 'inventory_equipment' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_equipment p
      WHERE p.id=(row_data->>field_name)::uuid)
   END INTO parent;
   IF parent IS NULL OR parent->>'organization_id'<>tenant::text
   OR parent->>'clinic_id'<>NEW.clinic_id::text THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_batch' THEN
  IF NEW.lot='' OR length(NEW.lot)>120 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF row_data ? 'quantity' AND
 ((row_data->>'quantity')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_quantity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF row_data ? 'amount_minor' AND
 ((row_data->>'amount_minor')::bigint NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 9000000000000000) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_amount' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_purchasebudget' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_userclinicrole r
   JOIN clinic_app.identity_user u ON u.id=r.user_id AND u.is_active
   WHERE r.user_id=NEW.approved_by_id AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND r.organization_id=tenant AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
   AND r.role IN ('clinic_manager','clinic_admin'))
  OR (runtime AND NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF runtime THEN NEW.approved_at:=statement_timestamp(); END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_purchaserequest' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF NEW.state<>'draft' OR NEW.approved_by_id IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.last_command_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'purchase_transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','approved_by_id','approved_at','last_command_id'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','approved_by_id','approved_at','last_command_id'])
   OR NEW.last_command_id IS NULL OR NEW.last_command_id=OLD.last_command_id
   OR NOT ((OLD.state='draft' AND NEW.state='approved') OR
       (OLD.state='approved' AND NEW.state='received')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'purchase_transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='approved' THEN
    IF NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    NEW.approved_at:=statement_timestamp();
   ELSE
    IF NEW.approved_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by_id
    OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at OR NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
     WHERE m.purchase_request_id=NEW.id AND m.kind='receipt'
      AND m.quantity=NEW.quantity AND m.command_id=NEW.last_command_id) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'purchase_not_approved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.budget_id IS NOT NULL AND
   (TG_OP='INSERT' OR NEW.state='approved') THEN
   SELECT coalesce(sum(p.amount_minor),0) INTO spent
   FROM clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest p WHERE p.budget_id=NEW.budget_id
   AND p.state IN ('approved','received') AND p.id<>NEW.id;
   IF spent+NEW.amount_minor>(SELECT amount_minor
     FROM clinic_app.inventory_purchasebudget WHERE id=NEW.budget_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'budget_exceeded' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('inventory_calibration','inventory_maintenance') THEN
  IF NEW.performed_on>(SELECT
   (statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)::date
   FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id)
   OR NEW.due_on<NEW.performed_on OR
   (TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_calibration' AND NEW.outcome NOT IN ('passed','failed'))
   OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_maintenance'
   AND NEW.outcome NOT IN ('completed','failed')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_commandreceipt' THEN
  IF NEW.operation NOT IN ('receive','use','return_stock','write_off','transfer',
   'create_purchase_request','propose_replenishment','approve_purchase',
   'receive_purchase','approve_budget','register_equipment','record_calibration',
   'record_maintenance','create_item','create_batch','create_location',
   'create_supplier','set_minimum_stock')
  OR NEW.object_type NOT IN ('stockmovement','purchaserequest','purchasebudget',
   'equipment','calibration','maintenance','item','batch','location','supplier',
   'minimumstock') OR NEW.recorded_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  SELECT CASE NEW.object_type
   WHEN 'item' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_item p WHERE
 p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'batch' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_batch p WHERE
 p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'location' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_location p WHERE
 p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'supplier' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_supplier p WHERE
 p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'minimumstock' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_minimumstock
 p WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'stockmovement' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement p WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'purchaserequest' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest p WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'purchasebudget' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM
 clinic_app.inventory_purchasebudget p WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'equipment' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_equipment p
 WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'calibration' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_calibration p
 WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
   WHEN 'maintenance' THEN (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM clinic_app.inventory_maintenance p
 WHERE p.id=NEW.object_id)
  END INTO parent;
  IF parent IS NULL OR parent->>'organization_id'<>tenant::text OR
   parent->>'clinic_id'<>NEW.clinic_id::text THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='inventory_stockmovement' THEN
  SELECT * INTO b FROM clinic_app.inventory_batch WHERE id=NEW.batch_id;
  IF b.id IS NULL OR b.organization_id<>tenant
  OR NOT clinic_app.inventory_batch_allowed(b.id,NEW.clinic_id)
  OR NEW.kind NOT IN ('receipt','use','return','write_off','transfer')
  OR NEW.recorded_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR (NEW.kind<>'write_off' AND NEW.reason<>'')
  OR (NEW.kind='write_off' AND NEW.reason NOT IN ('damaged','expired','lost'))
  OR (NEW.kind<>'return' AND NEW.source_movement_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (NEW.kind<>'use' AND NEW.procedure_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (NEW.kind<>'receipt' AND NEW.purchase_request_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('use','transfer') AND
   b.expires_on<=clinic_app.inventory_today(NEW.clinic_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'batch_expired' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('use','write_off','transfer') AND
   clinic_app.inventory_sum(b.id,NEW.location_id)<NEW.quantity THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_stock' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.procedure_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_specialtyentry p WHERE p.id=NEW.procedure_entry_id
   AND p.kind='procedure' AND p.organization_id=tenant AND p.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.kind='return' THEN
   SELECT * INTO source FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
    WHERE m.id=NEW.source_movement_id AND m.organization_id=tenant
    AND m.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND m.kind='use';
   IF source.id IS NULL OR source.batch_id<>b.id
    OR source.location_id<>NEW.location_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.quantity+coalesce((SELECT sum(m.quantity)
    FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
    WHERE m.source_movement_id=source.id),0)>source.quantity THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'return_exceeds_use' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind='transfer' THEN
   SELECT * INTO destination FROM clinic_app.inventory_location l
    WHERE l.id=NEW.destination_location_id AND l.organization_id=tenant;
   IF destination.id IS NULL OR destination.id=NEW.location_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF destination.clinic_id<>NEW.clinic_id AND NOT (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NULL
    AND clinic_app.has_permission('inventory.transfer_org',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    AND clinic_app.has_permission('inventory.transfer_org',destination.clinic_id,NULL)
    AND clinic_app.has_permission('inventory.manage',destination.clinic_id,NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.destination_location_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.purchase_request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO purchase FROM clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest p
   WHERE p.id=NEW.purchase_request_id AND p.organization_id=tenant
    AND p.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id;
   IF purchase.id IS NULL OR purchase.state<>'approved'
    OR purchase.item_id<>b.item_id OR purchase.quantity<>NEW.quantity THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'purchase_not_approved' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END "

function inventory_no_truncate().definition:

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$

function inventory_received().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.inventory_received()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.purchase_request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  UPDATE clinic_app.inventory_purchaserequest SET state='received',
   last_command_id=NEW.command_id WHERE id=NEW.purchase_request_id;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

function inventory_sum(uuid, uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.inventory_sum(batch uuid, location uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(sum(
 CASE WHEN m.location_id=location THEN
 CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('receipt','return') THEN m.quantity::bigint
 ELSE -m.quantity::bigint END ELSE 0 END
 + CASE WHEN m.destination_location_id=location THEN m.quantity::bigint ELSE 0 END
 ),0)::bigint FROM clinic_app.inventory_stockmovement m
 WHERE m.batch_id=batch
 AND m.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid
 AND (m.location_id=location OR m.destination_location_id=location)
$function$
"

function interop_allowed(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.interop_allowed(requested_clinic uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NULL
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=requested_clinic
  AND c.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid)
 AND (clinic_app.has_permission('staff.clinic',requested_clinic,NULL)
  OR clinic_app.has_permission('staff.organization',requested_clinic,NULL))
$function$
"

function interop_attachment(uuid, uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.interop_attachment(requested_clinic uuid, requested_record uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(record_id uuid, job_id uuid, enrollment_id uuid, media_type text, sha256 text, data bytea)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT r.id, r.job_id, r.enrollment_id, f.media_type::text, f.sha256::text,
  f.data
 FROM clinic_app.interop_importedrecord r
 JOIN clinic_app.interop_importfile f ON f.id=r.file_id AND f.job_id=r.job_id
  AND f.organization_id=r.organization_id AND f.role='attachment'
 WHERE r.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND r.clinic_id=requested_clinic
  AND r.id=requested_record AND r.kind='attachment'
  AND clinic_app.interop_record_visible(r.job_id,r.clinic_id,r.enrollment_id)
$function$
"
function interop_attachment(uuid, uuid).prosrc:
"
 SELECT r.id, r.job_id, r.enrollment_id, f.media_type::text, f.sha256::text,
  f.data
 FROM clinic_app.interop_importedrecord r
 JOIN clinic_app.interop_importfile f ON f.id=r.file_id AND f.job_id=r.job_id
  AND f.organization_id=r.organization_id AND f.role='attachment'
 WHERE r.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND r.clinic_id=requested_clinic
  AND r.id=requested_record AND r.kind='attachment'
  AND clinic_app.interop_record_visible(r.job_id,r.clinic_id,r.enrollment_id)
"

function interop_attachment_checks(uuid,.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.interop_attachment_checks(requested_job uuid, kek text)
 RETURNS TABLE(files integer, total_bytes bigint, mismatches integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE j clinic_app.interop_importjob;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO j FROM clinic_app.interop_importjob x WHERE x.id=requested_job
  AND x.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 IF j.id IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.interop_allowed(j.clinic_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'interop_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH linked AS (
  SELECT f.sha256, f.size_bytes,
   clinic_app.protected_decrypt(kek,'interop.importfile.data',f.data) AS plain
  FROM clinic_app.interop_importfile f
  WHERE f.job_id=j.id AND f.role='attachment' AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.interop_importedrecord r WHERE r.file_id=f.id))
 SELECT count(*)::integer, coalesce(sum(octet_length(l.plain)),0)::bigint,
  (count(*) FILTER (WHERE encode(sha256(l.plain),'hex')<>l.sha256
   OR octet_length(l.plain)<>l.size_bytes))::integer
 FROM linked l;
END $function$
"

"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.interop_hide_reversible(requested_job uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(imported_enrollment uuid, hidden boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE j clinic_app.interop_importjob; latest text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO j FROM clinic_app.interop_importjob x WHERE x.id=requested_job
  AND x.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 SELECT t.state INTO latest FROM clinic_app.interop_importtransition t
  WHERE t.job_id=j.id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1;

  OR latest IS DISTINCT FROM 'rolled_back' OR EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.interop_hiddenenrollment h WHERE h.job_id=j.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'interop_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

 WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT r.patient_id, r.enrollment_id, r.identifier_count

function interop_history(uuid, uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.interop_history(requested_clinic uuid, requested_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(record_id uuid, job_id uuid, kind text, row_number integer, original_author bytea, original_recorded_at timestamp with time zone, content bytea)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT r.id, r.job_id, r.kind::text, r.row_number::integer, r.original_author,
  r.original_recorded_at, r.content
 FROM clinic_app.interop_importedrecord r
 WHERE r.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid AND r.clinic_id=requested_clinic
  AND r.enrollment_id=requested_enrollment
  AND r.kind IN ('note','observation','attachment')
  AND clinic_app.interop_record_visible(r.job_id,r.clinic_id,r.enrollment_id)
 ORDER BY r.original_recorded_at, r.row_number, r.id
$function$
"

function interop_record_visible(uuid, uu.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.interop_record_visible(requested_job uuid, requested_clinic uuid, requested_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_principal',true),'') IS NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.interop_importtransition t
  WHERE t.job_id=requested_job AND t.state='rolled_back')
 AND clinic_app.has_permission('clinical.read',requested_clinic,requested_enrollment)
$function$
"

function interop_source(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.interop_source(requested_job uuid)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE j clinic_app.interop_importjob; latest text; envelope bytea;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO j FROM clinic_app.interop_importjob x WHERE x.id=requested_job
  AND x.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 SELECT t.state INTO latest FROM clinic_app.interop_importtransition t
  WHERE t.job_id=j.id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF j.id IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.interop_allowed(j.clinic_id)
  OR latest IS NULL OR latest NOT IN ('uploaded','profiled','mapped','dry_run','approved')
  OR (latest='approved'
   AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('demographics.read',j.clinic_id,NULL)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'interop_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT f.data INTO envelope FROM clinic_app.interop_importfile f
  WHERE f.job_id=j.id AND f.role='source';
 RETURN envelope;
END $function$
"

function identity_invitation_begin(bytea.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_invitation_begin(requested_hash bytea, requested_username bytea, requested_password text, requested_device_key text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    invitation clinic_app.identity_staffinvitation%ROWTYPE;
    created_device integer;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO invitation
    FROM clinic_app.identity_staffinvitation
    WHERE token_hash = requested_hash
      AND state = 'pending' AND revoked_at IS NULL
      AND expires_at > statement_timestamp()
      AND organization_id = NULLIF(
          current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), ''
      )::uuid
      AND pending_user_id = NULLIF(
          current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), ''
      )::uuid
    FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND OR invitation.password_set_at IS NOT NULL
       OR requested_username IS NULL OR requested_password IS NULL
       OR requested_password = '!' OR requested_device_key IS NULL
       OR requested_device_key !~ '^[a-f0-9]{40}$'
    THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_user
    SET password = requested_password
    WHERE id = invitation.pending_user_id AND NOT is_active;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice(
        user_id, name, confirmed, key, step, t0, digits, tolerance,
        drift, last_t, throttling_failure_timestamp, throttling_failure_count,
        created_at, last_used_at
    ) VALUES (
        invitation.pending_user_id, 'Clinic OS authenticator', false,
        '', 30, 0, 6, 1, 0, -1, NULL, 0,
        statement_timestamp(), NULL
    ) RETURNING id INTO created_device;
    INSERT INTO clinic_app.identity_totpsecret(device_id, secret)
    VALUES (created_device, decode(requested_device_key, 'hex'));
    UPDATE clinic_app.identity_staffinvitation
    SET desired_username = requested_username,
        password_set_at = statement_timestamp(),
        device_id = created_device
    WHERE id = invitation.id;
    RETURN created_device;
END
$function$
"

function identity_session_verify(bytea,.definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.identity_session_verify(requested_hash bytea, requested_device integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    WITH verified AS (
        UPDATE clinic_app.identity_sessionrecord AS session
        SET verification_device_id = requested_device,
            verification_passkey_id = NULL,
            verified_at = statement_timestamp()
        FROM clinic_app.otp_totp_totpdevice AS device
        JOIN clinic_app.identity_totpsecret AS store
          ON store.device_id = device.id
        WHERE session.session_key_hash = requested_hash
          AND session.user_id = NULLIF(
              current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), ''
          )::uuid
          AND session.revoked_at IS NULL
          AND session.expires_at > statement_timestamp()
          AND device.id = requested_device AND device.user_id = session.user_id
          AND device.confirmed AND device.last_t >= 0
          AND device.last_used_at >= statement_timestamp() - interval '5 minutes'
          AND store.verified_xact = pg_current_xact_id()
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_authenticatorretirement AS retirement
              WHERE retirement.device_id = device.id
          )
        RETURNING device.id AS device_id
    ), consumed AS (
        UPDATE clinic_app.identity_totpsecret AS store
        SET verified_xact = NULL
        FROM verified
        WHERE store.device_id = verified.device_id
        RETURNING store.device_id
    )
    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consumed)
$function$
"

function interop_hide_reversible(uuid).definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.interop_hide_reversible(requested_job uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(imported_enrollment uuid, hidden boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE j clinic_app.interop_importjob; latest text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO j FROM clinic_app.interop_importjob x WHERE x.id=requested_job
  AND x.organization_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')::uuid;
 SELECT t.state INTO latest FROM clinic_app.interop_importtransition t
  WHERE t.job_id=j.id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF j.id IS NULL OR NOT clinic_app.interop_allowed(j.clinic_id)
  OR latest IS DISTINCT FROM 'rolled_back' OR EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.interop_hiddenenrollment h WHERE h.job_id=j.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'interop_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT r.patient_id, r.enrollment_id, r.identifier_count
  FROM clinic_app.interop_importedrecord r
  WHERE r.job_id=j.id AND r.kind='patient'),
 reversible AS (
  SELECT c.enrollment_id FROM candidates c WHERE NOT (
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.billing_invoice x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_refusalrecord x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_clinicalattachment x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounter x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_encounteraddendum x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_episode x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_historyassessment x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_medicationstatement x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_observation x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_timelineprojection x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ehr_timelinerefresh x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_datasubjectrequest x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_emergencycontact x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_insurancemembership x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_mergedecision x WHERE x.merged_patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_mergedecision x WHERE x.survivor_patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientaccessgrant x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientaddress x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias x WHERE x.merged_patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientalias x WHERE x.survivor_patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientchannelpreference x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientcontact x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientsession x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_questionnaireresponse x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondocument x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondocumentrelease x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondocumentrevocation x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.prescription_prescriptiondraft x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.prescription_signatureoperation x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.retention_recordexport x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.retention_recordrelease x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_appointment x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_appointmentseries x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_waitlistentry x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.teleconsult_teleconsultsession x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_aiartifact x WHERE x.patient_enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_careproposal x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_extractionjob x WHERE x.patient_enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.ai_frontdeskthread x WHERE x.verified_enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_conversation x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_participant x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_consentacceptance x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.consent_refusalrecord x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.crm_campaignsend x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.crm_lead x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.crm_marketingpreference x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_careteammembership x WHERE x.patient_enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_patientdelegategrant x WHERE x.delegate_enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_patientdelegategrant x WHERE x.represented_enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.insurance_insurancemembership x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_datasubjectrequest x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_datasubjectrequest x WHERE x.requester_enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientaccessgrant x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientsession x WHERE x.acting_for_enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientsession x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_questionnaireresponse x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.orders_order x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scheduling_waitlistentry x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.scribe_recordingsession x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_careplan x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_proassignment x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_recall x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_releasedelivery x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_urgentconcern x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id AND x.id<>c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientdemographics x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id AND x.version>1)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.intake_patientidentifier x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)>c.identifier_count
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_breakglassgrant x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id))),
 inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO clinic_app.interop_hiddenenrollment
   (id, organization_id, clinic_id, enrollment_id, job_id, hidden_at)
  SELECT gen_random_uuid(), j.organization_id, j.clinic_id, v.enrollment_id, j.id,
   statement_timestamp() FROM reversible v
  RETURNING clinic_app.interop_hiddenenrollment.enrollment_id AS kept)
 SELECT c.enrollment_id, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.kept=c.enrollment_id)
 FROM candidates c ORDER BY c.enrollment_id;
END $function$
"

  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientclinicenrollment x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id AND x.id<>c.enrollment_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.intake_patientdemographics x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id AND x.version>1)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM clinic_app.intake_patientidentifier x WHERE x.patient_id=c.patient_id)>c.identifier_count
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_breakglassgrant x WHERE x.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id))),
 inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO clinic_app.interop_hiddenenrollment
   (id, organization_id, clinic_id, enrollment_id, job_id, hidden_at)
  SELECT gen_random_uuid(), j.organization_id, j.clinic_id, v.enrollment_id, j.id,
   statement_timestamp() FROM reversible v
  RETURNING clinic_app.interop_hiddenenrollment.enrollment_id AS kept)
 SELECT c.enrollment_id, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.kept=c.enrollment_id)
 FROM candidates c ORDER BY c.enrollment_id;
END "

function workflows_guard().definition:
"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clinic_app.workflows_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'clinic_app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid;
 run clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun;
 definition clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion;
 ref jsonb; item jsonb; allowed boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',
 true), '')::uuid
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.identity_clinic c WHERE c.id=NEW.clinic_id
 AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow scope mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;


 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='UPDATE'
 AND clinic_app.data_request_task_close_valid(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW))
 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.retention_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.orders_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.workflows_care_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' AND TG_OP='INSERT'
 AND clinic_app.workflows_release_system_task_valid(to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   IF (NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL) AND NOT clinic_app.enterprise_security_task(to_jsonb(NEW),'create'))
   OR NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'open'
   OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'' OR NEW.revision<>1
   OR NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' OR NEW.escalated_at IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL OR NEW.last_command_digest<>''
   OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task parent
    WHERE parent.id=NEW.depends_on_id AND parent.id<>NEW.id
    AND parent.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND parent.organization_id=NEW.organization_id))
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.subject_ref, NEW.organization_id,
   NEW.clinic_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF OLD.state IN ('done','cancelled') OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
   OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
   OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision', 'escalated_at', 'last_command_key', 'last_command_digest',
    'updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['owner_user_id','owner_role','state','completion_evidence',
    'revision','escalated_at','last_command_key','last_command_digest','updated_at'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF ROW(NEW.owner_user_id, NEW.owner_role) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.owner_user_id,
   OLD.owner_role) THEN
    -- owner_valid decides tasks.assign; the UPDATE policy already limits a
    -- non-manager's rows to own open tasks and owned work, so a self-claim
    -- needs no second, unobservable copy of that visibility here.
    IF (NOT clinic_app.workflows_owner_valid(NEW.clinic_id, NEW.owner_user_id,
    NEW.owner_role) AND NOT clinic_app.enterprise_security_task(to_jsonb(NEW),'review'))
    OR NOT (clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
     OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM actor)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task assignment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   allowed := NEW.state=OLD.state OR (OLD.state='open' AND NEW.state='assigned')
    OR (OLD.state='assigned' AND NEW.state='in_progress')
    OR (OLD.state='in_progress' AND NEW.state='done') OR NEW.state='cancelled';
   IF NOT allowed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task transition' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state IN ('in_progress','done') AND NEW.state<>OLD.state THEN
    IF (NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.complete',NEW.clinic_id,NULL) AND NOT clinic_app.enterprise_security_task(to_jsonb(NEW),'review'))
    OR (NOT clinic_app.workflows_owned(OLD.clinic_id,OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.owner_role) AND NOT clinic_app.enterprise_security_task(to_jsonb(NEW),'review'))
    OR (NEW.depends_on_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS
     (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.depends_on_id
      AND t.state='done'))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task completion denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'task cancellation denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.escalated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escalated_at AND
    (OLD.escalated_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.escalated_at IS NULL
     OR NEW.due_at>statement_timestamp()
     OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid escalation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.state='open' AND (NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_role<>'')
   OR NEW.state IN ('assigned', 'in_progress', 'done') AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NULL
   AND NEW.owner_role=''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='done' THEN
   IF NEW.kind='checklist' THEN allowed :=
   NEW.completion_evidence='{"checked":true}'::jsonb;
   ELSE allowed := jsonb_typeof(NEW.completion_evidence)='object'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence ?& ARRAY['record','outcome']
    AND NEW.completion_evidence-ARRAY['record','outcome']='{}'
    AND NEW.completion_evidence->>'outcome' IN ('reviewed','resolved','escalated')
    AND clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(NEW.completion_evidence->'record',
    NEW.organization_id, NEW.clinic_id);
   END IF;
   IF allowed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid task evidence' USING
   ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.completion_evidence<>'{}' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'premature task evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_taskcomment' THEN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment is immutable' USING
  ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.author_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NOT
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR octet_length(NEW.body)>65536 OR NOT EXISTS
   (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND ((t.state='open' AND
    t.created_by_id=actor)
     OR clinic_app.workflows_owned(t.clinic_id,t.owner_user_id,t.owner_role)
     OR clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',t.clinic_id,NULL)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'comment denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowdefinitionversion' THEN
  IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.key!~'^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$'
   OR NOT clinic_app.workflows_steps_valid(NEW.steps)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    'clinic-workflow-definition-v1:'||NEW.clinic_id::text||':'||NEW.key,0));
   IF NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR NEW.state<>'draft'
    OR NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.revision<>1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_digest<>'' OR NEW.creation_fingerprint<>NEW.fingerprint
    OR NEW.version<>(SELECT COALESCE(max(d.version),0)+1 FROM
     clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
     WHERE d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND d.key=NEW.key)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   NEW.created_at := statement_timestamp();
  ELSE
   IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
    OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
    OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest']) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','steps','fingerprint','validated_at',
     'published_by_id','published_at','retired_at','revision','last_command_key',
     'last_command_digest'])
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition identity is immutable'
    USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state IN ('draft','validated') AND NEW.state='draft' THEN
    IF NEW.published_by_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.validated_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF OLD.state='draft' AND NEW.state='validated' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.published_by_id,NEW.published_at,
     NEW.retired_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at,OLD.retired_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition validation changed content'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.validated_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='validated' AND NEW.state='published' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.retired_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,OLD.validated_at,OLD.retired_at)
     OR NEW.published_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'publication changed content' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.published_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSIF OLD.state='published' AND NEW.state='retired' THEN
    IF ROW(NEW.steps,NEW.fingerprint,NEW.validated_at,NEW.published_by_id,
     NEW.published_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.steps,OLD.fingerprint,
     OLD.validated_at,OLD.published_by_id,OLD.published_at)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'published definition is immutable'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    NEW.retired_at := statement_timestamp();
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition transition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_workflowrun' THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
    WHERE d.id=NEW.definition_version_id AND d.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND
    d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
   IF definition.id IS NULL OR definition.state<>'published'
    OR NEW.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR
   NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
    OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.context_refs)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   FOR ref IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.context_refs) LOOP
    IF NOT clinic_app.workflows_reference_valid(ref,NEW.organization_id,NEW.clinic_id)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
   FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition.steps) LOOP
    IF item->>'handler'='task' AND
    (item->>'subject')::int>=jsonb_array_length(NEW.context_refs)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing run reference' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','revision','last_command_key',
    'last_command_digest','updated_at'])
    OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled') OR NOT (
     (OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state IN ('running','cancelled')) OR
     (OLD.state IN ('running', 'waiting') AND NEW.state IN ('running', 'waiting',
     'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
     OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid run transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' THEN
    IF OLD.started_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NULL
     OR NEW.last_command_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_command_key
     OR NEW.last_command_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state='failed')
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
      WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND (s.state='cancelled' OR
       (s.state='failed' AND
        (s.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR s.created_task_id IS NOT NULL))))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run retry denied' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF ROW(NEW.last_command_key,NEW.last_command_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM
    ROW(OLD.last_command_key,OLD.last_command_digest) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'run command identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END IF;
   -- tasks.view is decided by the UPDATE policy before any row reaches here.
   IF NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',NEW.clinic_id,NULL)
   OR (NEW.state<>'cancelled' AND NOT clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'run transition denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
   clinic_app.workflows_workflowstep s
    WHERE s.run_id=NEW.id AND s.state<>'completed')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unfinished run' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO run FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowrun r WHERE r.id=NEW.run_id
   AND r.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id;
  IF run.id IS NULL OR NOT (run.started_by_id=actor AND
  clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.assign', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
  AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id, NULL)
   OR NEW.state='cancelled' AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.reassign',
   NEW.clinic_id, NULL) AND clinic_app.has_permission('tasks.view', NEW.clinic_id,
   NULL))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step authority denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT * INTO definition FROM clinic_app.workflows_workflowdefinitionversion d
   WHERE d.id=run.definition_version_id;
   IF NEW.position>=jsonb_array_length(definition.steps) OR NEW.state<>'pending'
    OR NEW.fencing_token<>0 OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL OR
    NEW.error_code<>''
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until', 'wake_at',
   'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state', 'fencing_token', 'claim_until',
    'wake_at', 'operation_id', 'created_task_id', 'error_code', 'updated_at'])
    OR OLD.state IN ('completed','cancelled')
    OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NOT (
     NEW.state='pending' AND run.state='pending'
     AND OLD.operation_id IS NULL AND OLD.created_task_id IS NULL))
    OR OLD.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.operation_id
    OR OLD.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.created_task_id IS DISTINCT FROM
    OLD.created_task_id
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state='pending' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR NEW.claim_until IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.wake_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.error_code<>''
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step retry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state='running' THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token+1 OR NEW.claim_until IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid fencing claim' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSIF NEW.state IN ('waiting','completed','failed','cancelled') THEN
    IF NEW.fencing_token<>OLD.fencing_token OR (OLD.state<>'running' AND
    NEW.state<>'cancelled')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid step transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
   WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   o.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
    AND o.kind='action' AND o.subject_type='workflows.step' AND o.subject_id=NEW.id
    AND o.actor_id=run.started_by_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step operation mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.created_task_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
  clinic_app.workflows_task t
   WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id AND t.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND
   t.clinic_id=NEW.clinic_id
   AND t.idempotency_key=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'step task mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='completed' THEN
   item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
   IF item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
     AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
     AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
     AND t.state='done')
    OR item->>'handler'='timer' AND (
     NEW.wake_at IS NULL OR NEW.wake_at>clinic_app.workflows_now())
    OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.comms_integrationoperation o
     WHERE o.id=NEW.operation_id AND o.status='delivered')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow effect is missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NEW.state='waiting' THEN
    item := definition.steps->NEW.position;
    IF NEW.wake_at IS NULL
     OR item->>'handler'='task' AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic_app.workflows_task t WHERE t.id=NEW.created_task_id
      AND t.kind=item->>'kind'
      AND t.subject_ref=run.context_refs->((item->>'subject')::int)
      AND t.state IN ('assigned','in_progress'))
     OR item->>'handler'='external' AND NEW.operation_id IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'workflow waiting receipt is missing'
     USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"

  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workflows_task' THEN
